name: a
trans: art. 表示“一(个, 件…)(非特指的)一(个)(同类事物中的)任何一(个)(用于表示时间、速度、价格等意义的)每一(用在某些物质名词和抽象名词前)一阵、一场、一种Aabbr. ampere 安
n. 英语字母表的第1个字母；A音；A类；干线公路；最高收入群体；第一列；第一已知量；表层土壤；A型血；A型号纸；A字形
abbr. 安培（ampere）；A纸牌（ace）；……比……（against）

sentences.c: He's a scoundrel! A cad!
sentences.cn: 他是个恶棍！一个卑鄙的无赖！

sentences.c: They had a butler, a cook, and a maid.
sentences.cn: 他们有一位管家、一位厨师和一位女仆。

sentences.c: She's a phony, a fake.
sentences.cn: 她是个伪君子、骗子。

name: an
trans: det. 一个（用于元音前）
art. 一（在元音音素前）

sentences.c: This recipe is an adaptation of an old favourite.
sentences.cn: 这个食谱是一个传统名食谱的改编。

sentences.c: The exam consists of an essay and an unseen translation.
sentences.cn: 考试包括一篇作文和一篇即席翻译。

sentences.c: An iron bar stuck out at an angle.
sentences.cn: 一根铁条成一定角度地突出来。

name: abandon
trans: v. 抛弃，遗弃；（因危险）离开，舍弃；中止，不再有；放弃（信念、信仰或看法）；陷入，沉湎于（某种情感）
n. 放任，放纵

sentences.c: Abandon hope all ye who enter here.
sentences.cn: 汝等进入此地，须弃绝希望。

sentences.c: The captain gave the order to abandon ship.
sentences.cn: 船长下令弃船。

sentences.c: Snow forced many drivers to abandon their vehicles.
sentences.cn: 大雪迫使许多驾驶者弃车步行。

name: ability
trans: n. 能力，能够；才能，技能，本领

sentences.c: No one doubted his ability.
sentences.cn: 没有人怀疑他的能力。

sentences.c: Her drama teacher spotted her ability.
sentences.cn: 她的戏剧老师发现了她的才能。

sentences.c: Almost everyone has some musical ability.
sentences.cn: 几乎人人都有一些音乐才能。

name: able
trans: adj. 能够，有能力的；聪明能干的，精通（某事）的
【名】 （Able）（英）埃布尔，（伊朗）阿布勒（人名）

sentences.c: She was barely able to stand.
sentences.cn: 她勉强能站立。

sentences.c: You'll be able to read in peace.
sentences.cn: 你将可以安静地看书。

sentences.c: She was not able to bear children.
sentences.cn: 她不能生育。

name: abnormal
trans: adj. 反常的，异常的，变态的；不规则的

sentences.c: They thought his behaviour was abnormal.
sentences.cn: 他们认为他行为反常。

sentences.c: He concluded that Oswald was somewhat abnormal.
sentences.cn: 他断定奥斯瓦德有点不正常。

sentences.c: The abnormal bleeding is your body's own red flag of danger.
sentences.cn: 这反常的流血是你身体本身的危险信号。

name: aboard
trans: adv. 在（船、飞机、火车等）上；上（船、飞机、火车等）；骑在（马）上，跨上（马）；（棒球）在垒上；加入，加盟
prep. 在（船、飞机、火车等）上；上（船、飞机、火车等）；骑在（马）上

sentences.c: She invited 750 people aboard the luxury yacht, the Savarona.
sentences.cn: 她邀请了750人登上这艘豪华游艇，萨瓦罗纳号。

sentences.c: The most junior executive officer outranked the senior engineer officer aboard ship.
sentences.cn: 船上最低的执行官也比高级工程官的级别高。

sentences.c: He was already aboard the plane.
sentences.cn: 他已经登机了。

name: abolish
trans: v. 废除，废止，取消

sentences.c: These reforms will abolish racially discriminatory laws.
sentences.cn: 这些改革将废除种族歧视法律。

sentences.c: An Illinois House committee voted Thursday to abolish the death penalty.
sentences.cn: 伊利诺伊州议院的一个委员会在星期四投票废除了死刑。

sentences.c: He took the first step to abolish slavery in America.
sentences.cn: 他迈出了在美国废除奴隶制的第一步。

name: abortion
trans: n. 流产，堕胎；失败；（生）（器官，尤其是种子或水果的）败育，停止发育；流产的胎儿

sentences.c: Is abortion morally defensible?
sentences.cn: 堕胎从道德上讲合乎情理吗？

sentences.c: I've always been anti-abortion.
sentences.cn: 我一直反对堕胎。

sentences.c: Abortion is a very emotional issue.
sentences.cn: 堕胎是个令人情绪十分激动的问题。

name: about
trans: 大约，大致
adv. 大约；几乎；到处，各处；无所事事；周围，在……附近；无序地，凌乱地；朝相反方向
prep. 关于，对于；目的是；针对（问题）；忙于，从事于；对……表示（情绪或心态）；各处，四下；在……附近；（某人或某事物）具有（某种特性）；围绕
adj. 现成的，能得到的；即将（做……）的，快要（发生……）的 （be about to do sth.）；四处走动的
【名】 （About）（法）艾保特（姓氏）

sentences.c: It costs about $10.
sentences.cn: 这大约要花10元钱。

sentences.c: What's he burbling about?
sentences.cn: 他在嘟囔些啥？

sentences.c: I'm definite about this.
sentences.cn: 我对这事毫无疑问。

name: above
trans: prep. （数量或度量）在……以上，超过；在（或向）……上面；（级别或地位上）高于； （重要性、质量）超过，胜过；（因善良或诚实正直而）不至于，不屑于（做某事）；（声音）比……更响亮，盖过；不受……影响，免于；（重要性、质量）超过，胜过
adv. （级别或地位上）高于；在（或向）上面，在（或向）较高处；高于，超出（特定数量、比率或标准）；上文，前文
adj. 前文述及的，上述的
n. 上文提及之事，前文所提之事（the above）

sentences.c: We were flying above the clouds.
sentences.cn: 我们在云层上面飞行。

sentences.c: Inflation is above 6%.
sentences.cn: 通货膨胀超过6%。

sentences.c: Above all, chairs should be comfortable.
sentences.cn: 首先椅子应该舒适。

name: abroad
trans: adv. 在国外，到国外；<旧>在室外，到室外；<正式> 广为流传，广为人知；行动自由；<古> 未击中目标，出错
n. 外国

sentences.c: He had been abroad many times.
sentences.cn: 他曾多次出国。

sentences.c: She worked abroad for a year.
sentences.cn: 她在国外工作了一年。

sentences.c: I have never contemplated living abroad.
sentences.cn: 我从未考虑过去国外居住。

name: abrupt
trans: adj. 突然的，意外的；粗鲁的，唐突的，（言语）生硬的；险峻的，陡峭的；（讲话或写作风格）不流畅的，不连贯的

sentences.c: He was abrupt to the point of rudeness.
sentences.cn: 他唐突到了无礼的地步。

sentences.c: She was very abrupt with me in our meeting.
sentences.cn: 在我们会面时，她跟我说话非常生硬。

sentences.c: His abrupt change of subject left her floundering helplessly.
sentences.cn: 他突然改变话题，使她茫然不知所措。

name: absence
trans: n. 缺席，缺勤，不在；缺乏，没有；缺席期间，休假期间；不注意

sentences.c: His absence went unremarked.
sentences.cn: 没有人注意到他不在场。

sentences.c: She did not mention her mother's absence.
sentences.cn: 她没有提到她母亲的缺席。

sentences.c: I can't think of any possible explanation for his absence.
sentences.cn: 我想不出他缺席的任何理由。

name: absent
trans: adj. 缺勤的，缺席的；不存在的，缺乏的；心不在焉的，出神的；不与子女一起住的
prep. <美，正式>缺乏，没有
v. 缺席，离开

sentences.c: "Nothing," Rosie said in an absent way.
sentences.cn: “没什么，”罗茜心不在焉地说。

sentences.c: She was absent for nine consecutive days.
sentences.cn: 她一连缺席了九天。

sentences.c: The pictures, too, were absent from the walls.
sentences.cn: 那些照片也不在那些墙上了。

name: absolute
trans: adj. 完全的，纯粹的；绝对的，无疑的；十足的；不受任何限制的，专制独裁的；（结构）独立的
n. 绝对真理，绝对原则

sentences.c: Their new CD is absolute pants!
sentences.cn: 他们的新光盘绝对是次货！

sentences.c: There are no absolute rules.
sentences.cn: 没有绝对的准则。

sentences.c: The laws of nature are absolute.
sentences.cn: 自然规律是绝对确凿的。

name: absorb
trans: v. 吸收；使并入，纳入；同化，汲取；消减，缓冲（外力、震动等）；理解，掌握（信息）；使全神贯注，使专心；承受（变革、影响等），承担（费用等）；花掉（大量金钱），耗费

sentences.c: Plants absorb oxygen.
sentences.cn: 植物吸收氧气。

sentences.c: Steel barriers can bend and absorb the shock.
sentences.cn: 铁栅栏会弯曲并吸收冲击力。

sentences.c: Black walls absorb a lot of heat during the day.
sentences.cn: 黑色墙壁在白天吸收大量的热。

name: abstract
trans: adj. 抽象的，纯概念的；（艺术）抽象派的；理论上的，不切实际的
n. 摘要，梗概；抽象画，抽象派艺术作品；抽象的概念
v. 抽象化，从理论上（或孤立地）考虑；提取，使分离；写……的摘要；偷走，窃取；退出

sentences.c: Abstract art is an acquired taste.
sentences.cn: 要慢慢培养才会欣赏抽象艺术。

sentences.c: It's not a question of some abstract concept of justice.
sentences.cn: 这不是一个有关正义的某一抽象概念的问题。

sentences.c: A modern abstract painting takes over one complete wall.
sentences.cn: 一幅现代抽象画占了整整一面墙。

name: absurd
trans: adj. 愚蠢的，荒谬的；滑稽可笑的；荒诞派的
n. 荒诞，荒诞的事物 （the absurd）

sentences.c: He has a good sense of the absurd.
sentences.cn: 他对荒诞事物有较强的识别能力。

sentences.c: Of course it's not true, what an absurd idea.
sentences.cn: 那当然不合乎事实，这个想法太荒唐了！

sentences.c: His high-flown style just sounds absurd today.
sentences.cn: 他的浮夸风格如今听起来真是荒谬。

name: abundant
trans: adj. 大量的，丰富的，充足的

sentences.c: There is an abundant supply of cheap labour.
sentences.cn: 有丰富的廉价劳动力供应。

sentences.c: I have ever had abundant love experiences.
sentences.cn: 我曾经有过丰富的感情经历。

sentences.c: Our country has a vast territory and abundant resources.
sentences.cn: 我国土地辽阔， 资源丰富。

name: abuse
trans: v. 虐待；滥用，辜负；辱骂；糟蹋（某物）；性侵犯
n. 虐待，凌辱；滥用，妄用；辱骂；舞弊，腐败；糟蹋；性侵犯；恶习，陋习
【名】 （Abuse）（英）阿比斯（人名）

sentences.c: Rival fans hurled abuse at each other.
sentences.cn: 两帮对立的球迷相互高声辱骂。

sentences.c: The system is open to abuse.
sentences.cn: 这项制度容易被滥用。

sentences.c: She let loose a stream of abuse.
sentences.cn: 她破口大骂起来。

name: academic
trans: adj. 学业的，学术的；学校的，学院的；学业（成绩）优秀的，善于学习的；不切实际的，空谈的
n. 大学教师，学者；（学校或学院的）课程；大学生

sentences.c: He is unsuited to academic work.
sentences.cn: 他不适合做学术工作。

sentences.c: It is a purely academic question.
sentences.cn: 这是一个纯理论问题。

sentences.c: Their academic standards are high.
sentences.cn: 他们的学术水平很高。

name: academy
trans: n. 专科院校；研究院，学会；（美国的）私立学校；（苏格兰的）中等学校

sentences.c: The Academy Awards appear to validate his career.
sentences.cn: 这些奥斯卡金像奖看来证实了他的职业生涯的价值。

sentences.c: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
sentences.cn: 该学院如今比过去更为兼收并蓄。

sentences.c: The movie won nine Academy Awards, including Best Picture.
sentences.cn: 这部电影荣获九项奥斯卡金像奖，包括最佳影片奖。

name: accelerate
trans: v. （使）加快，促进；（车辆或驾驶者）加速

sentences.c: Inflation continues to accelerate.
sentences.cn: 通货膨胀不断加速。

sentences.c: Growth will accelerate to 2.9 percent next year.
sentences.cn: 增长明年将加快到2.9%。

sentences.c: Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.
sentences.cn: 暴露在日光下会加快老化过程。

name: accent
trans: n. 口音，腔调，土音；着重点，强调；重音；（字母上的）读音符号；点缀，特色
v. 强调，突出；重读；以重音演奏

sentences.c: Everybody laughs at my accent.
sentences.cn: 大家都拿我的口音取笑。

sentences.c: Her accent was unmistakable.
sentences.cn: 她的口音是很明显的。

sentences.c: He mimicked her southern accent.
sentences.cn: 他滑稽地模仿她的南方口音。

name: accept
trans: v. 接受，收受；同意，赞成；相信，认为……正确；忍受，容忍；吸纳，招收；接纳；承担（责任等），承认；承兑，认付（单据等）；不排斥；适配

sentences.c: You have to accept the inevitable.
sentences.cn: 你得接受必然发生的事。

sentences.c: She won't accept advice from anyone.
sentences.cn: 她不会接受任何人的忠告。

sentences.c: She's decided not to accept the job.
sentences.cn: 她决定不接受这项工作。

name: access
trans: n. 入口，通道；获得的机会，使用权；（对计算机存储器的）访问，存取；（情感）爆发，发作；探视权
v. 接近，进入；获取，访问（计算机信息）
adj. <美>（电视节目或时间等）对外公开的

sentences.c: Does the hotel have wheelchair access ?
sentences.cn: 这家旅馆有轮椅通道吗？

sentences.c: She had unhindered access to the files.
sentences.cn: 她可任意使用档案。

sentences.c: There is no vehicular access.
sentences.cn: 不通车。

name: accessible
trans: adj. 可到达的，可进入的；易得到的，可使用的；可以理解的，易懂的；平易近人的，随和的；易受影响的

sentences.c: The centre is easily accessible to the general public.
sentences.cn: 该中心对于广大公众来讲很便利。

sentences.c: The museum is easily accessible by car.
sentences.cn: 开车可以方便地到达博物馆。

sentences.c: These documents are not accessible to the public.
sentences.cn: 公众无法看到这些文件。

name: accident
trans: n. 交通事故，车祸；（不幸的）意外遭遇，不测事件；意外，偶然的事；运气，机遇；大便（或小便）失禁；（亚里士多德思想中的）非本质属性

sentences.c: It was an unfortunate accident.
sentences.cn: 那是一次不幸的事故。

sentences.c: He was killed in an accident.
sentences.cn: 他死于一次车祸。

sentences.c: An accident can happen anywhere.
sentences.cn: 任何地方都可能发生事故。

name: accommodation
trans: n. <美>住宿，膳宿；<英>住处，办公处，停留处；（楼房或交通工具内的）空间，座位；和解，调和；（通过改变眼球晶状体形状）自动调焦

sentences.c: She left out an 'm' in 'accommodation'.
sentences.cn: 她在accommodation一词中漏掉了一个字母m。

sentences.c: The accommodation is simple but spacious.
sentences.cn: 住处简朴但宽敞。

sentences.c: They were unhappy with their accommodation.
sentences.cn: 他们对住处不满意。

name: accompany
trans: v. 陪伴，陪同；伴随，与……一起发生；为……伴奏（或伴唱）；附带，补充

sentences.c: Ken agreed to accompany me on a trip to Africa.
sentences.cn: 肯同意陪我去非洲旅行。

sentences.c: Barron invited her to accompany him to the races.
sentences.cn: 巴伦邀请了她陪他去看比赛。

sentences.c: Government monitors will continue to accompany reporters.
sentences.cn: 政府监督员们将继续陪同记者们。

name: accomplish
trans: v. 完成，实现

sentences.c: If we'd all work together, I think we could accomplish our goal.
sentences.cn: 如果我们齐心协力，我想我们能实现我们的目标。

sentences.c: He exhorted his companions, "Try to accomplish your aim with diligence."
sentences.cn: 他勉励他的同志，“尝试以勤奋来实现目标。”

sentences.c: "Never in my wildest dreams did I think I'd ever accomplish this," said Toni.
sentences.cn: “即便在我异想天开的时候，也从来没有想到过我能实现它，”托尼说。

name: according to
trans: 根据：表示根据某人或某事的陈述、说法或信念。
按照：表示按照某个标准、规则或方法。
据……所述：表示根据某人的陈述或说法。

sentences.c: Everything went according to plan.
sentences.cn: 一切均按照计划进行。

sentences.c: People should pay according to their means.
sentences.cn: 人们应该按照各自的负担能力来消费。

sentences.c: Prices change according to supply and demand.
sentences.cn: 价格根据供应量和需求量而变化。

name: account
trans: n. 账户，户头；客户，老主顾；网络账号；描述，报道；账目；账单；赊购账，赊购；理由，解释；重要性；（定期结付的）交易合同；演奏（音乐）；<英>账期交易期
v. 把……视作，认为；解释，说明（account for）；占（一定数量或比例）（account for）；<古>报账

sentences.c: I don't have a bank account.
sentences.cn: 我没有银行账户。

sentences.c: What's your account number please?
sentences.cn: 请问你的账户号码？

sentences.c: Does your current account pay interest?
sentences.cn: 你的活期存款账户计息吗？

name: accountant
trans: n. 会计，会计师

sentences.c: She has an appointment with her accountant.
sentences.cn: 她和她的会计师有个约会。

sentences.c: It would probably pay you to hire an accountant.
sentences.cn: 聘一名会计师或许对你有好处。

sentences.c: She has been an accountant all her working life.
sentences.cn: 她在整个职业生涯中一直是会计师。

name: accumulate
trans: v. 积累，积攒

sentences.c: Lead can accumulate in the body until toxic levels are reached.
sentences.cn: 铅可以在体内积聚直至到达有毒的程度。

sentences.c: It was his ambition to accumulate a million dollars before he turned thirty.
sentences.cn: 他的雄心是在30岁以前积攒100万美元。

sentences.c: They accumulate essentially no body fat.
sentences.cn: 它们基本上不积累身体脂肪。

name: accuracy
trans: n. 准确性，精确性；准确，精确

sentences.c: A high degree of accuracy is needed.
sentences.cn: 需要高度的准确性。

sentences.c: She hits the ball with great accuracy.
sentences.cn: 她击球十分准确。

sentences.c: He cannot vouch for the accuracy of the story.
sentences.cn: 他不能证明报道的准确性。

name: accuse
trans: v. 控告，指控；指责，谴责，归咎于

sentences.c: He laughs loudly when I accuse him of fibbing.
sentences.cn: 我指控他撒谎时，他笑得很大声。

sentences.c: His father would accuse him of neglecting his filial duties.
sentences.cn: 他父亲会指控他没有尽孝。

sentences.c: Politicians accuse the media of talking up the possibility of a riot.
sentences.cn: 政客们谴责媒体夸大骚乱的可能性。

name: accustomed
trans: adj. 习惯的，适应的；惯常的，通常的；（眼睛对光线变化）习惯了的，适应了的
v. 使习惯于，使适应（accustom 的过去式和过去分词）

sentences.c: Some are so accustomed to pigging out, they can't cut back.
sentences.cn: 有些人习惯暴饮暴食了，他们不可能缩减食量。

sentences.c: Mary Jo is still accustomed to travelling everywhere in style.
sentences.cn: 玛丽·乔仍然习惯于很有气派地到处旅行。

sentences.c: She was a person accustomed to having eight hours' sleep a night.
sentences.cn: 她是那种习惯每晚睡八个小时的人。

name: ache
trans: v. （隐隐地、持续地）疼痛；渴望；哀痛，怜悯
n. （身体某部位的）疼痛；（心中的）苦痛，痛苦；<文>渴望； <文>渴望
【名】 （Ache）（美、法、印尼）阿切（人名）

sentences.c: Mummy, I've got a tummy ache.
sentences.cn: 妈妈，我肚子疼。

sentences.c: My head had begun to ache and my stomach felt funny.
sentences.cn: 我的头开始疼了，我的胃也感到不对劲。

sentences.c: The pain, usually a dull ache, gets worse with exercise.
sentences.cn: 这种疼痛，通常是隐隐作痛，运动时会加剧。

name: achieve
trans: v. （经努力）达到，取得，实现；获得成功

sentences.c: The medicine did not achieve the desired effect.
sentences.cn: 这种药未达到预期效果。

sentences.c: Teamwork is required in order to achieve these aims.
sentences.cn: 要达到这些目标需要齐心协力。

sentences.c: The party has manifestly failed to achieve its goal.
sentences.cn: 这一政党显然没有达到自己的目标。

name: achievement
trans: n. 成绩，成就；完成，实现；（纹章）纹章牌

sentences.c: It is an impressive achievement.
sentences.cn: 这是一项令人敬佩的成就。

sentences.c: 2004 was a year of solid achievement.
sentences.cn: 2004年是颇有成绩的一年。

sentences.c: It is indeed a remarkable achievement.
sentences.cn: 这的确是非凡的成就。

name: acid
trans: n. 酸；<非正式>迷幻药；尖刻（或尖酸）的言语（或语调）；质子供体，电子对受体
adj. 酸的；酸性的；尖酸的，刻薄的；（颜色）刺目的，鲜亮的；（岩石，尤指熔岩）含相当量硅石的

sentences.c: Rye is tolerant of poor, acid soils.
sentences.cn: 黑麦耐贫瘠的酸性土壤。

sentences.c: Acid corrodes metal.
sentences.cn: 酸腐蚀金属。

sentences.c: Carbolic acid is usually used for cleaning.
sentences.cn: 石炭酸常用于清洁。

name: acknowledge
trans: v. 承认；认可； 跟……打招呼，理会；告知收到；（公开）感谢

sentences.c: She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.
sentences.cn: 她拒不承认改革的必要性。

sentences.c: I did not acknowledge that he had done anything wrong.
sentences.cn: 我没有承认他犯了什么错。

sentences.c: You have to acknowledge that we live in a racist society.
sentences.cn: 你不得不承认我们生活在一个有种族歧视的社会。

name: acquaintance
trans: n. 相识的人，泛泛之交；认识，相识；所知，了解

sentences.c: I made the acquaintance of several musicians around that time.
sentences.cn: 大约在那段时间，我结识了几位音乐家。

sentences.c: I am delighted to make your acquaintance, Mrs Baker.
sentences.cn: 贝克太太，我很高兴与您相识。

sentences.c: Hammer's business pedigree almost guaranteed him the acquaintance of presidents.
sentences.cn: 哈默的商业背景几乎保证了他与几位总统的相识。

name: acquire
trans: v. 获得，得到；学到，习得；患上（疾病）；逐渐具有，开始学会

sentences.c: He was the mastermind behind the plan to acquire the explosives.
sentences.cn: 他是获取炸药计划的幕后操纵者。

sentences.c: One will never be able to understand why these political issues can acquire such force.
sentences.cn: 人们将永远不会明白为什么这些政治问题能获得如此的影响力。

sentences.c: People must acquire this skill somewhere.
sentences.cn: 人们必须从某个地方获得这种技能。

name: acquisition
trans: n. 学得，习得；（金钱、财物等的）获取；购买，添置，增添物；收购，购置的产业

sentences.c: Indeed, ease of acquisition is the problem.
sentences.cn: 事实上，容易获得是个问题。

sentences.c: He devotes his time to the acquisition of knowledge.
sentences.cn: 他把时间用在获取知识上。

sentences.c: The first hypothesis is the acquisition and learning distinction hypothesis.
sentences.cn: 第一个假设是习得和学习差异的假设。

name: acre
trans: n. 英亩；<非正式>大片，大量

sentences.c: 50 five-acre parcels have already been sold.
sentences.cn: 五英亩一块的土地已经售出50块。

sentences.c: He spent holidays at the 300-acre estate of his aunt and uncle.
sentences.cn: 他在叔叔和婶婶的300英亩庄园里度过许多假日。

sentences.c: There is about half an acre around the house.
sentences.cn: 房子周围大约有半英亩地。

name: across
trans: adv. 从一边到另一边；在……对面；朝，向；宽；横向字谜答案
prep. 从一边到另一边；横过，穿过；在……对面；遍及；在……上；跨越（政治、宗教、社会隔阂等）

sentences.c: Clouds drifted across the sky.
sentences.cn: 朵朵浮云在空中飘过。

sentences.c: They fled across the border.
sentences.cn: 他们越过边界逃走了。

sentences.c: He stepped across the threshold.
sentences.cn: 他迈过门槛。

name: act
trans: v. 行动；举动，表现；假装；表演，演出；担任；起作用；代理；（心理分析）行为表现
n. 行为，行动；法案；装模作样；（戏剧、歌剧等的）一幕；一段表演；节目；表演者，演出团体；发现某人正在（做某事）；判决书；<旧>会议记录，公报

sentences.c: She doesn't go on until Act 2.
sentences.cn: 她要到第2幕才出场。

sentences.c: Can you act as interpreter?
sentences.cn: 你能担任口译吗？

sentences.c: You must act boldly and confidently.
sentences.cn: 你必须表现得大胆、自信。

name: action
trans: n. 行动；行为；战斗；诉讼；<非正式>令人激动的事；动作；情节；惊险刺激的活动（或事件）；作用；开始（电影导演开拍的指令）；赚钱的机会；性交；运转方式
v. 处理
adj. 动作（片）的，动作片中的
【名】 （Action）（英）埃克申（人名）

sentences.c: Take whatever action is needed.
sentences.cn: 采取任何必要的行动。

sentences.c: Fury propelled her into action.
sentences.cn: 怒火驱使她行动起来。

sentences.c: The government took swift action.
sentences.cn: 政府立即采取了行动。

name: active
trans: adj. 好动的；积极主动的；定期进行的，起作用的；（思想等）活跃的；切实的；（火山）活的；主动语态的；活性的；（疾病）恶化的；服役的；参战的；（动词）表动作的；（电路系统）在运转中的
n. 主动语态

sentences.c: They were both politically active.
sentences.cn: 他们两人在政治上都很积极。

sentences.c: He was very active in Freemasonry.
sentences.cn: 他在共济会组织很活跃。

sentences.c: REM sleep is termed 'active' sleep.
sentences.cn: 快速眼动睡眠称作“主动”睡眠。

name: activity
trans: n. 活跃状况，热闹；活动；（Activity）热力活性，活度

sentences.c: It was a period of intense activity.
sentences.cn: 那是活动激烈的时期。

sentences.c: Parents encourage every activity imaginable.
sentences.cn: 父母鼓励一切可能的活动。

sentences.c: Economic activity often follows a cyclical pattern.
sentences.cn: 经济活动常常遵循周期性模式。

name: actor
trans: n. 演员；像在演戏的人；（行动或过程）参与者

sentences.c: Grodin is a fine comic actor.
sentences.cn: 格罗丁是一位好的滑稽演员。

sentences.c: He failed miserably as an actor.
sentences.cn: 作为演员，他败得很惨。

sentences.c: He was nominated (as) best actor.
sentences.cn: 他获得了最佳男演员的提名。

name: actress
trans: n. 女演员

sentences.c: Her vocation is her work as an actress.
sentences.cn: 她适合的职业就是当演员。

sentences.c: She fancies herself (as) a serious actress.
sentences.cn: 她自以为是严肃的演员。

sentences.c: Jane is determined to stake her claim as an actress.
sentences.cn: 简决心提出她作为一名女演员的应有权利。

name: actual
trans: adj. 真实的，实际的，现实的；（用于对比主次方面）真正的；现存的，当前的

sentences.c: The actual cost was higher than we expected.
sentences.cn: 实际成本比我们预计的要高。

sentences.c: First we need to identify actual and potential problems.
sentences.cn: 首先，我们需要弄清实际的问题和潜在的问题。

sentences.c: Any resemblance to actual persons, places, or events is purely coincidental.
sentences.cn: 如与实际的人、地、事有所雷同，纯属巧合。

name: acute
trans: adj. 严重的，危险的；急性的，剧烈的；灵敏的；敏锐的，有洞察力的；锐角的；带尖音符的；（声音）高的，尖的

sentences.c: There is an acute shortage of water.
sentences.cn: 水严重短缺。

sentences.c: Her judgement is acute.
sentences.cn: 她的判断敏锐。

sentences.c: He collapsed from acute renal failure.
sentences.cn: 他的身体因严重的肾衰竭而垮掉了。

name: AD
trans: n. 公元；广告（ad）
n. 广告；促销活动；<非正式>预告片（同 advertisement）
abbr. 优势（advantage）

sentences.c: Rome annexed the Nabatean kingdom in AD 106.
sentences.cn: 罗马帝国于公元106年并吞了纳巴泰王国。

sentences.c: She delivered her lines ad lib.
sentences.cn: 她的台词是即兴的。

sentences.c: The speech was full of ad libs.
sentences.cn: 讲话中满是即兴之词。

name: ad
trans: n. 公元；广告（ad）
n. 广告；促销活动；<非正式>预告片（同 advertisement）
abbr. 优势（advantage）

sentences.c: Rome annexed the Nabatean kingdom in AD 106.
sentences.cn: 罗马帝国于公元106年并吞了纳巴泰王国。

sentences.c: She delivered her lines ad lib.
sentences.cn: 她的台词是即兴的。

sentences.c: The speech was full of ad libs.
sentences.cn: 讲话中满是即兴之词。

name: adapt
trans: v. 适应；调整，使适合；改编；改造，改装

sentences.c: It's amazing how soon you adapt.
sentences.cn: 你这么快就适应了，真是令人惊奇。

sentences.c: It's amazing how quickly people adapt.
sentences.cn: 人适应环境的速度之快真是惊人。

sentences.c: We have had to adapt quickly to the new system.
sentences.cn: 我们不得不迅速适应新制度。

name: adaptation
trans: n. 改编本，改写本；适应，改变；适应（性），适应力；适应性变化

sentences.c: This recipe is an adaptation of an old favourite.
sentences.cn: 这个食谱是一个传统名食谱的改编。

sentences.c: Most living creatures are capable of adaptation when compelled to do so.
sentences.cn: 大多数生物在为情势所迫时都能适应。

sentences.c: Branagh won two awards for his screen adaptation of Shakespeare's Henry the Fifth.
sentences.cn: 布拉纳因他对莎士比亚的《亨利五世》的荧幕改编而获了两次奖。

name: add
trans: v. 添加，掺入；（使）相加，加；增加；增添（某种特性）；把……计算在内，包括；补充说，继续说
abbr. 注意力缺陷障碍，多动症（ADD）

sentences.c: Add up all the money I owe you.
sentences.cn: 把我欠你的钱全部加起来。

sentences.c: If your soil is very acidic, add lime.
sentences.cn: 如果你的土壤酸性很强，就加点石灰。

sentences.c: Add more water until the dough is workable.
sentences.cn: 往面团里再加点儿水，直到能揉成形为止。

name: addicted
trans: adj. （吸毒）成瘾的，上瘾的；入迷的，着迷的
v. 使上瘾，使沉迷（addict 的过去式和过去分词形式）

sentences.c: People that are addicted to drugs get, er, help from the government one way or another.
sentences.cn: 那些吸毒上瘾的人，呃，通过某种方式获得政府的帮助。

sentences.c: She had become addicted to golf.
sentences.cn: 她已经对高尔夫球入迷了。

sentences.c: He's addicted to computer games.
sentences.cn: 他迷上了电脑游戏。

name: addition
trans: n. 增加物，新增人员；增加；加法；（建筑物的）扩建部分

sentences.c: There is, in addition, one further point to make.
sentences.cn: 此外，还有一点要说。

sentences.c: She's ready to learn simple addition and subtraction.
sentences.cn: 她准备学习简单的加法和减法。

sentences.c: In addition to headaches, you may develop stomach ulcers as well.
sentences.cn: 除了头痛，你还可能患上胃溃疡。

name: address
trans: n. 地址，住址；网址；电子邮箱地址；演讲，演说；（电子表格中某个单元格的）位置；<古>（对他人的）谈吐；<古>谦恭（或脉脉含情）的方式；<旧>机敏，迅速；位置存储编码
v. 演说，演讲；处理，设法解决；在（信封、包裹等）上写姓名和地址，致函；<正式> 向……讲话；称呼；<正式>（向某人）提出（陈述、投诉等）；（高尔夫）就位击（球）

sentences.c: What's your email address ?
sentences.cn: 你的电邮地址是什么？

sentences.c: Do you know his address?
sentences.cn: 你知道他的地址吗？

sentences.c: They had no permanent address.
sentences.cn: 他们没有固定的地址。

name: adequate
trans: adj. 足够的，适当的，合乎需要的；（品质）足够好的，令人满意的；（质量）达到要求的，勉强过关的

sentences.c: Make sure that the firm's insurance cover is adequate.
sentences.cn: 要确保该公司的保险保障是足够的。

sentences.c: She didn't give an adequate explanation for being late.
sentences.cn: 她没有给出充分的理由说明迟到的原因。

sentences.c: We cannot guarantee adequate supplies of raw materials.
sentences.cn: 我们不能保证提供充足的原料。

name: adjust
trans: v. 调整，调节；整理（衣服）；适应，习惯；（保险理赔时）理算，评估（损失，损害）

sentences.c: How did you adjust to college life?
sentences.cn: 你是怎么适应大学生活的？

sentences.c: You can adjust the height of the chair.
sentences.cn: 你可以调节椅子的高度。

sentences.c: He has been forced to adjust his schedule.
sentences.cn: 他已被迫调整了日程安排。

name: adjustment
trans: n. 调整，校正；（行为、思想的）调节，适应；调节器

sentences.c: Some adjustment of the lens may be necessary.
sentences.cn: 可能需要调整一下镜头。

sentences.c: Investment is up by 5.7% after adjustment for inflation.
sentences.cn: 投资在通货膨胀调整之后增长了5.7%。

sentences.c: The dynamic of the market demands constant change and adjustment.
sentences.cn: 市场的动力要求有不断的变化和调整。

name: administration
trans: n. 管理，行政；管理部门，行政部门；（某一任期的）政府；执行，监管；（药的）服用，配给；遗产管理，（债务人、其他个人或破产公司的）资产管理

sentences.c: Too much time is spent on administration.
sentences.cn: 太多的时间花在了管理工作上。

sentences.c: He has a Master's in Business Administration.
sentences.cn: 他获得了工商管理硕士学位。

sentences.c: I work in the Sales Administration department.
sentences.cn: 我在销售管理部门工作。

name: admirable
trans: adj. 令人钦佩的，极其出色的

sentences.c: Loyalty was her most admirable quality.
sentences.cn: 忠诚是她最令人钦佩的品质。

sentences.c: Twain was an admirable figure comparable to Abraham Lincoln.
sentences.cn: 吐温是个令人钦佩的人物，可以与亚伯拉罕·林肯相提并论。

sentences.c: He was an admirable chairman.
sentences.cn: 他是位值得尊敬的主席。

name: admire
trans: v. 钦佩，仰慕；欣赏，观赏

sentences.c: I really admire your enthusiasm.
sentences.cn: 我确实钦佩你的热情。

sentences.c: We stopped to admire the scenery.
sentences.cn: 我们中途停下来欣赏一下风景。

sentences.c: I admire his thoroughness.
sentences.cn: 我钦佩他办事认真仔细。

name: admission
trans: n. 承认，供认；允许进入（加入），进入权；录取，录取人数；入场费；入院治疗（检查）；入场人数；入院病人

sentences.c: Admission is by invitation only.
sentences.cn: 凭请柬入场。

sentences.c: The admission price is $8 for adults.
sentences.cn: 入场费成人是$8。

sentences.c: We have knocked 10% off admission prices.
sentences.cn: 我们已将入场票的价格降低了10%。

name: admit
trans: v. （勉强）承认；招认，招供；准许进入（某处）；接纳，接收（入学）；收治，接收入院；承认……有效；容许，为……留有余地

sentences.c: Admit it! You were terrified!
sentences.cn: 承认了吧！你吓坏了！

sentences.c: I must admit I am impressed.
sentences.cn: 我得承认我很佩服。

sentences.c: I must admit I'm completely foxed.
sentences.cn: 我得承认我一点都不懂。

name: adolescence
trans: n. 青春期，青春

sentences.c: No one knows for sure why adolescence is unique to humans.
sentences.cn: 没人确切知道为什么青春期是人类独有的。

sentences.c: The play is set in the dangerous no-man's land between youth and adolescence.
sentences.cn: 该剧定位于少年和青春期之间的危险的中间年龄段。

sentences.c: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
sentences.cn: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

name: adolescent
trans: n. 青少年
adj. 青春期的；不成熟的

sentences.c: Most adolescent problems are temporary.
sentences.cn: 多数青春期的问题都是暂时的。

sentences.c: He was showing off, as is the way with adolescent boys.
sentences.cn: 他在炫耀，青春期的男孩都是这个样子。

sentences.c: A little adolescent rebellion is commonly believed to be healthy.
sentences.cn: 少许青春期叛逆被普遍认为是一个健康的现象。

name: adopt
trans: v. 收养；采取，采纳，接受；正式通过；选定（名字），承袭（风俗）；移居，定居；提名（某人）为候选人；保持（姿势）；<英>（地方当局）承担（道路）维修保养责任

sentences.c: There is little or no incentive to adopt such measures.
sentences.cn: 几乎或根本没有鼓励来采取这样的措施。

sentences.c: There are hundreds of people desperate to adopt a child.
sentences.cn: 有数以百计的人极其渴望收养小孩。

sentences.c: Maybe we should adopt the policy of "don't ask, don't tell."
sentences.cn: 或许我们应该采用“不问不提”的政策。

name: adore
trans: v. 非常喜欢，热爱；爱慕，疼爱；崇拜，崇敬
【名】 （Adore）（法）阿多尔（人名）

sentences.c: I simply adore his music!
sentences.cn: 我简直太喜爱他的音乐了！

sentences.c: How could you not adore him?
sentences.cn: 你能不崇拜他吗？

name: airplane
trans: n. <美>飞机

sentences.c: The airplane had dual controls.
sentences.cn: 这架飞机有两套操纵装置。

sentences.c: They developed a solar airplane.
sentences.cn: 他们开发了一种太阳能飞机。

sentences.c: She fell out of my airplane.
sentences.cn: 她从我的飞机上摔了下来。

name: airport
trans: n. 机场，航空站 （港）；空旅通俗读物

sentences.c: He was fogbound at JFK airport.
sentences.cn: 他因浓雾而被困在肯尼迪机场。

sentences.c: Will you meet me at the airport?
sentences.cn: 你到机场接我好吗？

sentences.c: They arrived late at the airport.
sentences.cn: 他们晚到了机场。

name: airspace
trans: n. 领空，空域；空域使用权；绝缘空气带

sentences.c: Forty minutes later, they left Colombian airspace.
sentences.cn: 40分钟之后，他们离开了哥伦比亚的空域。

sentences.c: The jet entered Chinese airspace without permission.
sentences.cn: 那架喷气式飞机未经允许闯入中国领空。

sentences.c: Controlled airspace is that airspace in which FAA regulations apply.
sentences.cn: 管制空域是指适用 FAA 规定的空域。

name: alarm
trans: n. 警报；警报器；闹钟；惊恐，担忧
v. 使不安，使恐慌；给（门等）安装警报器

sentences.c: An alarm bell went off.
sentences.cn: 警钟响了。

sentences.c: Ann's pulse quickened in alarm.
sentences.cn: 安的脉搏因惊恐而加快了。

sentences.c: The alarm went off at 7 o'clock.
sentences.cn: 闹钟在7点钟响了。

name: album
trans: n. 唱片，专辑；相册，影集，集邮册

sentences.c: Their new album is dynamite.
sentences.cn: 他们的新唱片引起轰动。

sentences.c: I stuck the photos into an album.
sentences.cn: 我把照片贴到相册上。

sentences.c: Their new album is their doomiest.
sentences.cn: 他们的新专辑是他们最失败的作品。

name: alcohol
trans: n. 含酒精饮品，酒；酒精，乙醇；醇

sentences.c: Wine contains about 10% alcohol.
sentences.cn: 葡萄酒含有约10%的酒精。

sentences.c: Alcohol acts quickly on the brain.
sentences.cn: 酒精对大脑迅速产生影响。

sentences.c: The alcohol warmed and relaxed him.
sentences.cn: 这酒使他浑身发暖轻松起来。

name: alcoholic
trans: adj. 酒精的，含酒精的；酒精中毒的，酗酒的；喝酒引起的，由酒精引起的
n. 酗酒者，酒鬼

sentences.c: Alcoholic beverages are served in the hotel lounge.
sentences.cn: 宾馆的休息室供应酒类饮料。

sentences.c: The serving of alcoholic drinks was forbidden after six o'clock.
sentences.cn: 在6点以后供应酒精饮料是被禁止的。

sentences.c: Novello says college students will spend $4.2 billion yearly on alcoholic beverages.
sentences.cn: 诺韦洛说大学生每年会在各种酒精饮料上花费42亿美元。

name: algebra
trans: n. 代数；代数学

sentences.c: At twenty he translated Euler's standard work on algebra into English.
sentences.cn: 20岁时，他把尤勒的权威代数著作译成了英语。

sentences.c: He would allow John slyly to copy his answers to impossibly difficult algebra questions.
sentences.cn: 对于那些特别难的代数题，他允许约翰偷偷抄袭他的答案。

sentences.c: Algebra is not easy for everyone to learn, but it is very useful.
sentences.cn: 代数对每个人来说都不容易学，但它非常有用。

name: alike
trans: adj. 相似的，相像的
adv. 相似地，相同地；两者都，同样地
【名】 （Alike）（美、印）艾立凯（人名）

sentences.c: My sister and I do not look alike.
sentences.cn: 我和我妹妹外貌不相像。

sentences.c: They even dressed alike.
sentences.cn: 他们甚至连穿着都相像。

sentences.c: They tried to treat all their children alike.
sentences.cn: 他们尽量对自己的孩子一视同仁。

name: alive
trans: adj. 活着的；仍然存在的；活跃的，充满活力的；热闹的；尚未失败，仍有成功机会；注意到的

sentences.c: I felt exalted and newly alive.
sentences.cn: 我感到兴高采烈，充满新的活力。

sentences.c: He's still alive, isn't he?
sentences.cn: 他还活着，是吗？

sentences.c: He was buried alive in the earthquake.
sentences.cn: 地震把他活埋了。

name: all
trans: det. 全部；每一个；极度，尽量；无论什么，任何；唯一，仅仅
adj. 全部的；每一个的；任何的；尽可能多的；全然是……的，完全表现出……的；（某一体征）显著突出的
adv. 完全地；各方，各选手；非常，太
pron. 所有，全部；唯一
n. 全部，所有
【名】 （All）（英、美、巴、加）奥尔（人名）

sentences.c: I do all the work and he gets all the glory.
sentences.cn: 活儿都是我干，荣誉都是他得。

sentences.c: It's all sorted.
sentences.cn: 一切都办妥了。

sentences.c: They're all good players, but she's the best of all.
sentences.cn: 他们都是优秀运动员，而她更是其中的佼佼者。

name: allergic
trans: adj. 对……过敏的；过敏引起的，过敏性的；对……极其反感的

sentences.c: I am allergic to cat hair.
sentences.cn: 我对猫毛过敏。

sentences.c: I'm allergic to cats.
sentences.cn: 我对猫过敏。

sentences.c: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
sentences.cn: 坚果可以引起严重的过敏反应。

name: alley
trans: n. 小巷，胡同；（两旁有树木、灌木或石头的）小径；（九柱戏和保龄球等游戏的）球道；<美>双打网球场两边的狭长地带
【名】 （Alley）（英）阿利（人名）

sentences.c: She parked her bike in the alley.
sentences.cn: 她把摩托车停在巷子里。

sentences.c: I dodged back into the alley and waited a minute.
sentences.cn: 我往后一闪，躲进胡同里等了一会儿。

sentences.c: When he saw the police arrive, he bolted down an alley.
sentences.cn: 他看见警察来了，便从小巷逃走了。

name: allocate
trans: v. 分配，分派，划拨

sentences.c: The effect is caused by the way we allocate our attention.
sentences.cn: 这种效应是由我们分配注意力的方式引起的。

sentences.c: The effect is caused by the way we allocate our attention.
sentences.cn: 这种效应是由我们分配注意力的方式引起的。

sentences.c: It helps you allocate proper time for a task and perform the task more efficiently.
sentences.cn: 它能帮助你分配合理的任务时间，并助你更高效地执行任务。

name: allow
trans: v. 允许，准许；使有可能；任凭；<正式>接受，认可；促使；（特地）酌留；承认，同意；让对方得分

sentences.c: We must allow for human error.
sentences.cn: 我们必须考虑到人为的失误。

sentences.c: He won't allow himself to fail.
sentences.cn: 他不容许自己失败。

sentences.c: They wouldn't allow me to smoke.
sentences.cn: 他们不会允许我抽烟。

name: allowance
trans: n. 津贴，补助；限额，定量；折价，折扣；免税额；<美>零花钱；考虑到的事情；体谅，原谅；允许，认可；（赛马）减载量
v. 为（某人）提供津贴；定量供应（物品）

sentences.c: Do you get an allowance for clothing?
sentences.cn: 你有服装补贴吗？

sentences.c: She gets an allowance for taking care of Amy.
sentences.cn: 她照顾艾米是有津贴的。

sentences.c: The budget made allowance for inflation.
sentences.cn: 预算考虑到了通货膨胀。

name: almost
trans: adv. 几乎，差不多

sentences.c: Her English is almost flawless.
sentences.cn: 她的英语几乎无可挑剔。

sentences.c: She answered almost immediately.
sentences.cn: 她几乎立刻就回答了。

sentences.c: They'll eat almost anything.
sentences.cn: 他们几乎什么都吃。

name: alone
trans: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤独的，无依无靠的；唯一的
adv. 独自，单独；独力，单干（地）；单，只；仅仅……就

sentences.c: Exercising alone can be boring.
sentences.cn: 独自一个人锻炼可能会很无聊。

sentences.c: Lions sometimes hunt alone.
sentences.cn: 狮子有时单独猎食。

sentences.c: He dines alone most nights.
sentences.cn: 大多数晚上他都独自进餐。

name: along
trans: prep. 沿着，顺着；靠着……边；在某处
adv. 向前；一起，一道；进行，进展；（前）来，到某处；到相当的程度；传播

sentences.c: We cantered along the beach.
sentences.cn: 我们骑着马沿海滩慢跑。

sentences.c: I'm glad you came along.
sentences.cn: 有你跟我一起来，我很高兴。

sentences.c: The boat chugged slowly along.
sentences.cn: 船突突地缓慢前进。

name: alongside
trans: prep. 在……旁边；沿着……的边；与……一起，与……并肩（工作）；与……相比；与……同等重要的；同时，共存
adv. 在旁边

sentences.c: A police car pulled up alongside us.
sentences.cn: 一辆警车在我们旁边停了下来。

sentences.c: He crossed the street and walked alongside Central Park.
sentences.cn: 他过了马路，然后在中央公园旁边走着。

sentences.c: We tied up alongside the quay.
sentences.cn: 我们把船停靠在码头边上。

name: aloud
trans: adv. 大声地，出声地

sentences.c: She cried aloud in protest.
sentences.cn: 她大声抗议。

sentences.c: He read the poem aloud.
sentences.cn: 他朗读了这首诗。

sentences.c: The teacher listened to the children reading aloud.
sentences.cn: 老师听着孩子们朗读。

name: alphabet
trans: n. 字母表；基本要素；初步，入门

sentences.c: 'B' is the second letter of the alphabet.
sentences.cn: b是字母表的第二个字母。

sentences.c: The modern Russian alphabet has 31 letters.
sentences.cn: 现代俄语字母表有31个字母。

sentences.c: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.
sentences.cn: 英语字母表中，Q在P和R之间。

name: already
trans: adv. 已经，早已；<美，非正式>马上，够了（用于表达不耐烦或气恼）

sentences.c: We've already been introduced.
sentences.cn: 我们已经介绍认识了。

sentences.c: We've already said our goodbyes.
sentences.cn: 我们已经道别了。

sentences.c: She's backpedalled twice already.
sentences.cn: 她已经两次改变主意了。

name: also
trans: adv. 此外，而且；也，同样
conj. 另外，又
【名】 （Also）（罗）阿尔索（人名）

sentences.c: CNN also broadcasts in Europe.
sentences.cn: 美国有线新闻网络也在欧洲进行广播。

sentences.c: The nation also exports beef.
sentences.cn: 该国也出口牛肉。

sentences.c: He also trilled his r's.
sentences.cn: 他发“r”音时，声音也抖动了一下。

name: alternative
trans: n. 可供选择的事物，替代物
adj. 可替代的，备选的；非传统的，另类的；（两者）互不相容的，非此即彼的

sentences.c: There are alternative sources of nutrition to animal meat.
sentences.cn: 有能替代动物肉类的其他营养来源。

sentences.c: There is no viable alternative.
sentences.cn: 没有其他可行的措施。

sentences.c: Do you have an alternative solution?
sentences.cn: 你有没有别的解决办法？

name: although
trans: conj. 虽然，尽管；但是，然而

sentences.c: Although it is tasty, crab is very filling.
sentences.cn: 螃蟹虽然好吃，但很容易让人饱。

sentences.c: Although small, the kitchen is well designed.
sentences.cn: 厨房虽小，但设计巧妙。

sentences.c: Although the sun was shining it wasn't very warm.
sentences.cn: 尽管太阳高照，却不很暖和。

name: altitude
trans: n. 海拔高度；高地；（天体在地平线上的）地平纬度；顶垂线；（等级和地位等的）高级

sentences.c: They were flying at high altitude.
sentences.cn: 他们正在高空飞行。

sentences.c: The plane made a dive to a lower altitude.
sentences.cn: 飞机俯冲到较低高度。

sentences.c: We are flying at an altitude of 6 000 metres.
sentences.cn: 我们的飞行高度是6 000米。

name: altogether
trans: adv. 完全地；总共；总之

sentences.c: I don't altogether agree with you.
sentences.cn: 我不完全同意你的意见。

sentences.c: We have invited fifty people altogether.
sentences.cn: 我们共邀请了五十人。

sentences.c: It was an altogether different situation.
sentences.cn: 这完全是另外一种情况。

name: aluminium
trans: n. 铝

sentences.c: The aluminium body is 12% lighter than if built with steel.
sentences.cn: 用铝制作比用钢制作重量要轻12%。

sentences.c: He had a house there and a dock and a little aluminium boat.
sentences.cn: 他在那儿有一幢房、一个泊位和一条铝艇。

sentences.c: Copper, brass, and aluminium are separated and remelted for reuse.
sentences.cn: 铜、黄铜和铝被分门别类重新熔化以供再利用。

name: always
trans: adv. 总是，每次都是；一直，长久以来；永远；老是，一再；总还有（表示有另一种可能）

sentences.c: She always looks immaculate.
sentences.cn: 她总是打扮得干净利落。

sentences.c: That phone's always ringing.
sentences.cn: 那个电话总是响个不停。

sentences.c: She's always cracking jokes.
sentences.cn: 她总爱说笑话。

name: am
trans: v. 是（be 的第一人称单数现在时）
abbr. 上午（同 a.m.）
abbr. （AM）调幅（Amplitude Modulation）；威尔士国民议会（assembly member）
abbr. （Am.）<书面>美国人（American）
n. （AM）（中、英）安（人名）

sentences.c: I am lonely and I am hurting.
sentences.cn: 我很孤独，也很痛苦。

sentences.c: Luckily, I am a good swimmer.
sentences.cn: 幸好我是个游泳好手。

sentences.c: I am feeling very depressed.
sentences.cn: 我感到很沮丧。

name: a.m.
trans: n. 午前，上午【小写】

name: amateur
trans: n. 业余爱好者；生手，外行
adj. 非专业的，业余爱好的；不熟练的

sentences.c: She was a keen amateur photographer.
sentences.cn: 她是一个痴迷的业余摄影师。

sentences.c: Brian considered Sam a lightweight, a real amateur.
sentences.cn: 布赖恩认为萨姆是个无足轻重的人，是个真正的业余选手。

sentences.c: She also played the viola in some amateur orchestras.
sentences.cn: 她也曾在一些业余管弦乐队拉过中提琴。

name: amaze
trans: v. 使惊奇，使惊愕

sentences.c: You never cease to amaze me!
sentences.cn: 你总能让我感到惊奇！

sentences.c: He never ceases to amaze me.
sentences.cn: 他总让我惊喜不断。

sentences.c: It never ceases to amaze me what some people will do for money.
sentences.cn: 有些人为了钱什么都干得出来，这一直使我惊愕不已。

name: amazing
trans: adj. 惊人的，了不起的；令人诧异的，令人惊愕的；令人高兴的
v. 使惊奇，使惊愕（amaze 的现在分词形式）

sentences.c: She has amazing powers of recall.
sentences.cn: 她有惊人的记忆力。

sentences.c: BTW, the machine is simply amazing.
sentences.cn: 顺便提一句，这台机器简直太了不起了。

sentences.c: I find it amazing that they're still together.
sentences.cn: 他们还在一起，这使我大吃一惊。

name: ambassador ambassadress
trans: n. 大使

name: ambassadress
trans: n. 大使夫人；女大使
n. 大使夫人；女大使

sentences.c: Painting "Maiden" was collected by an ambassadress of UN and participated in a charity activity.
sentences.cn: 年油画《少女》被联和国大使夫人收藏并参加慈善活动。

name: ambiguous
trans: adj. 模棱两可的，有歧义的；不明朗的，不确定的

sentences.c: The wording was deliberately ambiguous.
sentences.cn: 这里的措辞故意模棱两可。

sentences.c: His role has always been ambiguous.
sentences.cn: 他的角色一直不明确。

sentences.c: This agreement is very ambiguous and open to various interpretations.
sentences.cn: 这个协议非常模棱两可，可以有多种解释。

name: ambition
trans: n. 追求的目标，抱负；雄心，野心；干劲
v. 追求，有……野心

sentences.c: It had been her lifelong ambition.
sentences.cn: 这是她终身追求的目标。

sentences.c: He was corrupted by power and ambition.
sentences.cn: 权力与野心使他腐化堕落。

sentences.c: We must fight low expectations because they stultify ambition.
sentences.cn: 我们一定要摆脱较低的期望，因为它们会磨灭我们的志向。

name: ambulance
trans: n. 急救车，救护车
v. 用救护车送（人）

sentences.c: An ambulance drove past.
sentences.cn: 一辆救护车驶了过去。

sentences.c: He screamed for his wife to call an ambulance.
sentences.cn: 他尖叫着，要妻子叫辆救护车来。

sentences.c: When the ambulance had gone, the crowd dissolved.
sentences.cn: 救护车离开后人群便散了。

name: America
trans: n. 美洲（包括北美和南美洲）；美国

sentences.c: We went by ship over to America.
sentences.cn: 我们乘轮船去美国。

sentences.c: She emigrated to America in 1995.
sentences.cn: 她1995年移民美国。

sentences.c: How do you like America?
sentences.cn: 你觉得美国怎么样？

name: American
trans: n. 美国人，美洲人；美国英语
adj. 美国的，美洲的；地道美国式的

sentences.c: I'm not American, I'm Canadian.
sentences.cn: 我不是美国人，我是加拿大人。

sentences.c: He put on an American accent.
sentences.cn: 他假操着一口美国腔。

sentences.c: The American flag was flying.
sentences.cn: 美国国旗飘扬。

name: among
trans: prep. 在……当中，周围是；与……在一起；……之一；在……群体中；为……所共有；彼此间；以及

sentences.c: Bees buzzed lazily among the flowers.
sentences.cn: 蜜蜂在花丛中懒洋洋地嗡嗡叫着。

sentences.c: Among sports superstars she's (the) tops.
sentences.cn: 她在超级体育明星中独占鳌头。

sentences.c: He was among the last to leave.
sentences.cn: 他是最后离开者之一。

name: amount
trans: n. 数量，量；金额，钱数；（感情、质量的）程度
v. 达到，总计（amount to）；等于，意味着（amount to）；发展成，变成（amount to）

sentences.c: We need double the amount we already have.
sentences.cn: 我们需要现有数量的两倍。

sentences.c: The generous amount of garlic adds flavour.
sentences.cn: 大量的蒜会增添滋味。

sentences.c: Only a minute amount is needed.
sentences.cn: 只需很少的一点。

name: ample
trans: adj. 充足的，充裕的；丰满的；宽敞的，巨大的
【名】 （Ample）（西）安普尔（人名）

sentences.c: Ample free parking is available.
sentences.cn: 有宽敞的免费停车场。

sentences.c: There was ample time to get to the airport.
sentences.cn: 有足够的时间到达机场。

sentences.c: The driver had ample time to brake or swerve and avoid the woman.
sentences.cn: 该司机有足够的时间刹车或急转来避让那女子。

name: amuse
trans: v. 逗乐，逗笑；（提供）消遣，（使）娱乐

sentences.c: This will amuse you.
sentences.cn: 这个会逗你笑的。

sentences.c: She suggested several ideas to help Laura amuse the twins.
sentences.cn: 她给劳拉出了一些主意，好逗这对双胞胎开心。

sentences.c: I need distractions. I need to amuse myself so I won't keep thinking about things.
sentences.cn: 我需要娱乐。我需要自我消遣，这样我才不会一直想事情。

name: amusement
trans: n. 开心，娱乐；娱乐活动，娱乐设施

sentences.c: What do you do for amusement round here?
sentences.cn: 你在这儿以什么消遣？

sentences.c: Amusement gleamed in his eyes.
sentences.cn: 他眼睛里流露出愉悦的神情。

sentences.c: Amusement glimmered in his eyes.

trans: vt. 对……进行分析，分解（等于 analyse）

sentences.cn: 我的主要任务是分析人体排泄物。

sentences.cn: 她花了整整一年的时间来追踪和分析他们。

sentences.cn: 他们分析回声，以及波是如何反弹回来的。

name: analysis
trans: n. 分析；化验分析；心理分析，精神分析；分析报告

sentences.cn: 我赞成她对形势的分析。

trans: n. 祖先，祖宗；（动植物）原种；原型，雏形

sentences.cn: 我的祖先是一位游历于乡间的传教士。

name: anchor

sentences.c: We could anchor off the pier.
sentences.cn: 我们可以在码头抛锚。

sentences.c: The ship lay at anchor two miles off the rocky coast.
sentences.cn: 船在离岩岸两英里处抛锚停泊。

sentences.cn: 他们傍晚抛锚停泊。

sentences.cn: 太极拳是一种古老的自卫手段。

sentences.cn: 这房间昏暗、阴冷且安静。

sentences.c: Sara and I read the story and marvelled.
sentences.cn: 我和萨拉读了这个故事后惊叹不已。

name: anecdote
trans: n. 轶事，趣闻；传闻

sentences.c: There is, as Robert Rubin, the treasury secretary, says, a "disjunction" between the mass of business anecdote that points to a leap in productivity and the picture reflected by the statistics.
sentences.cn: 正如美国财长罗伯特·鲁宾所言，在指向生产率飞跃的大量商业轶事与统计数据所反映的情况之间存在着“脱节”。

sentences.c: This research is based on anecdote not fact.
sentences.cn: 这项研究的根据是传闻而非事实。

sentences.c: Pete was telling them an anecdote about their mother.
sentences.cn: 皮特正告诉他们一个关于他们母亲的趣闻轶事。

name: angle

trans: adj. 愤怒的，生气的；狂风暴雨的，波涛汹涌的；红肿的，感染的

name: assessment

sentences.cn: 该委员会改变主意，废除充满争议性的奖金系统。

name: book
trans: n. 书籍 vt.预定
n. 书，书籍；本子，簿册；（长篇作品的）篇，卷，部；装订成册之物；赌局，打赌；账册，账簿
v. 预订，预约；（警方）将……记录在案；（裁判）记名警告
【名】 （Book）（英）布克，（瑞典）博克，（朝）北（人名）

sentences.c: Shoot! I've forgotten my book!
sentences.cn: 倒霉！我忘了带书！

sentences.c: I'm just finishing my book.
sentences.cn: 眼下我正在完成我的一本书。

sentences.c: That's cheating in my book.
sentences.cn: 依我看那是欺骗。

name: bookcase
trans: n. [家具] 书柜，书架

sentences.c: The bookcase is screwed to the wall.
sentences.cn: 书架用螺丝固定在墙上了。

sentences.c: The bookcase fits neatly into the alcove.
sentences.cn: 书架正好放得进壁凹。

sentences.c: The microphone was cunningly concealed in the bookcase.
sentences.cn: 话筒被巧妙地隐藏在书柜里。

name: bookmark
trans: 书签（等于bookmarker）；标记
n. 书签（等于 bookmarker）；标记

sentences.c: Do you want to bookmark this site?
sentences.cn: 你想给这个站点做书签吗？

sentences.c: This makes it extremely simple to save what you find with an electronic bookmark so you can return to it later.
sentences.cn: 用一个电子书签保存找到的内容使以后再次访问变得非常简单。

sentences.c: Provide information about the bookmark and click Save.
sentences.cn: 提供有关书签的信息并单击保存。

name: bookshop
trans: n. 书店

sentences.c: I found a lovely bookshop and bought two of his fairy tale books, The Little Mermaid and The Ugly Duckling.
sentences.cn: 我发现了一家可爱的书店，买了他的两本童话书，《小美人鱼》和《丑小鸭》。

sentences.c: Guanghua Bookshop as a stand-alone bookshop may face a loss, because profits from selling print books are slim and rents in central London are high.
sentences.cn: 光华书店作为一家独立书店可能会面临亏损，因为出售纸质书的利润微薄，而且伦敦市中心的租金也很高。

sentences.c: As he ran down the street with a light heart to the bookshop, he saw a poor German family, the father, mother and three children walking in the cold wind.
sentences.cn: 当他轻松地沿街跑向书店时，他看到一个贫穷的德国家庭，有爸爸、妈妈和三个孩子，在寒风中走着。

name: bookstore
trans: n. 书店（等于 bookshop）

sentences.c: The bookstore opened last year.
sentences.cn: 书店去年开张了。

sentences.c: He stopped at the bookstore.
sentences.cn: 他停在了书店那儿。

sentences.c: The bookstore is now closed.
sentences.cn: 书店现在已经关闭了。

name: boom
trans: n. 繁荣；流行，风靡；隆隆声；吊杆；帆桁；水栅
v. 迅速发展，繁荣；轰鸣，轰响；用低沉的声音说
【名】 （Boom）（英、美、荷、俄、比、德）博姆（人名）

sentences.c: He made a small fortune in the property boom.
sentences.cn: 他在房地产繁荣期发了一小笔财。

sentences.c: Living standards improved rapidly during the post-war boom.
sentences.cn: 在战后那段繁荣昌盛的时期里，生活水平得到了迅速提高。

sentences.c: The technology boom sent share prices into the stratosphere.
sentences.cn: 科技热潮使得股价飙升到极高的水平。

name: boot
trans: n. 靴子；猛踢；（汽车的）行李箱，后备箱；车轮固定夹；解雇；再者，除此之外（to boot）
v. 猛踢；锁住（非法停车的轮子）；启动（电脑）；在车轮上装制动装置；解雇；（使）穿靴
【名】 （Boot）（英、美、荷、加、德、意、俄）布特（人名）

sentences.cn: 他抽起脚猛踢了一下球。

sentences.cn: 计算机无法启动。

sentences.c: The ski had become disconnected from the boot.
sentences.cn: 滑雪板与靴子脱离了。

name: booth
trans: n. 电话亭，投票间；售货棚，摊位；岗亭；（隔开的）小间
【名】 （Booth）（英）布思，（德、瑞典）博特（人名）

sentences.c: He came barreling down the hill and smashed into a phone booth.
sentences.cn: 他沿山坡飞驰下来，撞在了一个电话亭上。

sentences.c: In the next booth he could see an elderly lady, talking volubly.
sentences.cn: 在隔壁的电话亭里，他看见一个上了年纪的妇女在滔滔不绝地说着。

sentences.cn: 我在酒吧入口附近的一个公用电话亭给她打了电话。

trans: 电话亭
电话亭：一个封闭的空间，人们可以在里面站着或坐着打电话。

sentences.c: There is a telephone booth near the cinema.
sentences.cn: 电影院附近有一个电话亭。

sentences.c: There happened to be a telephone booth near the bus stop.
sentences.cn: 正巧有一个电话亭在公共汽车站附近。

sentences.c: So we had a telephone booth used to produce tanks and scrap the idea.
sentences.cn: 因此我们就产生了利用废旧电话亭来制作水族缸的想法。

name: border
trans: n. 国境，边界；镶边，包边；狭长花坛，花带
v. 接壤，毗邻；环绕，沿……的边缘；近似，相像
【名】 （Border）（英）博德（人名）

sentences.c: Guards have been posted along the border.
sentences.cn: 边界上已部署了边防岗哨。

sentences.c: They fled across the border.
sentences.cn: 他们越过边界逃走了。

sentences.c: Jordan reopened its border with Iraq.
sentences.cn: 约旦重新开放了与伊拉克的边界。

name: bored
trans: adj. 无聊的，厌倦的；（枪）有特定口径的

sentences.cn: 这些妇女们感到愤怒和厌烦。

sentences.cn: 男孩子们渐渐变得厌烦起来。

sentences.c: Well, at least they weren't bored.

name: boring
trans: adj. 令人厌烦的；乏味的，无趣的，无聊的
n. 钻孔，扩洞；钻成的孔，扩大的洞

sentences.cn: 她觉得自己的工作很无聊。

sentences.c: She finds it boring at home.

name: born

sentences.c: She was born in April.
sentences.cn: 她是四月出生的。

name: borrow
trans: v. 借，借入；（向……）借贷；采用，借用；（演算减法时）借（位）

sentences.cn: 我可以借用你的钢笔吗？

sentences.cn: 20万个真菌标本被保存在科马罗夫植物研究所。

name: bottle

trans: adj. 中央的，中心的；起支配作用的，有控制力的；最重要的，主要的
n. <美，非正式>活动中心

sentences.c: The house has gas-fired central heating.
sentences.cn: 这所房子有燃气中央供暖系统。

sentences.c: He kept turning the central heating down.
sentences.cn: 他不断地调低中央暖气系统的温度。

sentences.c: I am thinking of installing central heating.
sentences.cn: 我在考虑安装中央供暖系统。

name: centre
trans: n. （地理位置）中间，中心点；（机构，组织）活动中心；关注点，焦点；中间派，中间立场；中锋
v. 把……放在中央；（使）以……为中心，（使）注意力集中于；（使）主要发生在，（使）集中于
【名】 （Centre）（澳、印、肯尼亚）森特尔（人名）

sentences.c: Tokyo is a major financial centre.
sentences.cn: 东京是主要的金融中心。

sentences.c: Our offices are in the city centre.
sentences.cn: 我们的办公室位于市中心。

sentences.c: The shopping centre is not roofed over.
sentences.cn: 购物中心是露天的。

name: center
trans: n. （地理位置）中间，中心点；（机构，组织）活动中心；关注点，焦点；中间派，中间立场；中锋
v. 把……放在中央；（使）以……为中心，（使）注意力集中于；（使）主要发生在，（使）集中于
n. （Center）森特（人名）

sentences.c: The band's performance that night at the Seattle Center Coliseum was a letdown.
sentences.cn: 该乐队当晚在西雅图中心体育馆的表演令人大失所望。

sentences.c: The recycling center works well.
sentences.cn: 这个回收中心运转良好。

sentences.c: Any shopping center is fine.
sentences.cn: 任何购物中心都可以。

name: century
trans: n. 世纪；一百年；（板球）一百分

sentences.c: A new century was dawning.
sentences.cn: 一个新的世纪开始了。

sentences.c: It was built at the turn of the century.
sentences.cn: 这是在世纪之交修建的。

sentences.c: DAB is the radio system of the 21st century.
sentences.cn: 数字音频广播是21世纪的广播系统。

name: ceremony
trans: n. 仪式，典礼；礼节，礼仪，客套

sentences.c: I hate all this pomp and ceremony.
sentences.cn: 我讨厌所有这些排场和仪式。

sentences.c: He left halfway through the ceremony.
sentences.cn: 他在仪式进行到一半时离开了。

sentences.c: The ceremony went off without a hitch.
sentences.cn: 仪式进行得很顺利。

name: certain
trans: adj. 必然的，必定的；确定的，无疑的；某个，特定的；某位，一位叫……的；一定程度上的，有点儿
pron. 某些，某几个
n. （Certain）（美、法）塞尔坦（人名）

sentences.c: That's true, to a certain extent.
sentences.cn: 在一定程度上的确如此。

sentences.c: Are you absolutely certain about this?
sentences.cn: 你对这事绝对确信无疑吗？

sentences.c: Certain people might disagree with this.
sentences.cn: 某些人对这事可能不会赞同。

name: certainly
trans: adv. 无疑，确定；当然，行（用于回答）

sentences.c: I certainly don't deal drugs.
sentences.cn: 我当然不做毒品生意。

sentences.c: She certainly knows what's what.
sentences.cn: 她当然知道轻重缓急。

sentences.c: I'm certainly not scared of him.
sentences.cn: 我当然不怕他。

name: certificate
trans: n. 证明，证书；文凭，成绩合格证书；电影放映许可证
v. 发证书给……，用证书证明

sentences.c: He was shown a photocopy of the certificate.
sentences.cn: 给他看了证书的复印件。

sentences.c: She's going in for the Cambridge First Certificate.
sentences.cn: 她打算参加剑桥初级证书考试。

sentences.c: She didn't like the course but she stuck it out to get the certificate.
sentences.cn: 她并不喜欢这门课，但为了拿证书还是耐着性子学完了。

name: chain
trans: n. 链，链条；一连串，一系列；连锁商店；镣铐；测链；连环式（指一群房主先售后购的置屋方式）；<文>约束，束缚
v. 用锁链拴住；拘禁，束缚

sentences.c: The mayor wore his chain of office.
sentences.cn: 市长佩戴着标志他职务的链徽。

sentences.c: His open shirt revealed a fat gold chain.
sentences.cn: 他敞开的衬衣里露出一条粗大的金链子。

sentences.c: She had strung the shells on a silver chain.
sentences.cn: 她把贝壳串在一条银链子上。

name: chain store
trans: 连锁店【空格符号】
连锁店：一种拥有相同所有权并销售相同商品线的众多零售店之一。

sentences.c: Target, a chain store, ordered $2m worth, then quadrupled the order.
sentences.cn: 连锁商店Target订购了200万美元的蜡烛，随后又将订单扩大了4倍。

sentences.c: Said the Master, "If you fear the owner of the chain store, you will hate him.
sentences.cn: 大哲道，“如果你害怕连锁店的拥有者，那么仇恨将让你一无所得”。 “我该怎么办呢？”

sentences.c: It's a chain store, so you will be able to change the shirt in your town if it does not fit.
sentences.cn: 这是连锁店，你的衬衫不合身，可以到你所在的城镇去换。

name: chair
trans: n. 椅子；主席，委员长；电椅；大学教授的职位
v. 主席，主持；用椅子把某人高高抬起；使……入座；使就任要职
【名】 （Chair）（法）谢尔 （人名）

sentences.c: She jumped down off the chair.
sentences.cn: 她跳下椅子。

sentences.c: Emily edged her chair forward.
sentences.cn: 埃米莉把椅子慢慢地向前挪动。

sentences.c: Helen sat upright in her chair.
sentences.cn: 海伦笔直地坐在椅子上。

name: chairman
trans: n. （尤指男性）主席，（委员会或组织的）负责人；（公司）总裁，（组织）主席；会议主持人，大会主席；<史>轿夫；（自1949年）中国共产党主席（Chairman）
v. 主持，掌管

sentences.c: He was an admirable chairman.
sentences.cn: 他是位值得尊敬的主席。

sentences.c: I propose Tom Ellis for chairman.
sentences.cn: 我提名汤姆•埃利斯做主席。

sentences.c: As chairman, I must remain impartial.
sentences.cn: 作为主席，我必须保持中立。

name: chairwoman
trans: n. 女主席；女议长

sentences.c: The chairwoman is up against the greatest challenge to her position.
sentences.cn: 女主席面临她职位的最大挑战。

sentences.c: Primakov was in Japan meeting with the chairwoman of the Socialist Party there.
sentences.cn: 普里马科夫正在日本和那里的社会党女主席会面。

sentences.c: She is the chairwoman of the department of human genetics at the University of Chicago.
sentences.cn: 她是芝加哥大学人类遗传学系的系主任。

name: chalk
trans: n. 白垩；粉笔；白垩地层；用粉笔划的记号
v. 用粉笔写（或画）；用粉笔做记号；用白垩粉擦（桌球杆等）；<英>把（酒钱）记于（某人）账上；获（胜），得（分）；变成白垩状
【名】 （Chalk）（美、英、加）乔克（人名）

sentences.c: You may chalk it on the wall.
sentences.cn: 你可以用粉笔把它记在墙上。

sentences.c: It's not over yet—not by a long chalk.
sentences.cn: 这事还没有了结—远远没有。

sentences.c: We can chalk that win up to a lot of luck.
sentences.cn: 我们可以把那次胜利归因于好运十足。

name: challenge
trans: n. 挑战，难题；挑战书，比赛邀请；质疑，质询；喝停盘查
v. 挑战，向……下战书；质疑，拒绝接受；盘问，查问；考验

sentences.c: Bill was stimulated by the challenge.
sentences.cn: 比尔受到该挑战的激励。

sentences.c: She beat off a challenge to her leadership.
sentences.cn: 她战胜了对她的领导地位的挑战。

sentences.c: I hope that he proves equal to the challenge.
sentences.cn: 我希望他最后能应付这一挑战。

name: challenging
trans: adj. 富于挑战性的，困难而有趣的；挑衅的，不赞同的
v. 挑战，向……下战书；质疑，拒绝接受；考验（challenge 的现在分词形式）

sentences.c: She does not like anyone challenging her authority.
sentences.cn: 她不喜欢任何人挑战她的权威。

sentences.c: Mike found a challenging job as a computer programmer.
sentences.cn: 迈克找到了一份富有挑战性的工作——当电脑程序师。

sentences.c: Building a home from scratch can be both exciting and challenging.
sentences.cn: 白手起家既激动人心又具有挑战性。

name: champion
trans: n. 冠军，第一名；拥护者，斗士
v. 捍卫，拥护，支持
adj. <英，非正式>极好的；冠军的，得一等奖的
【名】 （Champion）（英）钱皮恩，（法）尚皮翁（人名）

sentences.c: Kasparov became world champion.
sentences.cn: 卡斯帕罗夫成了世界冠军。

sentences.c: He defeated the champion in three sets.
sentences.cn: 他三盘击败了冠军。

sentences.c: Tim Powell is a former champion powerboat racer.
sentences.cn: 蒂姆·鲍威尔曾是汽艇比赛的冠军。

name: chance
trans: n. 机会，时机；可能性；危险，冒险；运气，偶然
v. 偶然，碰巧；冒险做
adj. 偶然的，碰巧的
【名】 （Chance）（英）钱斯（人名）

sentences.c: Everyone has a chance to win.
sentences.cn: 每个人都有机会赢。

sentences.c: It was a chance to start afresh.
sentences.cn: 这是个重新开始的机会。

sentences.c: We have a real chance of success.
sentences.cn: 我们确实有获得成功的机会。

name: changeable
trans: adj. 可改变的，可被改变的；变化无常的

sentences.c: The weather is very changeable at this time of year.
sentences.cn: 年年在这个时候天气都变化无常。

sentences.c: These feelings are changeable, they said.
sentences.cn: 他们说，这些感觉是可以改变的。

sentences.c: The weather of this island country is so changeable that the weather report is rarely correct.
sentences.cn: 这个岛国的天气变化无常，天气预报很少有准确的时候。

name: change
trans: v. 改变，变化；更换，替换；换乘；兑换，找零；交换，互换
n. 变化，变革；找回的钱，零钱；换乘；替代物，替换衣物；全新体验；转成新月；钟乐敲打的一种套路

sentences.c: Leaves change colour in autumn.
sentences.cn: 树叶在秋天改变颜色。

sentences.c: Can we change seats?
sentences.cn: 咱们可以交换一下座位吗？

sentences.c: A change in the money supply brings a corresponding change in expenditure.
sentences.cn: 货币供应量的改变随即引起支出的相应改变。

name: channel
trans: n. 频道，电视频道；管道，通道，航道；渠道，手段；沟渠，沟槽；河床；海峡；信道；电子沟道；输液道
v. 引导，把……用于；输送，传送；通灵；努力赶上，受启发；形成凹槽
【名】 （Channel）（美）沙内乐（人名）

sentences.c: Here the river is confined in a narrow channel.
sentences.cn: 这条河在这里流入狭窄的河床。

sentences.c: The programme's on Channel 4.
sentences.cn: 这个节目在4频道。

sentences.c: I hope Channel 4 doesn't bleep it out.
sentences.cn: 我希望第4频道别盖过这段话。

name: chant
trans: v. 反复唱，反复呼喊；唱圣歌，诵经文
n. 反复喊的话，反复唱的调子；圣歌，颂歌
【名】 （Chant）（英）钱特（人名）

sentences.c: Let's learn the chant.
sentences.cn: 让我们学唱圣歌吧。

sentences.c: "I will chant," he said.
sentences.cn: ”我就唱吧。“他说。

sentences.c: Listen and chant again.
sentences.cn: 听并再唱一遍。

name: chaos
trans: n. 混乱，无秩序状态；混沌
【名】 （Chaos）（西）查奥斯（人名）

sentences.c: He was ultimately overthrown and the country descended into chaos.
sentences.cn: 他最终被推翻，国家陷入了混乱。

sentences.c: That's a sure recipe for destroying the economy and creating chaos.
sentences.cn: 那是一个摧毁经济、制造混乱的注定因素。

sentences.c: The world's first transatlantic balloon race ended in chaos last night.
sentences.cn: 世界首次横渡大西洋的气球比赛昨晚在混乱中结束了。

name: character
trans: n. 性格，品质；特色，特征；人物，角色；勇气，毅力；某种人，古怪有趣的人；（书写或印刷）符号，文字，字体；名誉，名声
v. <古>刻，写；描述；使具有特征
【名】 （Character）（英）克拉克特（人名）

sentences.c: She's a good judge of character.
sentences.cn: 她很善于鉴定别人的性格。

sentences.c: I'm a pretty good judge of character.
sentences.cn: 我非常善于判别性格。

sentences.c: He's no longer a depressive character.
sentences.cn: 他不再是一个抑郁的人物。

name: characteristic
trans: n. 特征，特点，特色
adj. 独特的，典型的

sentences.c: She spoke with characteristic enthusiasm.
sentences.cn: 她说话带着特有的热情。

sentences.c: He replied with characteristic insouciance: "So what?"
sentences.cn: 他用特有的漫不经心的口吻答道：“那又怎么样？”

sentences.c: The main characteristic of the strike has been its longevity.
sentences.cn: 这次罢工的主要特点是持续时间长。

name: charge
trans: v. 充电；使……承担责任，赋予……责任；控告，指控；（公开）指责，责备；进攻，冲锋；把……记在账上；要价，收费（金额）；<旧>给（枪炮）装弹；斟满（杯子）
n. 电量，电荷；炸药量；掌管，照管；费用，价钱；控告，指控；（书面或口头的）指责，批评；需要照管的人；命令，指示；（人或动物的）猛攻，冲锋；<美，非正式>快感，刺激；感召力，感染力；负载
【名】 （Charge）（英）查奇，（法）沙尔热（人名）

sentences.c: She left her assistant in charge.
sentences.cn: 她委托助手来负责。

sentences.c: We can charge $50 a pop.
sentences.cn: 我们可以每个收费50元。

sentences.c: If I were in charge...
sentences.cn: 假若由我负责…

name: chapter
trans: n. 章，回，篇；阶段，时期；分会，分部；议会法案；一系列，一连串（a chapter of）；全体教士；宗教团体理事会
v. 把……分成章节

sentences.c: I've just finished Chapter 3.
sentences.cn: 我刚完成第3章。

sentences.c: I read as far as the third chapter.
sentences.cn: 我读到了第三章。

sentences.c: Each chapter begins with a quotation.
sentences.cn: 每一章的开头都有一条引语。

name: chart
trans: n. 图表，曲线图；海图，星位图；排行榜
v. 绘制；记录，跟踪；制定（行动计划）；进榜，上榜
【名】 （Chart）（泰）察（人名）

sentences.c: He copied the chart from a book.
sentences.cn: 他从书上复制了表格。

sentences.c: Each colour on the chart represents a different department.
sentences.cn: 图表中的每一种颜色都代表一个不同的部门。

sentences.c: A chart on the reverse of this letter highlights your savings.
sentences.cn: 这封信背面的图表着重写明了你的存款情况。

name: chat
trans: v. 闲聊，聊天
n. 闲聊，聊天；鸣禽
【名】 （Chat）（英、美、泰）沙（人名）

sentences.c: I just called in for a chat.
sentences.cn: 我只是来聊聊天。

sentences.c: I had a long chat with her.
sentences.cn: 我和她闲聊了很久。

sentences.c: I was just phoning up for a chat.
sentences.cn: 我只是打电话聊聊天。

name: cheap
trans: adj. 便宜的，廉价的；价低质劣的；小气的，吝啬的；卑劣的，可耻的；无足轻重的；简单的，容易获取的
adv. 低价地，便宜地

sentences.c: It wasn't cheap. Anything but.
sentences.cn: 它不便宜。绝对不。

sentences.c: The meal was amazingly cheap.
sentences.cn: 这餐饭便宜得出奇。

sentences.c: The hotel was anything but cheap.
sentences.cn: 这家旅馆根本不便宜。

name: cheat
trans: v. 欺骗，行骗；侥幸逃脱，逃避；作弊；对配偶（或伴侣）不忠
n. 骗子，作弊者；欺骗手段，欺诈行为；秘技，作弊软件

sentences.c: He was a liar and a cheat.
sentences.cn: 他是一个说谎的人，一个骗子。

sentences.c: He's a fraud and a cheat.
sentences.cn: 他是一个骗子。

sentences.c: It is just not credible that she would cheat.
sentences.cn: 她会行骗简直难以置信。

name: check
trans: v. 检查，核对；查看，查询；克制，抑制；存放，寄放；托运；在……上打钩；将（对方的）军
n. 检查，核对；制止（手段），抑制（手段）；结账单；支票（=cheque）；方格图案；衣帽寄存处；寄存凭证；钩号；（国际象棋）将军
【名】 （Check）（英）切克（人名）

sentences.c: Check whether a fuse has blown.
sentences.cn: 检查一下保险丝是否烧断了。

sentences.c: Could you give the tyres a check?
sentences.cn: 你能检查一下轮胎吗？

sentences.c: Check that all the details are correct.
sentences.cn: 检查所有这些细节是否准确无误。

name: cheek
trans: n. 脸颊，面颊；厚颜无耻，放肆；半边屁股
v. 对……无礼，对……不懂规矩
【名】 （Cheek）（英）奇克（人名）

sentences.c: The leaves brushed her cheek.
sentences.cn: 叶子轻拂她的面颊。

sentences.c: The bullet grazed his cheek.
sentences.cn: 子弹从他的脸颊擦过。

sentences.c: He touched her cheek familiarly.
sentences.cn: 他亲昵地碰了碰她的面颊。

name: cheer
trans: n. 欢呼声，喝彩声；加油口号，加油歌；欢快，愉快的情绪
v. 欢呼，喝彩；鼓励，鼓舞
【名】 （Cheer）（英、美、加、澳）舍尔（人名）

sentences.c: I think he misses her terribly. You might cheer him up.
sentences.cn: 我觉得他太想念她了。你也许能使他振作起来。

sentences.c: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
sentences.cn: 上校被这些人们报以一阵响亮的欢呼。

sentences.c: A great cheer went up from the crowd.
sentences.cn: 观众爆发出一阵热烈的欢呼声。

name: Cheer up
trans: 振作起来！提起精神！
使高兴起来：使（某人）更加快乐。
振作起来：变得更加快乐。
使更加愉快：使（某物）更加愉快或宜人。

sentences.c: Oh, don't be so childish! Cheer up!
sentences.cn: 哎呀，别这么孩子气！振作起来！

sentences.c: Cheer up, Becky, and let's go on trying.
sentences.cn: 振作起来，贝基，我们去试试。

sentences.c: Bright curtains can cheer up a dull room.

name: cheerful

sentences.c: In every moment and every circumstance, you can choose to have fuller, richer life by setting a clear intention.
sentences.cn: 在任何时刻、在任何情况下，你都可以通过设定一个明确的目标来选择更充实、更丰富的生活。

sentences.c: It is their sensitive response to human circumstance that accounts for the persistence of certain universal ideas.
sentences.cn: 他们对人类环境的敏感反应解释了某些普遍观点的持久性。

name: circus
trans: n. 马戏团，马戏演员；马戏表演；乱哄哄的人群，热闹的场面；圆形广场，环形交叉口；（古罗马）露天圆形竞技场

sentences.c: My dad took me to the circus.
sentences.cn: 我爸爸带我去看马戏。

sentences.c: We took the children to the circus.
sentences.cn: 我们带孩子去看了马戏表演。

sentences.c: My real ambition was to work in a circus.
sentences.cn: 我真正的理想是去马戏团工作。

name: citizen
trans: n. 市民，城镇居民；公民，国民

sentences.c: She became a US citizen.
sentences.cn: 她成了美国公民。

sentences.c: She's Italian by birth but is now an Australian citizen.
sentences.cn: 她生于意大利，但现在是澳大利亚公民。

sentences.c: I don't appreciate being treated like a second-class citizen.
sentences.cn: 我不愿被人当作二等公民。

name: city
trans: n. 城市
n. 城市，都市；市民，全市居民；市政府；<非正式>充满……的地方；<英>伦敦金融、商业区；<英>（国王或女王授权的）特许市；<美>（由州政府划定市界并授予特权的）特权市

sentences.c: The city is full of diversions.
sentences.cn: 城市里各种娱乐活动比比皆是。

sentences.c: They shelled the city all night.
sentences.cn: 他们整夜炮轰那座城市。

sentences.c: The city is under enemy control.
sentences.cn: 那座城市现处于敌人的控制之下。

name: civil
trans: adj. 公民的，国民的，国内的；平民的，民用的；文明的，有礼貌的；民法的（非刑法的），民事的；习俗规定的，历法规定的
【名】 （Civil）（土）吉维尔，（法）西维尔（人名）

sentences.c: We cannot take sides in a civil war.
sentences.cn: 内战中，我们不能支持任何一方。

sentences.c: The prospect of civil war is very real.
sentences.cn: 内战爆发的可能性确实存在。

sentences.c: The threat of renewed civil war looms ahead.
sentences.cn: 新一轮内战的威胁在逼近。

name: civilian
trans: n. 平民，百姓（区别于军、警）
adj. 平民的，民用的

sentences.c: A civilian was killed by a stray bullet.
sentences.cn: 一个平民被流弹打死。

sentences.c: They bombed military and civilian targets.
sentences.cn: 他们轰炸了军事和民用目标。

sentences.c: His supporters want a clean-up of civilian corruption.
sentences.cn: 他的支持者们想要一场对民间腐败的大整顿。

name: civilization
trans: n. 文明；文明社会，文明国家；人类社会；舒适的生活环境；教化，开化

sentences.c: Civilization is on the brink of apocalypse.
sentences.cn: 文明已濒临毁灭的边缘。

sentences.c: I finally reached what we laughingly call civilization.
sentences.cn: 我终于到了我们戏称为文明之地的地方。

sentences.c: Environmental damage threatens the whole of civilization.
sentences.cn: 环境的破坏威胁着整个文明世界。

name: clap
trans: v. 拍手，鼓掌；快速（或用力）放置；轻拍（背或肩膀）；使……砰然相击；（突然）把……关进监狱
n. 鼓掌，拍手；砰然巨响，霹雳声；（友好的）用手轻拍；<非正式>淋病
【名】 （Clap）（西、英）克拉普（人名）

sentences.c: Let's clap hands for Tom.
sentences.cn: 让我们为汤姆鼓掌祝贺。

sentences.c: You can clap your hands.
sentences.cn: 你可以拍拍你的手。

sentences.c: I often clap my hands.
sentences.cn: 我经常拍手。

name: clarify
trans: v. 澄清，阐明；（通过加热）使净化，使纯净

sentences.c: Thank you for writing and allowing me to clarify the present position.
sentences.cn: 谢谢你来信并允许我澄清目前的状况。

sentences.c: I hope you could clarify a few things for me.
sentences.cn: 我希望你能帮我澄清几件事。

sentences.c: Mr. Wang wondered about her response, and just to clarify, he asked her another question.
sentences.cn: 王先生想知道她的回答，只是想澄清一下，他又问了她一个问题。

name: class
trans: n. 班级；（一节）课，上课时间；（某一科目的）课程；阶级，阶层；等级划分，等级制度；（货物、服务或人的）等级，类别；（飞机、火车等的）舱位等级，车厢等级；品味；同届毕业生；<英>（英国大学的）学位等级；（生物）（植物或动物分类的）纲；（比赛的）组别
v. 把……归类，把……看作；把……编入某一班级；属于……类（或等级），被列为某类（或某级）
adj. <非正式>优秀的，出色的
【名】 （Class）（英、德）克拉斯（人名）

sentences.c: He's always cutting class.
sentences.cn: 他总是旷课。

sentences.c: The class reassembled after lunch.
sentences.cn: 午饭后，全班同学又集合起来。

sentences.c: The food was first-class.
sentences.cn: 这些食物是一流的。

name: classic
trans: adj. 典型的，有代表性的；一流的，经典的；古朴的，典雅的；<非正式>糟糕的，讨厌的
n. 经典作品，杰作；杰出的事物，典范；传统活动，传统项目

sentences.c: The novel may become a modern classic.
sentences.cn: 这部小说可能会成为现代名著。

sentences.c: The book is now recognized as a classic.
sentences.cn: 这本书现在是一部公认的经典著作。

sentences.c: Hers was a classic tale of rags to riches.
sentences.cn: 她的经历是从赤贫到富有的一个典型例子。

name: classical
trans: adj. 经典的，传统的；和古希腊与古罗马文化相关的；（音乐）古典的；文科的，人文科学的；典型的，有代表性的；相对论和量子力学理论前的概念、理论的，古典力学的

sentences.c: There is classical music playing in the background.
sentences.cn: 背景中正在播放古典音乐。

sentences.c: Most classical music sends me to sleep.
sentences.cn: 大多数古典音乐都会让我睡着。

sentences.c: 'Swan Lake' is one of the great classical ballets.
sentences.cn: 《天鹅湖》是一部伟大的古典芭蕾舞剧。

name: classify
trans: v. 把……分类，把……分级；把（信息）归入保密级别

sentences.c: Classify them by branch, region, and year.
sentences.cn: 将它们按部门、地区和年份分类。

sentences.c: Thing is that it's very difficult to classify.
sentences.cn: 问题是很难进行分类。

sentences.c: This is true regardless of how we classify the service.
sentences.cn: 无论我们如何对服务进行分类，这都是真的。

name: classmate
trans: n. 同班同学

sentences.c: She felt like a fifth-grader who had snitched on a classmate.
sentences.cn: 她觉得自己就像个打同学小报告的小学五年级学生。

sentences.c: My classmate has many notebooks.
sentences.cn: 我同学有许多本子。

sentences.c: This is my classmate, Andy.
sentences.cn: 安迪，这是我同学。

name: classroom
trans: n. 教室

sentences.c: She'd sent him outside the classroom.
sentences.cn: 她叫他到教室外面去。

sentences.c: The classroom teacher must be sensitive to a child's needs.
sentences.cn: 课堂教师必须理解孩子的需求。

sentences.c: The corner of the classroom was damp where the roof had leaked.
sentences.cn: 教室漏雨的一角是湿的。

name: claw
trans: n. （动物的）爪，爪子；（水生有壳动物的）螯，钳；爪形器具，钳形工具
v. （用爪）撕，抓；挠痒；（帆船）迎风而行

sentences.c: It has three pairs of legs, each ending in a large claw.
sentences.cn: 它有3对腿，每条腿的末端都有一个大爪子。

sentences.c: An iron claw gripped his shoulder.
sentences.cn: 一只铁爪抓住了他的肩膀。

sentences.c: Waiter, this lobster has only one claw.
sentences.cn: 服务员，这个龙虾只有一只爪。

name: clay
trans: n. 黏土，陶土；（网球场的）硬固泥地，红土网球场；<文>肉体；似黏土的东西；黄棕翼欧洲蛾
v. 用黏土处理
【名】 （Clay）（英、法、西、意、葡）克莱（人名）

sentences.c: Clay is a plastic substance.
sentences.cn: 黏土是可塑物质。

sentences.c: The tiles are made of clay.
sentences.cn: 这些砖是用陶土制成的。

sentences.c: She fashioned a pot from the clay.
sentences.cn: 她用黏土制成一个罐。

name: clean
trans: adj. 洁净的，干净的；讲卫生的，爱干净的；无有害物的，无污染的；清醇的，清新的；无污点的，清白的；公正的，遵守规则的；不私藏违禁品的；没吸毒的，没喝酒的；纯洁的，正派的；文明的，无色情的；平滑的，平整的；迅速彻底的；（行动）干净利落的；空白的，未写过的；（文件）无错误的；（木材）无树节的
v. （使）清洁，清理；变干净；清扫，做清洁工；干洗；（烹饪前）清除（动物）内脏
n. 清洁，清扫，打扫
adv. 彻底地，完全地；干净地，纯洁地
【名】 （Clean）（英）克林（人名）

sentences.c: Cats are very clean animals.
sentences.cn: 猫是颇爱干净的动物。

sentences.c: Her house is scrupulously clean.
sentences.cn: 她的家干干净净，纤尘不染。

sentences.c: Scrub the vegetables clean.
sentences.cn: 把蔬菜刷洗干净。

name: cleaner
trans: n. 清洁工人；清洁剂，去污剂；清洁器，清洁设备；干洗店（the cleaner's/cleaners）
adj. 更清洁的，更干净的（clean 的比较级形式）

sentences.c: He was a window cleaner.
sentences.cn: 他是一名窗户清洁工。

sentences.c: We placed an advertisement for a cleaner in the local paper.
sentences.cn: 我们在当地报纸上登了广告，招一名清洁工。

sentences.c: This new kitchen cleaner is formulated to cut through grease and dirt.
sentences.cn: 这种新的厨房清洁剂能去除油渍和污垢。

name: clear
trans: adj. 易懂的，明白的；明显的，明确的；完全了解的，清楚的；透明的，清澈的；易看清的，听得清的；（颜色）明亮的，鲜明的；（皮肤）光洁的；没有问题的，健康的；晴朗的；畅通的，无阻碍的；（时间）空闲的；完整的；问心无愧的，清白的；头脑清醒的，思维敏锐的；（比分）领先的；未碰触的，悬离的；摆脱掉（不愉快事物）的；（钱款）净得的，纯收入的；发音清晰的
v. 清除，清理；恢复畅通，不再受阻；证明……无罪；批准，许可；准许……入境（出境）；（使）不再困惑，（使）变清醒；获利，净赚；清偿（债务）；兑现（支票）；（天气）变晴朗；（液体）变清澈；（视力）变清晰；（烟雾等）开始消失；（皮肤）变光滑，变健康；（表情）放松，舒展；使离开，清场；穿过，越过；解决，成功地处理；做完（所有工作）；踢出解围球
adv. <美>一直；离开，不靠近；清除了地，理清了地；全地，整地，满地，足地；清楚地，清晰地
n. 清白的，无罪的（in the clear）；不再困难的，已脱险的（in the clear）；清除；空隙
【名】 （Clear）（英）克利尔（人名）

sentences.c: The photo wasn't very clear.
sentences.cn: 这张照片不太清晰。

sentences.c: She made her objections clear.
sentences.cn: 她明确表示反对。

sentences.c: The clear blue sea beckoned.
sentences.cn: 清澈蔚蓝的大海令人向往。

name: clearly
trans: adv. 清楚地，清晰地；毫无疑问，显然；明智地，清醒地

sentences.c: My remarks clearly nettled her.
sentences.cn: 我的话显然惹恼了她。

sentences.c: Reforms are clearly in order.
sentences.cn: 改革显然是顺理成章的。

sentences.c: The question clearly angered him.
sentences.cn: 这个问题显然激怒了他。

name: clerk
trans: n. 办事员，职员；售货员，店员；（宾馆）接待员；（法庭、市政会等负责管理文书的）文书，书记员；<旧>（英国国教会的）牧师；<古>读书识字的人，学者
v. 当职员（或文书、书记员）
【名】 （Clerk）（英）克拉克（人名）

sentences.c: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel.
sentences.cn: 很奇怪一名职员会感到如此地受人忽视。

sentences.c: A clerk had slipped the wrong tab on Tony's X-ray.
sentences.cn: 一位职员失手把一个错误的标签贴到了托尼的X光片上。

sentences.c: In the first movie Tony Curtis ever made he played a grocery clerk.
sentences.cn: 在托尼·柯蒂斯制作的第一部影片中，他出演一名杂货店店员。

name: clever
trans: adj. 聪明的，机灵的；机敏的，巧妙的；诙谐的；熟练的，灵巧的；耍小聪明的，滑头的；真聪明（用于讽刺某人做的蠢事）；<英，非正式>健壮的，健康的

sentences.c: 'You are clever,' she gushed.
sentences.cn: “你好聪明。”她夸张地称赞说。

sentences.c: It's Jim who's the clever one.
sentences.cn: 就数吉姆聪明。

sentences.c: He's a very clever man.
sentences.cn: 他是个很聪明的人。

name: click
trans: v. （用鼠标）点击；发出咔嗒声；一见如故，受欢迎；突然明白，恍然大悟；配合默契，进展顺利；得到关注，引起兴趣
n. 短而尖的声音，咔哒声；点击；（南非语等语言的）倒吸气音

sentences.c: If you get stuck, click on Help.
sentences.cn: 如果你碰到困难，请点击“帮助”。

sentences.c: Click the link and see what happens.
sentences.cn: 点击那个链接，看看会发生什么。

sentences.c: Click on the icon when you want to print.
sentences.cn: 你想打印时就点击一下这个图标。

name: climate
trans: n. 气候；气候区；氛围，局势

sentences.c: What a damnable climate we have!
sentences.cn: 我们这的气候多讨厌啊！

sentences.c: The economic climate remains uncertain.
sentences.cn: 经济气候依然是不确定。

sentences.c: These plants flourish in a damp climate.
sentences.cn: 这些植物在潮湿的气候下长势茂盛。

name: climb
trans: v. 攀登，攀爬；爬升，升高；上升，升值；提高社会地位，晋升；吃力地爬（移动）；（植物）攀缘而上
n. 攀登，爬升；攀登的地方，攀登物；增值，上升；提高地位，晋升

sentences.c: Nancy began to climb the stairs.
sentences.cn: 南希开始爬楼梯。

sentences.c: It's an hour's climb to the summit.
sentences.cn: 爬到顶峰需要一小时。

sentences.c: I found the climb absolutely petrifying.
sentences.cn: 我觉得这次爬山太吓人了。

name: clinic
trans: n. 诊所，门诊部；门诊时间；临床实习；讲习班；（医院的）科，室；减免费用的专业服务机构；健康讲座

sentences.c: He is being treated at the London clinic.
sentences.cn: 他正在伦敦一家私人诊所接受治疗。

sentences.c: He went to an expensive clinic to dry out.
sentences.cn: 他到一家费用昂贵的诊所戒酒瘾。

sentences.c: He failed to keep his appointment at the clinic.
sentences.cn: 他未能按预约的时间去诊所。

name: clock
trans: n. 时钟，时钟的；考勤钟（the clock）；里程表（the clock）；（比赛）计时器，时间段（the clock）；速度计（the clock）；<英>（尤指蒲公英的）绒毛头；<英，非正式>人脸；（电脑）启动与同步内部操作的电子装置
v. 达到，记录下（一定时间，距离，速度）；记录（时间，速度）；打卡；<英，非正式>注意；<非正式>痛打，狠揍；回拨里程表作弊；获（胜）；需时
【名】 （Clock）（英）克洛克（人名）

sentences.c: The clock showed midnight.
sentences.cn: 时钟显示已是午夜。

sentences.c: The clock struck the hour.
sentences.cn: 钟敲过整点了。

sentences.c: I heard the clock chime.
sentences.cn: 我听见钟响报时。

name: clone
trans: n. （动植物的）无性繁殖，克隆；极为相似的人（或事物），复制品；仿制品，山寨货；复制器，仿制机；<非正式>外表或着装夸大男性气概的男同性恋者
v. 克隆，使无性繁殖；盗用（他人的手机号码），非法复制

sentences.c: A team from the UK were the first to successfully clone an animal.
sentences.cn: 英国的一个小组率先克隆动物成功。

sentences.c: He knows her clone may not have her temperament.
sentences.cn: 他知道她的克隆品可能没有她的气质。

sentences.c: Every man wants his son to be somewhat of a clone.
sentences.cn: 每个男人都希望自己的儿子在某种程度上是自己的克隆体。

name: close
trans: v. （使）关闭；合上，合拢；（使）暂时性关闭；（永久）停业，停止活动；（使）结束，（使）停止；关闭（计算机程序）；（股票等）收盘；拉近（距离），缩小（差距）；抱住，抓住，握住；（使）（伤口）愈合；封锁（公路、公园等）；完成，做成（交易等）；接通（电路）
adj. 接近的；酷似的，几乎相等的；快要……的；（坏事）险些发生的；近亲的；亲近的，亲密的；（关联）密切的；仔细的，全面的；势均力敌的；闷热的，不通风的；密集的，空间很小的；（头发或胡子）齐根的；守口如瓶的，掩饰感情的；吝啬的，小气的；严加保护（守卫）的；闭塞音的
adv. （空间或时间上）接近地
n. 结束，结尾；（大教堂的）围地；死胡同；<英>英国某些传统公学的操场；<苏格兰>通路，入口；（股市一日的）收盘（the close）；（板球一日比赛的）终赛（the close）；（乐）短句结尾，收束；关闭（尤指关门）
【名】 （Close）（英、法）克洛斯（人名）

sentences.c: The trees grew close together.
sentences.cn: 这些树紧挨着一起成长。

sentences.c: She sounded close to tears.
