sentences.c: You can actually initialize multiple things at once by separating them with a comma, and this is sometimes helpful.
sentences.cn: 实际上，您可以通过用逗号分隔多个事物来一次初始化它们，有时这很有帮助。

name: command
trans: v. 命令，下令；统率，指挥；博得，赢得；控制，掌管；居高临下，俯瞰；值（高价）
n. 命令，指示；（计算机的）指令；控制，管辖；指挥权，控制权；兵团，军区；指挥部，司令部；掌握，精通
【名】 （Command）（美）科芒（人名）

sentences.c: Begin when I give the command.
sentences.cn: 我发出命令时开始。

sentences.c: This command will invoke the HELP system.
sentences.cn: 这条指令将启用“帮助”系统。

sentences.c: This command deletes files from the directory.
sentences.cn: 这一指令把文档从目录中删除。

name: comment
trans: n. 评论，意见；批评，指责；说明，写照；<旧>解说，注释；（计算机）注解
v. 评论，发表意见；（计算机）注解，把（部分程序）转成注解
【名】 （Comment）（美、瑞、法）科门特（人名）

sentences.c: I forbore to comment on this.
sentences.cn: 我不欲评论它

sentences.c: Buckingham Palace refused to comment.
sentences.cn: 英国王室拒绝发表评论。

sentences.c: That comment needs some amplification.
sentences.cn: 这个评论需要进一步充实。

name: commercial
trans: adj. 商业的，商务的；商业化的，以获利为目的的；由广告商支付的；（化学制品）大量供应且纯度不高的
n. 电视广告，电台广告

sentences.c: We hope it will be a commercial success.
sentences.cn: 我们希望它会是一次商业成功。

sentences.c: The proposal makes sound commercial sense.
sentences.cn: 这项建议从营利的角度看是完全合情合理的。

sentences.c: Their more recent music is far too commercial.
sentences.cn: 他们最近的音乐过分商业化了。

name: commit
trans: v. 犯（罪、错）；调拨，投入；（使）承诺，承担义务；郑重承诺，忠于；把……关进医院（监狱），监禁；传唤（某人）到法院受审；订婚，决定与（某人）保持长期感情；把……托付给

sentences.c: He won't commit.
sentences.cn: 他不会承诺。

sentences.c: People who commit such crimes aren't normal.
sentences.cn: 犯这种罪的人心理不正常。

sentences.c: He hit out at public figures who commit adultery.
sentences.cn: 他猛烈抨击犯通奸的公众人物。

name: commitment
trans: n. 忠诚，献身；承诺，保证；奉献，投入；热情，决心；义务，责任；花费，使用（资金、时间、人力）；需要定期支付的款项

sentences.c: We made a commitment to keep working together.
sentences.cn: 我们作了承诺要继续在一起工作。

sentences.c: Will the president be able to hold to this commitment?
sentences.cn: 总统能恪守这一承诺吗？

sentences.c: His commitment has been unquestioned.
sentences.cn: 他的奉献是无可置疑的。

name: committee
trans: n. 委员会；<英>受托人，监护人；<美>精神病者监护人

sentences.c: The committee meets on Fridays.
sentences.cn: 委员会每周五开会。

sentences.c: The committee meets fortnightly.
sentences.cn: 委员会两星期开一次会。

sentences.c: The committee has been dissolved.
sentences.cn: 委员会被解散了。

name: common
trans: adj. 共同的，共享的；常见的，普遍的，一般的；普通的，平凡的；出于礼貌的，起码的；粗俗的，庸俗的
n. 公共用地，公地；校园公共食堂；<英，非正式>常识；（基督教教会适用于各种场合的）普通礼拜；平民

sentences.c: It's not a word in common usage.
sentences.cn: 这不是一个常用词。

sentences.c: Jackson is a common English name.
sentences.cn: 杰克逊是常见的英语人名。

sentences.c: Winters is a common enough surname.
sentences.cn: 温特斯是一个相当普通的姓。

name: communicate
trans: v. 传递信息，通讯；传达，传递（想法或感情）；传染（疾病）；（房间或建筑）相通，相连；传输（热，力），传递（运动）；领受圣餐

sentences.c: They can communicate even when they strongly disagree.
sentences.cn: 他们即使是在有较大分歧时也能相互交流。

sentences.c: They successfully communicate their knowledge to others.
sentences.cn: 他们成功地把他们的知识传达给别人。

sentences.c: Now he can only communicate through a voice synthesizer.
sentences.cn: 如今他只能通过声音合成器来进行交流。

name: communication
trans: n. 表达，交流，交际；信息，书信，电话；通讯，交通联系；传播学

sentences.c: Good communication is key to our success.
sentences.cn: 良好的沟通是我们成功的关键。

sentences.c: We are in regular communication by letter.
sentences.cn: 我们定期通信联系。

sentences.c: Television is an effective means of communication.
sentences.cn: 电视是一种有效的通信手段。

name: communism
trans: n. 共产主义学说，共产主义制度
n. 共产主义，共产主义理论（或制度）

name: communist
trans: n. 共产主义者，共产党党员
adj. 共产主义的，共产党党员的；共产党的（Communist）

name: companion
trans: n. 同伴，伴侣；（受雇照料老人或病人的）陪护；成对的物品之一；同甘共苦的伙伴；（用于书名）指南，手册；伴星；最低级爵士
v. 陪伴
【名】 （Companion）（英）康帕宁（人名）

sentences.c: He was a good friend, a dependable companion.
sentences.cn: 他是个好朋友，一个可以信赖的同伴。

sentences.c: Claude was a charming, sophisticated companion.
sentences.cn: 克劳德是个有魅力、见多识广的伙伴。

sentences.c: You come over as a capable and amusing companion.
sentences.cn: 你让人觉得是一个能干而有趣的同伴。

name: company
trans: n. 公司；陪伴，同伴；宾客，来宾；在一起的一群人；连队；剧团，歌舞团；女童军大队
v. <古>结交，交往；<古>陪伴
【名】 （Company）（美、瑞）孔帕尼（人名）

sentences.c: The company employs 18 workers.
sentences.cn: 该公司雇用18位职工。

sentences.c: The company wants quick results.
sentences.cn: 这公司要立竿见影的成果。

sentences.c: The company sued for defamation.
sentences.cn: 这个公司因受到诽谤而提起诉讼。

name: compare
trans: v. 比较，对比；把……比作；（与……）相比；构成（形容词或副词）的比较级和最高级
n. 比较

sentences.c: The point of the lesson is to compare the two countries.
sentences.cn: 本课的目的是比较这两个国家。

sentences.c: Managers analyse their company's data and compare it with data on their competitors.
sentences.cn: 经理们分析他们公司的数据并与其竞争者的数据进行比较。

sentences.c: Scientists are attempting to compare features of extinct animals with living analogues.
sentences.cn: 科学家正试图把已灭绝动物的特征与现存类似动物相比较。

name: compass
trans: n. 指南针，罗盘；圆规，两脚规；界限，范围
v. 绕（某物）而行，围绕；图谋完成

sentences.c: A compass needle points north.
sentences.cn: 罗盘指针指向北方。

sentences.c: The compass needle was pointing north.
sentences.cn: 罗盘指针指向北方。

sentences.c: We had to rely on a compass and a lot of luck to get here.
sentences.cn: 我们只得靠罗盘和很大的运气到达这儿。

name: compensate
trans: v. 赔偿，偿付；弥补，补偿；抵消；酬报（某人）

sentences.c: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.
sentences.cn: 失去心爱的人是无法补偿的。

sentences.c: The damages are designed to compensate victims for their direct losses.
sentences.cn: 该赔偿金是用来补偿受害人的直接损失的。

sentences.c: A surge in domestic sales helped compensate for a fall-off in export sales.
sentences.cn: 国内销售的增长帮助补偿了出口销售的减少。

name: compete
trans: v. 竞争，对抗；争夺；参加比赛

sentences.c: We can't compete with them on price.
sentences.cn: 我们在价格上无法与他们竞争。

sentences.c: The company must reduce costs to compete effectively.
sentences.cn: 公司要有效地参与竞争必须降低成本。

sentences.c: Charles has never felt the need to compete with anyone.
sentences.cn: 查尔斯从未感觉到与人竞争的需要。

name: competence
trans: n. 能力，胜任；权限，管辖权；技能；感受态，反应能力；<旧>足以谋生的收入（尤指非劳动所得）

sentences.c: Many people have testified to his competence.
sentences.cn: 很多人已证实了他的能力。

sentences.c: The judge has to act within the competence of the court.
sentences.cn: 法官必须在法庭的权限范围内行使权力。

sentences.c: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
sentences.cn: 挑选过程是建立在对能力和经验严格缜密的考核的基础之上的。

name: competition
trans: n. 竞争；比赛，竞赛；竞争者，对手

sentences.c: Competition for jobs is acute.
sentences.cn: 求职竞争非常激烈。

sentences.c: 1 000 children entered the competition.
sentences.cn: 1 000名孩子报名参加了比赛。

sentences.c: She won first prize in the competition.
sentences.cn: 她在竞赛中获得头奖。

name: competitor
trans: n. 竞争者，对手；选手，参赛者

sentences.c: The opposite of an opportunist is a competitor.
sentences.cn: 与机会主义者对立的是竞争者。

sentences.c: His success was beyond belief since his competitor was so experienced.
sentences.cn: 他的成功令人难以置信，因为他的对手非常有经验。

sentences.c: The girl I viewed as a competitor congratulated me on my contest results.
sentences.cn: 那个被我视为竞争对手的女孩就我取得的竞赛成绩向我表示祝贺。

name: complete
trans: adj. 完全的，彻底的；全部的，完整的；完成的，结束的；技能全面的，技术娴熟的；向前传球成功的
v. 使完整，使完美；填写（表格）；完成，结束

sentences.c: We were in complete agreement.
sentences.cn: 我们意见完全一致。

sentences.c: I'm a complete novice at skiing.
sentences.cn: 滑雪我完全是个新手。

sentences.c: His boss is a complete tyrant.
sentences.cn: 他的老板是个不折不扣的暴君。

name: complex
trans: adj. 复杂的，难懂的；组合的，合成的；（句子）复合的；复数的，复的；配合的，络合的
n. 综合大楼，建筑群；复合体，综合体；情结；强烈（或过度）的关心（或忧虑）；配合物，络合物

sentences.c: He was an unusually complex man.
sentences.cn: 他是个异常复杂的人。

sentences.c: It is a complex yet stimulating book.
sentences.cn: 这是一本复杂却能引发兴趣的书。

sentences.c: Now, the next point is quite complex.
sentences.cn: 请注意，下一点非常复杂。

name: component
trans: n. 组成部分，成分，部件
adj. 组成的，构成的

sentences.c: Attitudes have a behavioral component.
sentences.cn: 态度隐含着行为性的成分。

sentences.c: Finally, attitudes have a behavioral component.
sentences.cn: 最后，态度具有行为上的成分。

sentences.c: That said, curiosity does have a genetic component.
sentences.cn: 这就是说，好奇心确实有基因成分。

name: composition
trans: n. 成分构成，成分；（音乐、艺术、诗歌的）作品；创作，作曲；构图；作文

sentences.c: We had to write a composition on the subject "My Pet."
sentences.cn: 我们得就“我的宠物”这个主题写一篇作文。

sentences.c: Television has transformed the size and social composition of the audience at great sporting occasions.
sentences.cn: 电视改变了大型体育赛事观众的数量及其社会构成。

sentences.c: Extracting information about the large-scale composition of a planet from a sample weighing a millionth of a gram was a fascinating example of scientific endeavour.
sentences.cn: 从重量为百万分之一克的样品中提取有关行星宏观组成的信息是一个极为有趣的科学尝试实例。

name: comprehension
trans: n. 理解力，领悟力；（听力或阅读）理解测试；包括，包含

sentences.c: This was utterly beyond her comprehension.
sentences.cn: 这完全超出了她的理解力。

sentences.c: Is this test a good measure of reading comprehension?
sentences.cn: 这种测试是判断阅读理解力的好方法吗？

sentences.c: It's a devastating and barbaric act that defies all comprehension.
sentences.cn: 这是毁灭性的野蛮行径，完全没有方法可理解。

name: compromise
trans: n. 折中，妥协；妥协方案，折中办法
v. 妥协，让步；危及，损害

sentences.c: I refuse to compromise my principles.
sentences.cn: 我拒绝在原则问题上妥协。

sentences.c: Neither side is prepared to compromise.
sentences.cn: 双方都不愿意妥协。

sentences.c: Compromise is an inevitable part of life.
sentences.cn: 妥协是生活不可避免的一部分。

name: compulsory
trans: adj. 必须做的，义务的，强制的
n. （花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作

sentences.c: There is a compulsory course in statistics.
sentences.cn: 有一门统计学的必修课。

sentences.c: Certain courses are compulsory, others are optional.
sentences.cn: 某些课程是必修的，其他是选修的。

sentences.c: It is compulsory for all motorcyclists to wear helmets.
sentences.cn: 所有骑摩托车的人都必须戴头盔，这是强制性的。

name: computer
trans: n. 电脑；计算机；电子计算机
n. 计算机；电脑；电子计算机

sentences.c: My computer keeps going funny.
sentences.cn: 我的计算机老出故障。

sentences.c: He's addicted to computer games.
sentences.cn: 他迷上了电脑游戏。

sentences.c: He hacked into the bank's computer.
sentences.cn: 他侵入了这家银行的计算机。

name: computer game
trans: n. 电脑游戏
电子游戏，尤其是使用通用计算机玩的游戏（与游戏机相对）

sentences.c: He's playing the computer game.
sentences.cn: 他在玩电脑游戏。

sentences.c: Let's give him a computer game.
sentences.cn: 让我们给他个电脑游戏吧！

sentences.c: I'm playing a computer game.
sentences.cn: 我正在玩电脑游戏。

name: comrade
trans: n. 伙伴，战友；同志（用于社会主义政党的成员之间）
【名】 （Comrade）（尼日利）科姆拉德（人名）

sentences.c: He vowed to himself to avenge his martyred comrade.
sentences.cn: 他暗暗发誓要为牺牲的同志报仇。

sentences.c: Better be careful of your bookish approach, comrade.
sentences.cn: 同志，注意你的书生气！

sentences.c: Most of the goats ran away from their rough comrade.
sentences.cn: 大多数山羊都从它们粗暴的伙伴身边跑开了。

name: concentrate
trans: v. 集中注意力，聚精会神；使集中，聚集；浓缩
n. 浓缩物，浓缩液

sentences.c: At work you need to be able to concentrate.
sentences.cn: 工作时你要能专心。

sentences.c: We need to concentrate on our core business.
sentences.cn: 我们需要集中在核心业务上。

sentences.c: I am leaving to concentrate on writing fiction.
sentences.cn: 我要离开去专心写小说。

name: concept
trans: n. 概念，观念
adj. （围绕）某主题的；为表达一种想法而创造的
v. <非正式>想象，设想

sentences.c: Ten years on, the original concept was wearing well.
sentences.cn: 十年过去，最初的观念依然适用。

sentences.c: The concept of saturation marketing makes perfect sense.
sentences.cn: 饱和营销的概念很有道理。

sentences.c: It's not a question of some abstract concept of justice.
sentences.cn: 这不是一个有关正义的某一抽象概念的问题。

name: concern
trans: n. 担心，忧虑；使人担忧的事物；关心，关爱；重要的事物，关心的事；（某人）负责的事，涉及的事；公司，企业；<非正式>复杂的物体
v. 有关，关于；涉及，影响；使忧虑，使担心

sentences.c: There is no cause for concern.
sentences.cn: 没有理由担忧。

sentences.c: He assumed an air of concern.
sentences.cn: 他装出关心的样子。

sentences.c: I didn't concern myself with politics.
sentences.cn: 我不关心政治。

name: concert
trans: n. 音乐会，演奏会；一致，和谐；（尤指犯罪时的）联合行动
v. 共同议定，协调

sentences.c: When does the concert begin?
sentences.cn: 音乐会什么时间开始？

sentences.c: Their concert there was a sell-out.
sentences.cn: 他们在那儿的音乐会座无虚席。

sentences.c: The concert had been a great success.
sentences.cn: 音乐会非常成功。

name: conclude
trans: v. 断定，推断出；结束，终止；达成，做成，完成；<美>决定

sentences.c: So what can we conclude from this debate?
sentences.cn: 那么从这场辩论中我们能推断出什么呢？

sentences.c: The competitors cantered into the arena to conclude the closing ceremony.
sentences.cn: 赛手们慢跑进入比赛场地，结束了闭幕式。

sentences.c: What do you conclude from that?
sentences.cn: 你从这件事中得出了什么结论？

name: conclusion
trans: n. 结论，推论；结局，结尾；缔结，商定；（根据所给前提得出的）命题

sentences.c: What led you to this conclusion?
sentences.cn: 你是如何得出这个结论的？

sentences.c: Few will argue with this conclusion.
sentences.cn: 很少有人会不同意这个结论。

sentences.c: The judge's conclusion was plainly wrong.
sentences.cn: 法官的结论显然是错误的。

name: concrete
trans: adj. 确实的，具体的；实在的，有形的；混凝土的；物质的
n. 混凝土
v. 用混凝土覆盖（或做成）；<旧>（使）凝固，（使）凝结；使真实（化），使具体（化）

sentences.c: We sat on the concrete floor.
sentences.cn: 我们坐在混凝土地板上。

sentences.c: The concrete was ready mixed.
sentences.cn: 混凝土是搅拌好的。

sentences.c: I had no concrete evidence.
sentences.cn: 我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

name: condition
trans: n. 状况，状态；条件，环境；疾病；条款；<旧>社会地位
v. 训练，使习惯于；控制，制约；护理，保养；影响；加条件于；使（人，动物）健康；（发酵后，在酵母仍存在时）使（啤酒，黑啤酒）酿熟

sentences.c: The piano was in good condition.
sentences.cn: 这台钢琴状况良好。

sentences.c: The car was in A1 condition.
sentences.cn: 汽车状况好极了。

sentences.c: Day by day his condition improved.
sentences.cn: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

name: condemn
trans: v. 谴责，严厉指责；宣判，判决；使陷入（不愉快的境地）；宣布……不安全；证明（或表明）有罪

sentences.c: The Church has a duty to condemn violence.
sentences.cn: 基督教会有义务谴责暴力。

sentences.c: Like everyone else, I deplore and condemn this killing.
sentences.cn: 我同所有人一样强烈谴责这桩凶杀案。

sentences.c: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence.
sentences.cn: 政治领袖们昨天联合谴责最近发生的一波暴力事件。

name: conduct
trans: v. 实施，进行；指挥；带领，引导；举止，表现；传导
n. 行为，举止；经营方式，管理方法

sentences.c: He was ejected for unsporting conduct.
sentences.cn: 他因为不符合运动员道德的行为被驱逐。

sentences.c: The sport has a strict code of conduct.
sentences.cn: 体育运动有严格的行为规范。

sentences.c: Police will conduct random breath tests.
sentences.cn: 警察会随机进行吹气酒精测试。

name: conductor
trans: n. （乐队等的）指挥；售票员，检票员；导体；<英>传导教育的引导者

sentences.c: The conductor beat time with a baton.
sentences.cn: 指挥用指挥棒打拍子。

sentences.c: Graphite is a highly efficient conductor of electricity.
sentences.cn: 石墨是一种高效的电导体。

sentences.c: Under its new conductor, the orchestra has established an international reputation.
sentences.cn: 在新指挥的领导下，这个乐团建立了国际声誉。

name: confident
trans: adj. （性格，态度）自信的，充满信心的；坚信的，肯定的
n. <古>密友，知己

sentences.c: Marina was a confident, happy child.
sentences.cn: 玛丽娜是个自信、快乐的孩子。

sentences.c: She was in a relaxed, confident mood.
sentences.cn: 她的心态从容而自信。

sentences.c: He feels more confident on home turf.
sentences.cn: 他在主场感到更有信心。

name: confidential
trans: adj. 机密的，保密的；（言谈举止）神秘的，隐秘的；受信任的，委以机密的

sentences.c: My letter is, of course, strictly private and confidential.
sentences.cn: 当然，我的信纯属私人信件，务须保密。

sentences.c: The deliberations of the committee are completely confidential.
sentences.cn: 委员会的审议过程是绝对保密的。

sentences.c: From time to time he passed on confidential information to him.
sentences.cn: 他不时地传送机密情报给他。

name: conference
trans: n. （大型、正式的）会议，研讨会；（小型正式的）商讨，讨论；体育协会（或联合会）

sentences.c: It was a good-humoured conference.
sentences.cn: 会议的气氛很愉快。

sentences.c: Such threats could scuttle the peace conference.
sentences.cn: 这样的威胁可能会破坏和平会议。

sentences.c: There are daily conference calls with Washington.
sentences.cn: 与华盛顿方面有每日电话会议。

name: confirm
trans: v. 确定，确认；证实，证明；批准，认可；使坚定，加强；给（某人）施坚信礼

sentences.c: Can you confirm what happened?
sentences.cn: 你能证实一下发生了什么事吗？

sentences.c: Can you write and confirm your booking?
sentences.cn: 你能写信来确认你的预订项目吗？

sentences.c: A brief dip into history serves to confirm this view.
sentences.cn: 随便翻阅一下历史就足以证实这种观点。

name: conflict
trans: n. 争执，争论，分歧；战斗，战争；抵触，矛盾
v. 冲突，抵触

sentences.c: John often comes into conflict with his boss.
sentences.cn: 约翰经常和他的老板发生争执。

sentences.c: She was unafraid of conflict.
sentences.cn: 她不怕发生冲突。

sentences.c: These results conflict with earlier findings.
sentences.cn: 这些结果与早期的发现相矛盾。

name: confuse
trans: v. 使糊涂，使迷惑；混淆，弄错；使复杂化

sentences.c: I always confuse my left with my right.
sentences.cn: 我总是混淆左右。

sentences.c: Don't confuse liberty with license.
sentences.cn: 不要把自由与放纵混为一谈。

sentences.c: People often confuse me and my twin sister.
sentences.cn: 人们常常把我和我的孪生妹妹搞错。

name: congratulate
trans: v. 祝贺，向……道贺；感到高兴（或自豪）

sentences.c: I congratulate you.
sentences.cn: 我祝贺你。

sentences.c: I congratulate all of you on this achievement.
sentences.cn: 我祝贺你们的这一成就。

sentences.c: I should congratulate you that you resisted the temptation.
sentences.cn: 我应向你祝贺，你抗住了这种引诱。

name: congratulation
trans: n. 恭喜，祝贺；恭贺，贺辞

sentences.c: She flashed him a false smile of congratulation.
sentences.cn: 她向他虚情假意地微微一笑表示祝贺。

sentences.c: We have received many letters of congratulation.
sentences.cn: 我们收到了许多祝贺信。

sentences.c: Congratulation! You made it!
sentences.cn: 恭喜！你做到了！

name: connect
trans: v. （使）连接；（使）相通；使接通（电源、水源等）；与……有关系；把……联系起来；衔接，联运；（使）换乘（飞机或火车）；给……接通电话；产生共鸣，契合；建立良好关系；击中

sentences.c: Click 'Continue' to connect to the Internet.
sentences.cn: 点击 Continue 连接到互联网。

sentences.c: You can connect the speakers to your CD player.
sentences.cn: 你可以将这些扬声器与你的激光唱机连接起来。

sentences.c: The canal was built to connect Sheffield with the Humber estuary.
sentences.cn: 修建这条运河是为了将设菲尔德和亨伯河河口连接起来。

name: connection
trans: n. 关系，联系；连接，接通；连接物，接头；联运，转车，转机；交通线；人际关系，人脉；亲戚，旁系亲属；<美，非正式>毒品贩子

sentences.c: I felt a strong connection between us.
sentences.cn: 我感觉到了我们之间的强烈关系。

sentences.c: I'm having problems with my Internet connection.
sentences.cn: 我的互联网连接有问题。

sentences.c: My flight was late and I missed the connection.
sentences.cn: 我乘坐的航班晚点了，因此我错过了联运航班。

name: conscience
trans: n. 良知，良心；内疚，愧疚
【名】 （Conscience）（法）孔西延斯（人名）

sentences.c: He won't let it trouble his conscience.
sentences.cn: 他不会让这件事搞得自己良心不安。

sentences.c: He lay awake, scourged by his conscience.
sentences.cn: 他备受良心的折磨，不能入睡。

sentences.c: The crime lay heavy on her conscience.
sentences.cn: 那件罪行使她内疚不安。

name: consensus
trans: n. 一致看法，共识

sentences.c: There is a growing consensus of opinion on this issue.
sentences.cn: 对这个问题的看法日趋一致。

sentences.c: There is a general consensus among teachers about the need for greater security in schools.
sentences.cn: 教师们对必须加强学校的保安有普遍的共识。

sentences.c: The consensus among the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades.
sentences.cn: 全世界科学家的共识是地球可能在未来几十年中变暖。

name: consequence
trans: n. 结果，后果；重要性，价值

sentences.c: This is a necessary consequence of progress.
sentences.cn: 这是发展的必然后果。

sentences.c: It was an inevitable consequence of the decision.
sentences.cn: 那是这个决定的必然后果。

sentences.c: One consequence of global warming is extinction.
sentences.cn: 全球变暖的后果之一是物种灭绝。

name: conservation
trans: n. 保护，保存；节约，防止浪费；守恒定律

sentences.c: This proposal will incense conservation campaigners.
sentences.cn: 这项提议将激怒自然保护的倡导者。

sentences.c: The benefits of conservation are both financial and aesthetic.
sentences.cn: 保护自然环境在经济上和美化环境上都有好处。

sentences.c: Scientific research and conservation are intimately connected.
sentences.cn: 科学研究与环境保护联系密切。

name: conservative
trans: adj. 保守的；保守派的，保守主义的（认为政府应该实行政治保守主义）；（衣着）守旧的，传统的；低估的；保守党的；不愿冒险的，谨慎的
n. 保守者，因循守旧者；保守党党员，保守党支持者

sentences.c: Her style of dress was never conservative.
sentences.cn: 她的服装式样一点儿也不保守。

sentences.c: Two Conservative MPs have gone over to the Liberal Democrats.
sentences.cn: 两名保守党议员已转向自由民主党人一边。

sentences.c: The company's conservative instincts sit ill with competition.
sentences.cn: 该公司的保守本性不适合竞争。

name: consider
trans: v. 考虑，斟酌；认为，视为；体贴，顾及；细看，端详；探讨，讨论

sentences.c: I'd like some time to consider.
sentences.cn: 我希望有些时间考虑一下。

sentences.c: Let's consider this point further.
sentences.cn: 让我们更深入地考虑这一点。

sentences.c: They sat down to consider the problem.
sentences.cn: 他们坐下来考虑这一问题。

name: considerate
trans: adj. 体贴的，考虑周到的；<旧>小心的，谨慎的

sentences.c: It was very considerate of him to wait.
sentences.cn: 他一直在等候着，真是体贴人。

sentences.c: He was charming, considerate and impeccably mannered.
sentences.cn: 他富有魅力，待人体贴，举止无可挑剔。

sentences.c: She is always polite and considerate towards her employees.
sentences.cn: 她对待雇员总是客客气气，关心体谅。

name: consideration
trans: n. 考虑，斟酌；考虑因素；体贴，关心；报酬，酬金；（合同协议中的）对价，约因；<旧>重要（性）

sentences.c: This consideration was not unimportant.
sentences.cn: 这项考虑并非无关紧要。

sentences.c: Time is another important consideration.
sentences.cn: 时间是另一个需要考虑的重要因素。

sentences.c: The report deserves careful consideration.
sentences.cn: 这报告应该给予认真考虑。

name: consist
trans: v. 由……组成，由……构成；在于，存在于
n. （铁路）车列

sentences.c: True education does not consist in simply being taught facts.
sentences.cn: 真正的教育并不在于简单地讲授事实。

sentences.c: The development will consist of 66 dwellings and a number of offices.
sentences.cn: 新建楼区将由66栋住房和一些办公用房组成。

sentences.c: Most consist of timber frames that rest on stone blocks.
sentences.cn: 大部分由木框架组成，木框架放置在石块上。

name: consistent
trans: adj. 始终如一的，一贯的；持续的，连续的；固守的，坚持的；一致的，吻合的

sentences.c: A theory should be internally consistent.
sentences.cn: 一套理论应当内在一致。

sentences.c: We must be consistent in applying the rules.
sentences.cn: 我们在实施这些规则时必须保持一致。

sentences.c: Graham is so solidly consistent.
sentences.cn: 格雷厄姆非常可靠稳定。

name: constant
trans: adj. 持续不断的，经常发生的；恒定的，不变的；忠诚的，忠实的
n. 常数，恒量；不变的事物
【名】 （Constant） （德）康斯坦特（人名）

sentences.c: This entrance is in constant use.
sentences.cn: 此入口经常使用。

sentences.c: Her constant nagging drove him away.
sentences.cn: 她不断的唠叨把他给赶跑了。

sentences.c: Constant rejections made him feel worthless.
sentences.cn: 不断地遭到拒绝使他觉得一无是处。

name: constitution
trans: n. 宪法，章程；体质，体格；组成，结构

sentences.c: This system is enshrined in our Constitution.
sentences.cn: 我们的宪法使该制度神圣而不可侵犯。

sentences.c: A new constitution was promulgated last month.
sentences.cn: 上个月颁布了一部新宪法。

sentences.c: The assembly was mandated to draft a constitution.
sentences.cn: 大会被授权起草一份章程。

name: construct
trans: v. 建造，修建；组成，创立，构思；绘制，作图
n. 构想，观念；建筑物，创造物；结构体

sentences.c: Any attempt to construct an ideal society is foredoomed to failure.
sentences.cn: 任何构建理想社会的努力都注定要失败。

sentences.c: My next work was to construct a nest and anchor it in a tree.
sentences.cn: 我的下一步工作是建造一个巢穴,并把它固定在树上。

sentences.c: Now let us construct two three-member sets based on the results.
sentences.cn: 现在让我们根据结果构造两个三成员集。

name: construction
trans: n. 建造，建筑；创立，构建；构造，结构；建筑物；语法结构；解释，理解

sentences.c: The railway is still under construction.
sentences.cn: 这条铁路仍在建设之中。

sentences.c: The summer house was a simple wooden construction.
sentences.cn: 那座避暑别墅是简单的木结构建筑。

sentences.c: Construction had slowed because of a dearth of labourers.
sentences.cn: 建筑进程缓慢是因为劳动力不足。

name: consult
trans: v. 咨询，请教；商量，商讨；查询，查阅；当顾问

sentences.c: He needed to consult with an attorney.
sentences.cn: 他需要和律师咨询。

sentences.c: Consult your doctor about how much exercise you should get.
sentences.cn: 咨询你的医生你应做多少运动。

sentences.c: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
sentences.cn: 如果你的皮肤变红，疼痛或严重脱皮，请咨询医生。

name: consultant
trans: n. 顾问；高级顾问医师，会诊医师；咨询者

sentences.c: She is a consultant to the government.
sentences.cn: 她是政府顾问。

sentences.c: He is currently engaged as a consultant.
sentences.cn: 他现在受雇为顾问。

sentences.c: He was a consultant rheumatologist at the local hospital.
sentences.cn: 他是当地医院的一位风湿病学顾问。

name: consume
trans: v. 消耗，消费；吃，喝；吞噬，烧毁；使……着迷，充满

sentences.c: Many people are unaware of just how much food and drink they consume.
sentences.cn: 许多人不知道自己到底消耗掉多少食物和饮料。

sentences.c: Some of the most efficient refrigerators consume 70 percent less electricity than traditional models.
sentences.cn: 一些能效最高的冰箱比传统型号少消耗70%的电。

sentences.c: Fat people consume more energy than slim people.
sentences.cn: 胖的人比瘦的人消耗更多的能量。

name: contain
trans: v. 包含，容纳；遏制，防止……蔓延；抑制（感情）

sentences.c: Most vegetables contain fibre.
sentences.cn: 大多数蔬菜含有纤维。

sentences.c: This drink doesn't contain any alcohol.
sentences.cn: 这种饮料不含任何酒精。

sentences.c: Some mushrooms contain a deadly poison.
sentences.cn: 有些蘑菇含有致命毒素。

name: container
trans: n. 容器；集装箱，货柜

sentences.c: The metal container began to emit a clicking sound.
sentences.cn: 金属容器开始发出咔嗒咔嗒的声音。

sentences.c: Do not fill the container more than two-thirds full.
sentences.cn: 加入的量不要超过容器总容量的2/3。

sentences.c: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.
sentences.cn: 如果贮藏在密封的容器里，食物能保持比较久的时间。

name: contemporary
trans: adj. 当代的，现代的；同时期的，同时代的
n. 同时代的人；同龄人，同辈

sentences.c: Contemporary African cinema has much to offer.
sentences.cn: 当代非洲电影制作艺术有很多贡献。

sentences.c: We weren't out to design a contemporary utopia.
sentences.cn: 我们不想去设计一个当代乌托邦。

sentences.c: She patronizes many contemporary British artists.
sentences.cn: 她赞助许多英国当代艺术家。

name: content
trans: adj. 满足的，满意的，甘愿的
n. 目录；所含物，容纳的东西；（书、文章、演讲、电影等的）内容；含量；满足，满意；投赞成票的贵族院议员；网上信息，电子信息
v. 使满意，使满足
【名】 （Content）（法）孔唐（人名）

sentences.c: He seemed more content, less bitter.
sentences.cn: 他看起来比较满意，不那么失望。

sentences.c: He says his daughter is quite content.
sentences.cn: 他说他的女儿颇为满意。

sentences.c: I am content to admire the mountains from below.
sentences.cn: 我满足于从山下观赏群山。

name: continent
trans: n. 洲，大陆
adj. 有排便节制力的；<旧>节制性欲的

sentences.c: She loved the African continent.
sentences.cn: 她热爱非洲大陆。

sentences.c: The news set off a continent-wide health scare.
sentences.cn: 这一消息引起了整个大陆的健康恐慌。

sentences.c: The famine threatened to depopulate the continent.
sentences.cn: 饥荒威胁着该大陆人口数量。

name: continue
trans: v. （使）继续，（使）延续；继续说，接着说；移动，延伸；留任，维持原状

sentences.c: They'll continue to fight injustice.
sentences.cn: 他们将继续与不公正的现象抗争。

sentences.c: He will continue as chairman emeritus.
sentences.cn: 他将会继续担任荣誉主席。

sentences.c: Please continue—I didn't mean to interrupt.
sentences.cn: 请继续往下说，我并非有意打断你的话。

name: contradict
trans: v. 反驳，否认；相抵触，相矛盾；发生矛盾

sentences.c: She dared not contradict him.
sentences.cn: 她不敢反驳他。

sentences.c: His comments appeared to contradict remarks made earlier in the day by the chairman.
sentences.cn: 他的评论好像在反驳主席当天早些时候的言论。

sentences.c: Bowen and Greene's results contradict that argument.
sentences.cn: 鲍恩和格林的结果与该论点相矛盾。

name: contradictory
trans: adj. 相互矛盾的，对立的；好反驳的，爱争辩的
n. 矛盾命题

sentences.c: The advice I received was often contradictory.
sentences.cn: 我所得到的建议常常是相互矛盾的。

sentences.c: We are faced with two apparently contradictory statements.
sentences.cn: 我们面前这两种说法显然是矛盾的。

sentences.c: He is notorious for making unexpected, often self-contradictory, comments.
sentences.cn: 他因发表出人意料的，经常自相矛盾的观点，而臭名昭著。

name: contrary
trans: adj. 相反的，相对的；乖戾的，好与人作对的；逆向的，逆行的
n. 相反的事实（或事情、情况）；对立命题，反对命题
adv. 相反地

sentences.c: I don't find him funny at all. Quite the contrary.
sentences.cn: 正相反，我觉得他一点儿也不可笑。

sentences.c: Contrary to popular belief , many cats dislike milk.
sentences.cn: 与普通的看法相反，许多猫不喜欢牛奶。

sentences.c: Contrary to expectations , interest rates did not rise.
sentences.cn: 出乎意料的是利率并未上升。

name: contribute
trans: v. 捐赠，捐助；（为……）做贡献；促成，是……的原因之一；撰稿，投稿；发表意见，提议

sentences.c: Do you wish to contribute?
sentences.cn: 你想捐助吗？

sentences.c: You need not feel obliged to contribute.
sentences.cn: 你不必认为你非得捐款。

sentences.c: Local businesses have agreed to contribute.
sentences.cn: 当地的公司已经同意捐助了。

name: contribution
trans: n. 贡献，促成作用；捐款，捐助；（保险金、养老金等的）定期缴款；稿件，投稿

sentences.c: His contribution could be key.
sentences.cn: 他的贡献可能是最重要的。

sentences.c: Their contribution was of great worth.
sentences.cn: 他们的贡献具有伟大的意义。

sentences.c: They may define their contribution too narrowly.
sentences.cn: 他们可能把他们的贡献说得太狭隘了。

name: control
trans: n. （对国家、地区、机构等的）控制权，支配权；控制能力；操纵装置；管理，管制；指挥（或检查、控制）站，指挥（或检查、控制）人员；（键盘上的）控制键
v. 控制，掌管；限制，限定；阻止蔓延（或恶化）；操纵，控制（机器或系统等）；抑制，克制

sentences.c: The situation is under control.
sentences.cn: 局面得到了控制。

sentences.c: The city is under enemy control.
sentences.cn: 那座城市现处于敌人的控制之下。

sentences.c: The government remained in control.
sentences.cn: 政府继续控制着局势。

name: controversial
trans: adj. 有争议的，引发争论的

sentences.c: Immigration is a controversial issue in many countries.
sentences.cn: 移民在很多国家都是一个有争议的问题。

sentences.c: The distinction between craft and fine art is more controversial.
sentences.cn: 工艺和美术之间的区别更有争议。

sentences.c: Winston Churchill and Richard Nixon were both controversial figures.

sentences.cn: 课程设置应该内容广泛而且均衡。

sentences.c: The curriculum was too narrow and too rigid.
sentences.cn: 课程设置过于狭窄和死板。

sentences.c: The subjects of the curriculum form a coherent whole.
sentences.cn: 课程中的科目构成了一个连贯的整体。

name: curtain
trans: n. 窗帘，门帘；帘状物，幕状物（如浓烟或大雨等）；纱幔，帷幔；（舞台上的）幕，幕布；开幕，落幕；灾难性结局

sentences.cn: 她把窗帘拉向一边。

sentences.cn: 一挂珠帘子把两个房间分开。

sentences.c: Light beamed through a hole in the curtain.
sentences.cn: 光线透过窗帘上的一个孔照射进来。

name: cushion
trans: n. 垫子，坐垫；减震垫，缓冲垫；起缓解作用的东西；大比分领先，稳操胜券；（台球桌的）弹性衬边
v. 缓冲；减轻……的影响；给…安上垫子，把……安置在垫子上

sentences.c: A hovercraft rides on a cushion of air.
sentences.cn: 气垫船悬浮在气垫上行驶。

sentences.c: She embroidered flowers on the cushion covers.
sentences.cn: 她在这些靠垫套上绣了花。

sentences.c: She embroidered the cushion covers with flowers.
sentences.cn: 她在这些靠垫套上绣了花。

name: custom
trans: n. 风俗，习俗；习惯；光顾，惠顾；<法律>惯例，习惯法；（经常性的）顾客
adj. 定做的，量身设计的

sentences.c: It was her custom to rise early.
sentences.cn: 早起是她的习惯。

sentences.c: The origin of the custom is obscure.
sentences.cn: 该习俗的起源鲜为人知。

sentences.c: This quaint custom should be revived.
sentences.cn: 应该恢复这一独特的风俗。

name: customer
trans: n. 顾客；（某一类型的）家伙

sentences.c: The customer called to cancel.
sentences.cn: 顾客打电话来取消了。

sentences.c: The firm has excellent customer relations.
sentences.cn: 此公司与客户关系极好。

sentences.c: They set high standards of customer service.
sentences.cn: 他们制订了严格的客户服务标准。

name: customs
trans: n. 海关；风俗（custom的复数）；习惯；关税
n. 海关；关税

sentences.c: He walked through customs.
sentences.cn: 他步行通过了海关。

sentences.c: The old customs are dying.
sentences.cn: 旧的习俗正在消亡。

sentences.c: The ship was boarded by customs officials.
sentences.cn: 海关官员登上了这艘船。

name: cut
trans: v. 切，割，剪；削减，缩减；删节，删减；停止，切断；抄近路，穿过；切（牌），倒（牌）；灌制（唱片），录制（讲话）；划伤，割伤；剪裁；开始长（新牙）；<美>逃学，逃课；停止做不好的事情；切下；切开，把……切碎；凿，挖，刻；剪短，修剪；（割断束缚物）使脱身，使松开；可用于切割；能被切割；剪切（计算机文档）； 剪辑，剪接；停止拍片（或录音、录像）；切换画面；（从感情上）伤害；（与另一条线）相交；冲淡，稀释；划分（区域）；砍（植物）；开除，除名；快速行进；突然转向；插队；（直截了当地）处理；去除（污垢、油污等）；削（球）；<美，非正式>符合要求（cut it）

sentences.c: The cut needed eight stitches.
sentences.cn: 这道伤口需要缝八针。

sentences.c: Johnson cut himself shaving.
sentences.cn: 约翰逊刮胡子时割伤了自己。

sentences.c: Their throats had been cut.
sentences.cn: 他们的咽喉被割断了。

name: cycle
trans: n. 自行车，摩托车；循环，周期；组诗，组歌；整套，系列；自行车骑行；一段时间

sentences.c: We went for a cycle ride on Sunday.
sentences.cn: 我们星期天骑自行车去兜风了。

sentences.c: I usually cycle home through the park.
sentences.cn: 我通常骑自行车穿过公园回家。

sentences.c: This cycle repeats itself ad infinitum.
sentences.cn: 这个周期一直循环往复。

name: cyclist
trans: n. 骑自行车的人

sentences.c: The car narrowly missed a cyclist.
sentences.cn: 汽车差点儿撞上一位骑自行车的人。

sentences.c: He beeped his horn at the cyclist.
sentences.cn: 他对骑自行车的人按喇叭。

sentences.c: She swerved sharply to avoid a cyclist.
sentences.cn: 她猛地急转弯，以躲开一个骑自行车的人。

name: dad = daddy
trans: n. （口）爸爸，爹爹

sentences.c: The first was in the form of a card from his daughter, saying in part “we don’t know all of what you shared with my dad but that conversation changed his life. We have our daddy back”.
sentences.cn: 第一个是他的女儿以卡片的形式对我说：“我们不知道你曾和我父亲聊过些什么，但那个对话改变了他对人生的态度，我们曾经的那个父亲又回来了”。

sentences.c: Then there was the ‘Daddy-push’, which consisted of us boys pushing against our dad’s shoulders with our own shoulders, though we were on our feet while our dad was on hands and knees.
sentences.cn: 然后我们当中的三个人“推爸爸”，就是说我们用我们的肩膀反向推我们的爸爸的肩膀，尽管我们是用脚站立而爸爸使用手或者膝盖。

sentences.c: Desiring to have his reasons for liking him, I could only gather the sentences — 'I known't: he pays dad back what he gies to me — he curses daddy for cursing me.
sentences.cn: 我想知道他喜欢他的理由，只听到这些话：“我不知道——爸爸怎么对付我，他就怎么对付爸爸——他骂爸爸因为爸爸骂我。”

name: daily

n. 日报；<英>日工，女佣；（每天拍摄的）电影样片

sentences.cn: 他们召开了每日例行的新闻发布会。

sentences.c: The plants want to be watered daily.
sentences.cn: 这些花草需要天天浇水。

sentences.c: The machines are inspected twice daily.
sentences.cn: 机器每日检查两次。

name: dam
trans: n. 堤，坝；母兽，母畜；<南非>水库；（牙科手术中的）橡皮障

【名】 （Dam）（美）丹（人名）

sentences.cn: 大坝决口了。

sentences.cn: 一个大坝决堤，淹没了他们的村子。

sentences.c: The dam burst under the weight of water.
sentences.cn: 大坝在水的巨大压力下溃决了。

name: damage
trans: n. （有形的）损坏，损失；损害，伤害；损害赔偿金；费用，代价

sentences.cn: 火灾造成了巨大的损失。

sentences.c: Happily, the damage was only slight.
sentences.cn: 所幸的是，损伤不大。

sentences.c: The damage was slight.
sentences.cn: 损失很小。

name: damp
trans: adj. 潮湿的

sentences.cn: 这小屋又冷又湿。

sentences.c: The outside walls are damp.
sentences.cn: 外墙潮湿。

sentences.c: Old houses are often damp.
sentences.cn: 老房子大多都潮湿。

name: dance
trans: v. 跳舞；跳（某种舞）；跳跃，雀跃；和……共舞；（某物）摆动，摇晃；（某人眼睛）因快乐（或激动）而闪烁

sentences.cn: 我们情不自禁地跳起舞来。

sentences.c: He can't dance for toffee!

name: danger

trans: adj. 危险的，有威胁的

sentences.cn: 这个男子有枪，是个危险分子。

sentences.cn: 这是一截危险路段。

sentences.cn: 他对她低下他那黑发的头。

sentences.cn: 部队已在黎明登陆。

sentences.cn: 他们在黎明时出发。

sentences.c: He arose at dawn.
sentences.cn: 他黎明即起。

sentences.cn: 他们在一天天地改进。

sentences.cn: 他的健康状况一天天好转。

sentences.cn: 假如他死了—那怎么办？

sentences.cn: 我怕得要死。

name: deadline

sentences.cn: 反战示威者们扰乱了辩论。

name: debt

sentences.cn: 我们终于偿清了债务。

sentences.c: Women have become more assertive in the past decade.
sentences.cn: 妇女在过去十年已变得更坚定自信。

sentences.c: At least one supernova occurs per decade in our galaxy.
sentences.cn: 每十年至少有一颗超新星在我们的银河系中出现。

sentences.c: Her husband had played the trombone in the band for a decade.
sentences.cn: 她丈夫已在这支乐队吹了十年的长号。

name: December
trans: n. 十二月

sentences.c: I keep forgetting it's December.
sentences.cn: 我总是忘了现在是12月份。

sentences.c: He departed his job December 16.
sentences.cn: 他于12月16日离职。

sentences.c: Prices edged up 2% in the year to December.
sentences.cn: 到12月为止的年度价格上涨了2%。

name: decide
trans: v. 影响（或决定）……的结果；断定，判定；使下决心；决定，选定；裁决，判决

sentences.c: It's up to you to decide.
sentences.cn: 这事由你来决定吧。

sentences.c: Whatever you decide, it's okay by me.
sentences.cn: 无论你怎么决定对我来说都行。

sentences.c: You have our support, whatever you decide.
sentences.cn: 不管你作何决定，都会得到我们的支持。

name: decision
trans: n. 决定，抉择；判决，裁定；果断，决断力；作决定，决策

sentences.c: Their decision was unanimous.
sentences.cn: 他们的决定是全体同意的。

sentences.c: I warmly welcome this decision.
sentences.cn: 我热烈欢迎这一决定。

sentences.c: You made the right decision.
sentences.cn: 你的决定是正确的。

name: declare
trans: v. 宣布，声明；断言，宣称；申报；放弃击球，宣布结束赛局

sentences.c: I declare this festival open.
sentences.cn: 我宣布庆祝活动开始。

sentences.c: Do you have anything to declare?
sentences.cn: 你有什么要申报的吗？

sentences.c: I declare this bridge open.
sentences.cn: 我宣布大桥正式启用。

name: decline
trans: v. 下降，衰退；拒绝，谢绝；变格，词形变化
n. 减少，衰退

sentences.c: The industry has slid into decline.
sentences.cn: 这个行业已成衰退之势。

sentences.c: Support for the party continues to decline.
sentences.cn: 对该党的支持继续下降。

sentences.c: They failed to arrest the company's decline.
sentences.cn: 他们未能阻止公司的衰落。

name: decorate
trans: v. 装饰，装点；粉刷，装修；授予（某人）勋章

sentences.c: The boys are planning to decorate when they get the time.
sentences.cn: 男孩们正计划在他们有时间的时候装修。

sentences.c: When he came to decorate the kitchen, Kenneth opted for a friendly rustic look.
sentences.cn: 当他来装修厨房时，肯尼思显出一副友好质朴的样子。

sentences.c: When they came to decorate the rear bedroom, it was Jemma who had the final say.
sentences.cn: 他们开始装修后卧室时，说了算的人是杰马。

name: decoration
trans: n. 装饰，装饰品；勋章，奖章；装潢，装饰风格

sentences.c: He gave Stephanie a free hand in the decoration.
sentences.cn: 他让斯蒂芬妮在装潢时便宜行事。

sentences.c: It was a building without any adornment or decoration.
sentences.cn: 它曾是一栋完全未经装修的大楼。

sentences.c: The room was austere, nearly barren of furniture or decoration.
sentences.cn: 这个房间很简朴，几乎没有什么家具或装饰。

name: decrease
trans: v. （使）减少，（使）降低
n. 减少，降低

sentences.c: People should decrease the amount of fat they eat.
sentences.cn: 人们应减少脂肪的摄入量。

sentences.c: It will sharply decrease work efficiency.
sentences.cn: 这会大幅降低工作效率。

sentences.c: There has been a decrease in traffic accidents.
sentences.cn: 交通事故减少了。

name: deed
trans: n. 行为，行动；契约，证书；功绩，英勇事迹
v. 立契转让

sentences.c: He is all talk and no deed.
sentences.cn: 他光说空话，没有行动。

sentences.c: My grandmother says a good deed is its own reward.
sentences.cn: 我的奶奶说，做好事本身就是一种回报。

sentences.c: Smith changed his name by deed poll to Jervis-Smith.
sentences.cn: 史密斯通过单边契据将自己的名字更改为杰维斯—史密斯。

name: deep
trans: adj. 深的，厚的；纵深的，宽的；有……深的；成……排的；深呼吸的；（声音）低沉的；深色的；酣睡的；严重的；（感情）深厚的；透彻的，深刻的；深奥的；全神贯注，深陷；（人）深沉的；（目光）锐利的，深邃的；靠近场地边界的；神秘的；<美>大幅下降的；<美>有很多优秀选手的
adv. 深深地，至深处；有……深；成……排地；靠近场地边界地
n. <文>海洋（the deep）；海洋深处（deeps）；<文>中间部分（the deep）；（板球）外围场地（the deep）
【名】 （Deep）迪普（人名）

sentences.c: He sank into deep melancholia.
sentences.cn: 他陷入了深深的忧郁。

sentences.c: The wardrobe was very deep.
sentences.cn: 橱柜很深。

sentences.c: She took a deep breath.
sentences.cn: 她深深地吸了一口气。

name: deeply
trans: adv. 很，非常；深刻地，深沉地；至深处

sentences.c: She breathed in deeply.
sentences.cn: 她深深地吸了气。

sentences.c: The recession remains deeply entrenched.
sentences.cn: 经济衰退仍然根深蒂固。

sentences.c: He breathed deeply before speaking again.
sentences.cn: 他深深吸一口气，然后继续说下去。

name: deer
trans: n. 鹿
n. （Deer）人名；（英）迪尔

sentences.c: Deer had stripped the tree of its bark.
sentences.cn: 鹿啃掉了树皮。

sentences.c: He'd gone deer hunting with his cousins.
sentences.cn: 他已和堂兄弟们猎鹿去了。

sentences.c: Deer had stripped all the bark off the tree.
sentences.cn: 鹿把树皮全都啃光了。

name: defeat
trans: v. 击败，战胜；困惑，难住；使失败，阻挠；反对（动议或提议）
n. 失败，战败；战胜，击败

sentences.c: They narrowly avoided defeat.
sentences.cn: 他们险些儿被打败。

sentences.c: He bamboozled Mercer into defeat.
sentences.cn: 他蒙骗默瑟并击败了他。

sentences.c: Defeat was staring them in the face.
sentences.cn: 他们必遭失败。

name: defence defences
trans: n. & v. 防御；防务【单数 复数】

sentences.c: Although certain coastal areas are heavily defended, these defences do not seem to be in any great depth, and it would appear that the Germans have concentrated their defence on the beaches.
sentences.cn: 虽然某些沿海地区有重兵把守，但这些防御工事似乎没有任何深度，这样看来，德军把海滩当作了自己防御的重点。

sentences.c: Missile defences cannot fend off Russia's huge Arsenal, but countries hosting them place themselves under America's umbrella, in effect becoming part of the defence of its homeland.
sentences.cn: 导弹防御系统根本无法应对俄罗斯庞大的军火库，但是对那些加入到导弹防御系统的国家来说，深层的意义在于他们通过这种方式被纳入了美国本土防御的一部分。

sentences.c: Defence companies such as Lockheed Martin have seen some of their cyber-defences penetrated.
sentences.cn: 许多公司如洛克希德·马丁航空公司等的网络防御都遭到渗透。

name: defend
trans: v. 保卫，防御；捍卫，维护；（在比赛中）防守，防卫；参加卫冕赛，蝉联；做……的辩护律师，为……辩解

sentences.c: The newspaper continues to defend its publication of the photographs.
sentences.cn: 这家报纸继续为刊登这些照片辩护。

sentences.c: How can you defend such behaviour?
sentences.cn: 你怎能为这种行为辩解呢？

sentences.c: If cornered, the snake will defend itself.
sentences.cn: 蛇在被逼得走投无路时会自卫的。

name: degree
trans: n. 度，度数（温度单位）；（角的）度，度数；学位课程，学位；程度；音级；次，次数；（形容词或副词的）级；共济会职务；<旧>社会地位，官衔

sentences.c: She's reading for a law degree.
sentences.cn: 她在攻读法学学位。

sentences.c: He studied French to degree level.
sentences.cn: 他的法语学到了拿学位的水平。

sentences.c: I'm hoping to do a chemistry degree.
sentences.cn: 我希望攻读化学学位课程。

name: delay
trans: v. 推迟，延期；延误，耽搁；（故意）拖延，磨蹭
n. 延期，推迟；延误，耽搁；延迟器
【名】 （Delay）（美）德莱（人名）

sentences.c: Can you delay him in some way?
sentences.cn: 你能用什么办法耽搁他一下吗？

sentences.c: They were impatient at the delay.
sentences.cn: 他们对拖延不耐烦了。

sentences.c: Any delay would be fatal.
sentences.cn: 任何延误都可能导致失败。

name: delete
trans: v. 删除
n. 删除键

sentences.c: I selected a file and pressed the delete key.
sentences.cn: 我选定了一份文件，然后按下了删除键。

sentences.c: After we delete their names, we have some results like Figure 21.
sentences.cn: 删除它们的名称之后，我们将得到如图21所示的结果。

sentences.c: Dreams organize the events of the day into folders and delete what is not needed.
sentences.cn: 在梦中，一天的事情被分门别类地整理好，而不必要的则会被删除。

name: deliberately
trans: adv. 故意地；从容不迫地，小心翼翼地

sentences.c: He spoke slowly and deliberately.
sentences.cn: 他说得缓慢而慎重。

sentences.c: Are you being deliberately obtuse?
sentences.cn: 你是不是故意装傻？

sentences.c: The wording was deliberately ambiguous.
sentences.cn: 这里的措辞故意模棱两可。

name: delicate
trans: adj. 柔和的，清淡的；虚弱的，纤弱的；脆弱的，易碎的；小巧玲珑的，纤细的；微妙的，棘手的；精致的，精巧的；灵巧的，熟练的；（仪器）灵敏的
n. 精美的衣物

sentences.c: The name Latifah, by the way, means "delicate."
sentences.cn: 顺便提一下，Latifah这个名字有“精致”之意。

sentences.c: She was physically delicate and psychologically unstable.
sentences.cn: 她身体纤弱，而且心理也不稳定。

sentences.c: Babies have very delicate skin.
sentences.cn: 婴儿的皮肤非常娇嫩。

name: delicious
trans: adj. 美味的，芬芳的；令人愉快的，宜人的

sentences.c: He served up a delicious meal.
sentences.cn: 他端上一顿可口的饭菜。

sentences.c: She served us a delicious lunch.
sentences.cn: 她招待我们吃了一顿可口的午餐。

sentences.c: They serve the most delicious roast beef.
sentences.cn: 他们做最美味的烤牛肉。

name: delight
trans: n. 高兴；令人高兴的人或物，乐事
v. 使高兴；以……为乐
【名】 （Delight）（英）迪莱特（人名）

sentences.c: They all cackled with delight.
sentences.cn: 他们都高兴得嘎嘎地笑。

sentences.c: She gave a chuckle of delight.
sentences.cn: 她高兴得轻声笑了出来。

sentences.c: She clapped her hands in delight.
sentences.cn: 她高兴地拍起手来。

name: delighted
trans: adj. 高兴的
v. 使高兴；以……为乐（delight 的过去式及过去分词）

sentences.c: I'm delighted at your news.
sentences.cn: 听到你的消息我非常高兴。

sentences.c: They expressed themselves delighted.
sentences.cn: 他们表示他们很高兴。

sentences.c: I'd be absolutely delighted to come.
sentences.cn: 我非常乐意前来。

name: deliver
trans: v. 投递，运送；履行，兑现；交付，移交；发表，宣布；接生，分娩；解救，拯救；投掷，击打；（法官或法庭）宣布（判决）；拉（选票）；发行，发布（计算机程序）；处理

sentences.c: We deliver the goods in batches.
sentences.cn: 我们分批交付货物。

sentences.c: The question is, can he deliver?
sentences.cn: 问题是他能履行吗？

sentences.c: We promise to deliver within 48 hours.
sentences.cn: 我们承诺在48小时内送到。

name: demand
trans: v. 强烈要求；需要，需求
n. 坚决的要求；需求，需求量；（困难的）要求
【名】 （Demand）（德）德曼德（人名）

sentences.c: Demand is outstripping supply.
sentences.cn: 需求快超过供给了。

sentences.c: Demand is outpacing production.
sentences.cn: 需求正在超过生产。

sentences.c: I demand to see the manager.
sentences.cn: 我坚决要求见经理。

name: dentist
trans: n. 牙科医生；牙医诊所

sentences.c: I have to go to the dentist tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 我明天得去看牙医。

sentences.c: The dentist scaled and polished my teeth.
sentences.cn: 牙医为我刮除牙石，抛光了牙齿。

sentences.c: He keeps putting off going to the dentist.
sentences.cn: 他把看牙医的事一拖再拖。

name: department
trans: n. （组织或机构中的）部，司，系，处，科；（商场里的）部；<非正式>专长，专责；（法国等国的）省

sentences.c: He moved to the sales department.
sentences.cn: 他调到了销售部。

sentences.c: She resigned as head of department.
sentences.cn: 她辞去了部门主管的职务。

sentences.c: His department will merge with mine.
sentences.cn: 他的部门将和我的合并。

name: department-store
trans: n. 百货商场【连字符】
百货商店：一家有各种商品分区的商店。

sentences.c: The department store at the four corners is the largest one in the city.
sentences.cn: 十字路口的那家百货商店是这个城市最大的一家。

sentences.c: Department store buyers purchase the goods that their stores sell.
sentences.cn: 百货公司的采购员购买他们商店出售的商品。

sentences.c: Spero is downscaling, shopping at middle-brow Dillard's department store near her suburban Cleveland home, instead of Neiman Marcus.
sentences.cn: 斯佩罗正在缩减开支，她不再去内曼•马库斯百货公司，而是去位于克利夫兰郊区家中附近的迪拉德百货公司购物。

name: departure
trans: n. 背离；离开，启程

sentences.c: His departure passed unnoticed.
sentences.cn: 他神不知、鬼不觉地离开了。

sentences.c: It was a radical departure from tradition.
sentences.cn: 这从根本上违背了传统。

sentences.c: His departure, in fact, went almost unremarked.
sentences.cn: 事实上，他的离去几乎没被注意到。

name: depend
trans: v. 取决于；依赖，依靠；相信，指望；那得看情况；（语法上）从属（depend on/upon）

sentences.c: Wage rates depend on levels of productivity.
sentences.cn: 工资水平取决于生产量的多寡。

sentences.c: Can you depend on her version of what happened?
sentences.cn: 你能相信她对所发生事情的描述吗？

sentences.c: Does the quality of teaching depend on class size?
sentences.cn: 教学质量取决于每个班的人数吗？

name: deposit
trans: v. 放下，放置；储蓄；存放，寄存；沉积，沉淀；支付（押金、订金或预缴费用）
n. 沉积物，沉积层；订金；押金；存款；竞选保证金

sentences.c: A 10% deposit is payable in advance.
sentences.cn: 须预付10%的押金。

sentences.c: Landlords can charge a returnable deposit.
sentences.cn: 房东可以收取一笔可退还的押金。

sentences.c: A returnable deposit is payable on arrival.
sentences.cn: 抵达时应支付可退还押金。

name: depth
trans: n. 深度，纵深；深刻，深奥；深厚，深切；（声音的）低沉；浓度，强度；严重性，严峻性；渊博，老练；纵深感，景深；最深处，极限；低迷状态，非常糟糕的状态

sentences.c: What's the depth of the water here?
sentences.cn: 这儿的水有多深？

sentences.c: The depth of the shaft is 520 yards.
sentences.cn: 这个通道的深度是520码。

sentences.c: His ideas lack depth.
sentences.cn: 他的想法缺乏深度。

name: describe
trans: v. 描述，形容；做……运动，形成……形状

sentences.c: Can you describe him to me?
sentences.cn: 你能向我描述一下他的样子吗？

sentences.c: A lexicographer's job is to describe the language.
sentences.cn: 词典编纂者的工作就是对语言加以描述。

sentences.c: His novels nicely describe life in Britain between the wars.
sentences.cn: 他的小说细致地描述了两次大战之间英国的生活状况。

name: description
trans: n. 描述，形容，说明；类型

sentences.c: The description was pretty vague.
sentences.cn: 这项描述是相当含糊的。

sentences.c: The description fits us to a tee.
sentences.cn: 这个描述恰好符合我们的情况。

sentences.c: They gave a general description of the man.
sentences.cn: 他们对这个男人作了大致的描述。

name: desert
trans: n. 沙漠，荒漠；荒凉的地方；应得的赏罚
v. 离弃，舍弃（某地）；抛弃，遗弃（某人）；背弃，放弃；擅离，开小差；突然丧失
adj. 无人居住的，荒凉的；像沙漠的

sentences.c: Somalia is mostly desert.
sentences.cn: 索马里大部分地区都是荒漠。

sentences.c: The heat in the desert was extreme.
sentences.cn: 沙漠中极其炎热。

sentences.c: They drove 600 miles across the desert.
sentences.cn: 他们驱车600英里横穿沙漠。

name: deserve
trans: v. 值得，应受

sentences.c: These proposals deserve careful study.
sentences.cn: 这些建议值得认真研究。

sentences.c: The players deserve a pat on the back.
sentences.cn: 运动员们值得表扬。

sentences.c: Government officials clearly deserve some of the blame as well.
sentences.cn: 政府官员们显然也应受到某些谴责。

name: design
trans: n. 设计，布局，安排；设计艺术，构思；设计图，图纸；图案，花纹；计划，意图
v. 设计，制图，构思；筹划，制订；预定，指定
【名】 （Design）（俄、巴、印）迪赛（人名）

sentences.c: She's good at art and design.
sentences.cn: 她擅长美术和设计。

sentences.c: The product is at the design stage.
sentences.cn: 产品处于设计阶段。

sentences.c: It was a simple but pleasing design.
sentences.cn: 这是一项简单但令人满意的设计。

name: desire
trans: n. 愿望，欲望，渴望；情欲，性欲
v. 渴望，想望；<正式>要求，请求；被……吸引，对……产生性欲
【名】 （Desire）（英、刚）德西雷（人名）

sentences.c: We all desire health and happiness.
sentences.cn: 我们都渴望健康和幸福。

sentences.c: The desire for revenge can be overpowering.
sentences.cn: 复仇的愿望会是抵挡不住的。

sentences.c: He was overestimating their desire for peace.
sentences.cn: 他高估了他们对和平的渴望。

name: desk
trans: n. 书桌，办公桌，写字台；服务台，问询台；（办理某项业务的）部门；乐谱架，演奏者席；<美>（报社）编辑部
adj. 书桌的，桌上适合用的

sentences.c: The desk looked undisturbed.
sentences.cn: 那张书桌子看上去没有被动过。

sentences.c: A phone trilled on the desk.
sentences.cn: 办公桌上的电话丁零零地响了。

sentences.c: She was sitting at her desk.

sentences.cn: 她朝他那个方向瞥了一眼。

sentences.cn: 风向已经变了。

name: director
trans: n. 导演；管理者，负责人；董事，理事

sentences.cn: 主任可能会损失最大。

sentences.c: She has only the director over her.
sentences.cn: 她的上司只有主任一个。

sentences.c: He was voted most promising new director.
sentences.cn: 他当选为最有前途的新导演。

name: directory
trans: n. 名址录，电话号码簿；（计算机的）目录，文件夹；<史>（尤指长老会和罗马天主教会的）礼拜规则书
adj. 指导的，咨询的

sentences.cn: 这一指令把文档从目录中删除。

sentences.c: You can use a directory service to search for people on the Internet.
sentences.cn: 你可以使用目录服务在因特网上搜索人。

name: dirt

sentences.cn: 我开始擦除灰尘。

sentences.cn: 他的衣服沾满了污垢。

sentences.c: I drove along the dirt road.
sentences.cn: 我行驶在一条土路上。

name: dirty
trans: adj. 肮脏的；下流的；卑鄙的，不诚实的；暗淡的；<美，非正式>吸毒的
v. 弄脏，使变脏；变脏
adv. 很，非常；卑鄙地，不诚实地

sentences.c: Don't get your dress dirty!
sentences.cn: 别把你的连衣裙弄脏了！

sentences.c: The sink was full of dirty dishes.
sentences.cn: 水池里满是脏碟子。

sentences.c: The bag was stuffed with dirty clothes.
sentences.cn: 袋子里塞满了脏衣服。

name: disability
trans: n. 残疾，缺陷；无能力，障碍；残疾补贴

sentences.cn: 我们都害怕伤残或体弱。

sentences.c: Disability is a physical limitation on your life.
sentences.cn: 残疾在身体方面限制了你的生活。

sentences.c: He qualifies for help on the grounds of disability.
sentences.cn: 他因身有残疾有资格得到帮助。

name: disabled
trans: adj. 丧失能力的，有残疾的；（活动、组织、设施）与残疾人有关的
v. 使丧失能力，使伤残；使不能运转（disable 的过去式和过去分词形式）

sentences.cn: 一帮混混儿羞辱了一个残疾人。

sentences.c: He was born disabled.
sentences.cn: 他天生残疾。

sentences.c: She did not perceive herself as disabled.
sentences.cn: 她没有把自己看成残疾人。

name: disadvantage
trans: n. 不利条件，劣势；不利因素；损失，损害
vt. 使处于不利地位，损害

sentences.cn: 主要的不利条件是什么？

sentences.c: We're labouring under an unfair disadvantage.
sentences.cn: 我们在不公平的劣势下艰难地工作。

sentences.cn: 我缺少实际经验是个不利条件。

name: disagree
trans: v. 有分歧，意见不合；不一致；不适宜，使……不舒服

sentences.cn: 即便是朋友有时也有分歧。

sentences.cn: “我不同意。”波利拒不妥协地说。

sentences.c: We disagree with every point she makes.
sentences.cn: 我们不同意她提出的任何观点。

name: disagreement
trans: n. 分歧，争论；不符，不一致

sentences.cn: 分歧的缘起在于专门用语使用的不同。

sentences.cn: 这种疗法是否安全争论很大。

sentences.c: The disagreement over trade tariffs has soured relations between the two countries.
sentences.cn: 贸易关税上的分歧导致两国关系恶化。

name: disappear
trans: v. 消失，不见；失踪，丢失；不复存在，灭绝

sentences.c: They watched the bus disappear into the distance.
sentences.cn: 他们注视着公共汽车消失在远方。

sentences.c: It was uncharacteristic of her father to disappear like this.
sentences.cn: 就这样消失不是她父亲的风格。

sentences.c: The problems of traffic congestion will not disappear in a hurry.
sentences.cn: 交通堵塞问题不会很快消失。

name: disappoint
trans: v. 使失望；使破灭，使落空

sentences.c: His latest novel does not disappoint.
sentences.cn: 他最近发表的这部小说没有使人失望。

sentences.c: Her decision to cancel the concert is bound to disappoint her fans.
sentences.cn: 她决定取消这场音乐会，肯定会使她的歌迷失望。

sentences.c: She would do anything she could to please him, but she knew that she was fated to disappoint him.
sentences.cn: 她愿意做任何事情来讨好他，但她知道她注定会让他失望。

name: disappointment
trans: n. 失望，沮丧；令人失望的人，让人扫兴的事

sentences.cn: 她很失望，但表现得很大度。

sentences.c: She managed to hide her disappointment.
sentences.cn: 她设法掩藏住自己的失望。

sentences.c: She wept bitter tears of disappointment.
sentences.cn: 她失望得痛哭流涕。

name: disaster
trans: n. 灾难，灾害；祸患，灾难性事物；彻底的失败

sentences.cn: 及时防止了一场灾难。

sentences.c: Disaster threatens on every side.
sentences.cn: 灾祸四伏。

sentences.c: This will surely end in disaster.
sentences.cn: 这无疑将以灾难告终。

name: discount
trans: n. 减价，折扣；（汇票或期票到期前转手的）贴现率

sentences.cn: 你们打折吗？

sentences.cn: 它们经常可以以折扣价买到。

sentences.cn: 所有全职员工都可以享受8折优惠。

name: discourage
trans: v. 使泄气，使灰心；使打消念头，劝阻；阻碍

sentences.cn: 他的父母试图阻止他去当演员。

sentences.c: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
sentences.cn: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。

sentences.c: He explained the yellow fever epidemic as a providential act to discourage urban growth.
sentences.cn: 他对黄热病疫情对城市化进程的阻碍为一种巧合做出了解释。

name: discover
trans: v. 发现，找到；了解到，发觉，查明；发掘（人才）；初次接触

sentences.c: Only later did she discover a talent for writing.
sentences.cn: 她后来才发现自己的写作天分。

sentences.c: We happened to discover we had a friend in common.
sentences.cn: 我们碰巧发现我们有个共同的朋友。

sentences.c: Wind forward to the bit where they discover the body.
sentences.cn: 往前绕片，绕到他们发现尸体的那一截。

name: discovery
trans: n. 发现，被发现的事物；（法律）强制性透露

sentences.c: Police have made a macabre discovery.
sentences.cn: 警察有了个可怕的发现。

sentences.c: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
sentences.cn: 我感到自己有了一个惊人的发现。

sentences.c: This discovery challenges traditional beliefs.
sentences.cn: 这项发现是对传统信念的冲击。

name: discrimination
trans: n. 歧视，区别对待；区分，辨别；辨别力，鉴赏力

sentences.cn: 她不用遵守性别歧视法规。

sentences.cn: 妇女组织谴责性别歧视。

sentences.cn: “这么做” 布特莱齐先生愤怒地说，“是歧视。”

name: discuss
trans: v. 讨论，辩论；详述，论述

sentences.cn: 他们有些重要的问题要讨论。

sentences.cn: 我们在星期一的会上讨论这件事儿。

sentences.c: It's hardly the time to discuss it now.
sentences.cn: 现在还不是讨论的时候。

name: discussion
trans: n. 讨论；论述，详述；谈话，辩论

sentences.cn: 讨论的时间已过。

sentences.cn: 你是在追求我吗？多么恶心！

sentences.cn: 摄影机最终将镜头推远。

sentences.c: Troops eventually quelled the unrest.
sentences.cn: 部队最终镇压了动乱。

sentences.c: Eventually the search was called off.
sentences.cn: 搜查最后被取消了。

name: ever
trans: adv. 曾经，从来，在任何时候；一直，始终；越来越，愈发；究竟，到底；非常，确实
【名】 （Ever）（英）埃弗，（俄）叶韦尔，（西、法）埃韦尔（人名）

sentences.c: Is infidelity ever forgivable?
sentences.cn: 配偶的不忠行为究竟可以被原谅吗？

sentences.c: It's my best ever score.
sentences.cn: 这是我得到过的最好分数。

sentences.c: He said he would love her for ever (and ever).
sentences.cn: 他说会永远爱她。

name: every
trans: det. 每个，每一；每……之中的；每隔，每逢（表频率）；所有可能的，完全可能的
【名】 （Every）（美、荷、瑞典）埃夫里（人名）

sentences.c: I go jogging every evening.
sentences.cn: 我每天晚上都慢跑锻炼。

sentences.c: Every individual learns differently.
sentences.cn: 每个人的学习方式都不一样。

sentences.c: Every move was painful.
sentences.cn: 每动一下都很痛。

name: everybody
trans: pron. 每个人，人人

sentences.c: The news heartened everybody.
sentences.cn: 这个消息鼓舞了每个人。

sentences.c: Everybody ready? It's showtime!
sentences.cn: 大家都准备好了吗？开演！

sentences.c: Everybody laughs at my accent.
sentences.cn: 大家都拿我的口音取笑。

name: everyday
trans: adj. 日常的，每天的

sentences.c: The Internet has become part of everyday life.
sentences.cn: 互联网已成为日常生活的一部分。

sentences.c: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence.
sentences.cn: 投诉似乎成了天天发生的事。

sentences.c: Her novels are anchored in everyday experience.
sentences.cn: 她的小说取材自日常生活经验。

name: everyone
trans: pron. 每个人；人人

sentences.c: The news astonished everyone.
sentences.cn: 这消息使大家十分惊讶。

sentences.c: Everyone began talking at once.
sentences.cn: 大家同时开始讲话。

sentences.c: Everyone cheered and clapped.
sentences.cn: 人人都鼓掌欢呼。

name: everything
trans: pron. 每件事物，（有关的）一切，万事；形势，情况；最重要的东西
n. （Everything）（印、美、澳）艾维辛（人名）

sentences.c: That day, everything gelled.
sentences.cn: 那天，一切都很顺利。

sentences.c: Did everything go smoothly?
sentences.cn: 一切进行得都顺利吗？

sentences.c: Everything is just ducky.
sentences.cn: 一切顺利。

name: everywhere
trans: adv. 到处
n. 每个地方

sentences.c: I saw her picture everywhere.
sentences.cn: 我到处看到她的照片。

sentences.c: Smoking was forbidden everywhere.
sentences.cn: 吸烟到处都是被禁止的。

sentences.c: Fires were breaking out everywhere.
sentences.cn: 到处都在发生火灾。

name: evidence
trans: n. 根据，证明；（呈上法庭的）证据，证词；迹象，痕迹
v. 证实，证明

sentences.c: The evidence is against him.
sentences.cn: 证据对他不利。

sentences.c: I had no concrete evidence.
sentences.cn: 我当时没有明确而具体的证据。

sentences.c: Evidence is plentifully available.
sentences.cn: 证据俯拾即是。

name: evident
trans: adj. 清楚的，显然的

sentences.c: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
sentences.cn: 通货膨胀的威胁在证券价格上已经是明显可见的。

sentences.c: It was evident that someone had gone through my possessions.
sentences.cn: 显然有人翻过我的物品。

sentences.c: The privations of monastery life were evident in his appearance.
sentences.cn: 修道院生活的清苦从他的穿着外表明显地表露出来。

name: evolution
trans: n. 进化（论）；演变，发展；（气体的）释放，（热量的）散发；队形变换，位置变换；<旧>开方

sentences.c: Darwin eventually put forward a model of biological evolution.
sentences.cn: 达尔文最终提出了一套生物进化的理论模式。

sentences.c: We're dealing with probably the biggest missing link in what we know about human evolution.
sentences.cn: 我们正在解决的可能是我们所知的人类进化过程中缺失最大的一环。

sentences.c: I have moved from trying to model and understand the distribution and evolution of water vapour.
sentences.cn: 我已经不再试图构建和理解水汽的分布和演变的理论模式了。

name: exact
trans: adj. 确切的，精确的；严谨的，一丝不苟的；精密的，严密的
v. 强取，勒索；实施（报复）；造成重大苦难（或损失等）

sentences.c: I don't remember the exact words.
sentences.cn: 我不记得确切的话了。

sentences.c: What is the exact location of the ship?
sentences.cn: 那条船的确切位置在哪里？

sentences.c: The exact length of each period may vary.
sentences.cn: 每一时期的确切持续时间可能有所不同。

name: exactly
trans: adv. 精确地，确切地；（用于强调）恰好，完全；（要求得到更多信息）究竟，到底；<非正式>正是如此，一点不错

sentences.c: Your answer is exactly right.
sentences.cn: 你的回答完全正确。

sentences.c: That's exactly what I think.
sentences.cn: 我正是那么想的。

sentences.c: What exactly do you mean?
sentences.cn: 你到底什么意思？

name: exam = examination
trans: n. 考试，测试；检查；审查

sentences.c: The frequency of errors in grammar and punctuation has become a serious concern, the State Examination Commission said in a report after reviewing last year's exam performance by 15-year-olds.
sentences.cn: 爱尔兰国家考试委员会在针对去年15岁学生考试成绩的评论报告中称，语法和标点错误频频出现，已成为一个严重的问题。

sentences.c: Teachers themselves are often judged by examination results and instead of teaching their subjects, they are reduced to training their students in exam techniques which they despise.
sentences.cn: 对老师本人教学水平的评判通常就是看学生的考试成绩。老师们不去教授他们的课，而是简化教学，对学生进行他们嗤之以鼻的考试技巧培训。

sentences.c: We should adjust good face and use good exam skills. Grasp the examination method that first easy then difficult. Take basic points, and win a high score.
sentences.cn: 我们要调整好临场心态，运用好考试技巧，掌握先易后难，先熟后生的考试方法。拿足基本分，争取得高分。

name: examine
trans: v. 检查，调查；考核，测验；（医生）诊察；（尤指在法庭上）审问，查问

sentences.c: It is necessary to examine how the proposals can be carried out.
sentences.cn: 有必要调查一下怎样才能实施这些方案。

sentences.c: We examine the wording in detail before deciding on the final text.
sentences.cn: 我们详细检查了措辞，才确定了最终文本。

sentences.c: The committee will examine the agreement and any problems arising therefrom.
sentences.cn: 委员会将审查这项协议和由此引起的问题。

name: example
trans: n. 例子，例证；榜样，楷模；典型，范例；例句，例题；警戒，受罚（以示警告）者
v. 得到说明，可加以举例说明

sentences.c: Let me give you an example.
sentences.cn: 让我来举一个例子吧。

sentences.c: She is a shining example to us all.
sentences.cn: 她是我们所有人的光辉榜样。

sentences.c: Her courage is an example to us all.
sentences.cn: 她的勇气是我们大家的榜样。

name: excellent
trans: adj. 极好的，卓越的
int. 太好了

sentences.c: The recording quality is excellent.
sentences.cn: 录制质量极好。

sentences.c: Her musicianship is excellent.
sentences.cn: 她的演奏技巧非常棒。

sentences.c: She speaks excellent French.
sentences.cn: 她法语说得好极了。

name: except
trans: prep. 除……外，不包括
conj. 除了，只是；要不是
v. 不包括，把……排除在外

sentences.c: We work every day except Sunday.
sentences.cn: 我们除星期天外每天都工作。

sentences.c: They all came except Matt.
sentences.cn: 除马特外他们都来了。

sentences.c: I like all sports except football.
sentences.cn: 除足球外我喜欢所有的运动。

name: exchange
trans: n. 交换，互换；短暂的交谈，争吵；交战，交火；兑换，汇兑；交流，互访；交易所；（商品的）调换；电话局，电话交换台；换子，兑子
v. 调换，更换；交流，交谈；交换，互换；兑换，交易

sentences.c: Shares soared on the New York stock exchange.
sentences.cn: 纽约证券交易所股票暴涨。

sentences.c: We only exchange notes and traveller's cheques.
sentences.cn: 我们只兑换纸币和旅行支票。

sentences.c: Trading on the stock exchange may be suspended.
sentences.cn: 股票交易可能被暂停。

name: excite
trans: v. 使兴奋，使激动；引起，激起；使（身体或身体系统某部份）活动，刺激……的活动；使产生性欲

sentences.c: Daniel's early exposure to motor racing did not excite his interest.
sentences.cn: 丹尼尔早期对赛车运动的接触并没有激起他的兴趣。

sentences.c: We tend to have a good memory for things that excite our senses or appeal to our emotions.
sentences.cn: 我们往往记得那些能够激起我们的共鸣或者诉诸情感的事物。

sentences.c: Such a view, however, fails to explain the ability of some works of art to excite the human mind.
sentences.cn: 然而，这种观点并不能解释为什么某些艺术作品能够激发人类思维。

name: excuse
trans: n. 借口，托词；正当理由；宽恕，赦免；拙劣样品，蹩脚货；<美>（医生或父母为学生写的）病假条，请假条
v. 原谅，宽恕；辩解，开脱；准许……离开；同意免除

sentences.c: She served up the usual excuse.
sentences.cn: 她给出的借口还是老一套。

sentences.c: Excuse me, is this your seat?
sentences.cn: 对不起，这是您的座位吗？

sentences.c: Excuse my interrupting you.
sentences.cn: 对不起，打扰你一下。

name: exercise
trans: n. 运动，锻炼；（一套）动作，体操；练习，演练；运用；活动，任务；典礼；宗教仪式，礼拜
v. 运动，锻炼；运用，行使；使担忧，使烦恼；驯，遛

sentences.c: Do you take regular exercise?
sentences.cn: 你经常锻炼吗？

sentences.c: Exercise tones up your body.
sentences.cn: 运动强健身体。

sentences.c: Riding a bike is great exercise.
sentences.cn: 骑自行车是很好的锻炼。

name: exhibition
trans: n. 展览，展出；表现，展示；<美>表演赛；<英>奖学金

sentences.c: The exhibition is held annually.
sentences.cn: 这个展览每年举行一次。

sentences.c: His exhibition opens on February 5.
sentences.cn: 他的展览2月5日开幕。

sentences.c: Have you seen the Picasso exhibition?
sentences.cn: 你看过毕加索的画展吗？

name: exist
trans: v. 存在，实际上有；持续存在，生存

sentences.c: The magic cure for inflation does not exist.
sentences.cn: 解决通货膨胀的神奇方法并不存在。

sentences.c: Does life exist on other planets?
sentences.cn: 其他行星上有生命吗？

sentences.c: Many possible orderings may exist.
sentences.cn: 组合方式可能有许多种。

name: existence
trans: n. 存在，实有；生存，生活，生活方式；<古>存在物，实体

sentences.c: I lead a pretty mundane existence.
sentences.cn: 我过着相当平淡的生活。

sentences.c: Surely my existence cannot be so purposeless?
sentences.cn: 想必，我的存在不可能如此毫无意义吧？

sentences.c: She felt estranged from her former existence.
sentences.cn: 她感到自己已脱离了过去的生活方式。

name: exit
trans: n. 出口，通道，太平门；（车辆驶出公路的）出路；离去；退出；<文>去世，死亡
v. 退出（电脑程序）；退场（剧本里的舞台指示）；<文>去世，死亡；摊牌让分；离去

sentences.c: There was a stampede for the exit.
sentences.cn: 出现了人群向出口的狂奔。

sentences.c: The crowd made a mad rush for the exit.
sentences.cn: 人群疯狂地冲向出口处。

sentences.c: He made a quick exit to avoid meeting her.
sentences.cn: 他迅速离去以避免见到她。

name: expand
trans: v. 扩大，增加；扩展，发展；细谈，详述；变得更自信（善谈）；（宇宙）膨胀

sentences.c: We have to expand the size of the image.
sentences.cn: 我们不得不扩大图像的尺寸。

sentences.c: The country was trying to expand territorially.
sentences.cn: 这个国家在设法扩张领土。

sentences.c: It was just a passing comment, he didn't expand.
sentences.cn: 那只是顺便提到的评论，他没有展开。

name: expect
trans: v. 期待；预计；要求，指望；认为；怀孕

sentences.c: Don't expect it to improve overnight.
sentences.cn: 不要指望这事一下子就改善了。

sentences.c: Don't expect others to read your mind.
sentences.cn: 不要期望别人能看出你的心思。

sentences.c: Both leaders seemed to expect measurable progress.
sentences.cn: 两位领导人好像都期待着显著的进展。

name: expectation
trans: n. 期待，预期；期望，指望

sentences.c: There was an air of expectation and great curiosity.
sentences.cn: 有着一种期待和好奇的感觉。

sentences.c: I applied for the post more in hope than expectation.
sentences.cn: 我申请这个职位是希望多于期待。

sentences.c: We are confident in our expectation of a full recovery.
sentences.cn: 我们满怀信心地期待着完全康复。

name: expense
trans: n. 代价，费用；业务费用，报销（expenses）；需要花钱的东西，花销的东西
v. <非正式>把……记入费用账户；向……收取费用；被花掉

sentences.c: He can comfortably afford the extra expense.
sentences.cn: 他支付这些额外的费用毫无问题。

sentences.c: Running a car is a big expense.
sentences.cn: 养一辆车开销很大。

sentences.c: Let's celebrate and damn the expense!
sentences.cn: 管它花多少钱，咱们先庆祝一番再说！

name: expensive
trans: adj. 花钱多的，昂贵的；（错误或决定）代价高的

sentences.c: Food was scarce and expensive.
sentences.cn: 食物匮乏而且昂贵。

sentences.c: Skiing gear can be expensive.
sentences.cn: 滑雪用具有时会很昂贵。

sentences.c: Tickets are likely to be expensive.
sentences.cn: 入场券可能很贵。

name: experience
trans: n. 经历，往事；经验，阅历；传统
v. 经历，遭遇；体会到，感受到

sentences.c: It was a cathartic experience.
sentences.cn: 那是一次情感宣泄的体验。

sentences.c: It was a terrifying experience.
sentences.cn: 那是一次可怕的经历。

sentences.c: It was a chastening experience.
sentences.cn: 那是一次令人遗憾的经历。

name: experiment
trans: n. 实验，试验；尝试，实践
v. 进行实验，做试验；试，尝试

sentences.c: I decided to conduct an experiment.
sentences.cn: 我决定做一项实验。

sentences.c: The experiment went horribly wrong.
sentences.cn: 实验弄得一塌糊涂。

sentences.c: As an experiment, we bought Ted a watch.
sentences.cn: 作为尝试，我们给特德买了块手表。

name: expert
trans: n. 专家，能手，权威
adj. 专业的，熟练的
v. 当专家
【名】 （Expert）（法、印、俄、罗、巴、荷）埃克斯佩（人名）

sentences.c: He considers himself an expert.
sentences.cn: 他认为自己是专家。

sentences.c: We'll need an expert opinion.
sentences.cn: 我们将需要专家的意见。

sentences.c: I don't claim to be an expert.
sentences.cn: 我不敢自称为专家。

name: explain
trans: v. 解释，说明；说明（……的）原因，解释（……的）理由

sentences.c: It's pretty hard to explain.
sentences.cn: 这事很难解释清楚。

sentences.c: Explain why you didn't telephone.
sentences.cn: 解释一下你为什么不打电话。

sentences.c: Can you explain that point again?
sentences.cn: 你能再解释一下那一点吗？

name: explanation
trans: n. 解释，说明；解释性说法，说明性文字；理由，原因

sentences.c: There was a logical explanation.
sentences.cn: 存在一个合理的解释。

sentences.c: He didn't get a decent explanation.
sentences.cn: 他没有得到一个合理的解释。

sentences.c: I'd like an explanation.
sentences.cn: 我想要一个解释。

name: explicit
trans: adj. 清楚明白的，明确的，详述的；直截了当的，坦率的；赤裸裸表现性爱（或暴力）的，露骨的
n. （手稿、早期印刷品或礼拜仪式上唱诗的）结束语

sentences.c: He gave me very explicit directions on how to get there.
sentences.cn: 他清楚地向我说明了去那儿的路线。

sentences.c: Should they have explicit permission?
sentences.cn: 他们应该有明确的许可吗？

sentences.c: It makes their expressions more explicit.
sentences.cn: 这让他们的表达更加直白明确。

name: explode
trans: v. （使）爆炸，（使）爆破；急剧扩大，激增；（情感）迸发，爆发；推翻，破除；爆响，发出巨响；迅速移动

sentences.c: The bomb was primed, ready to explode.
sentences.cn: 炸弹已准备好，可随时引爆。

sentences.c: The bomb must explode within less than a millionth of a second.
sentences.cn: 那枚炸弹必须在百万分之一秒内爆炸。

sentences.c: At last, a women's magazine to explode the myth that thin equals beautiful.
sentences.cn: 终于有一家妇女杂志起来推翻瘦即美的神话。

name: exploit
trans: v. 剥削，压榨；利用（……为自己谋利）；运用，发挥；开发，开拓
n. 英勇事迹，壮举；大胆的表演，不凡的身手

sentences.c: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology.
sentences.cn: 正如计算机系统变得越来越复杂，开发计算机技术的人所采用的方法也日趋复杂。

sentences.c: What do you think my last exploit was?
sentences.cn: 你觉得我最后一项功绩是什么？

sentences.c: Modern technology is good enough to exploit all the sea resources.
sentences.cn: 现代技术足以开发所有的海洋资源。

name: explore
trans: v. 探讨，探究；考察，探索；（用手或身体其他部位）探查，仔细检查

sentences.c: We will explore every avenue until we find an answer.
sentences.cn: 我们要探索一切途径，直到找到答案为止。

sentences.c: I want to explore and get in touch with my inner self.
sentences.cn: 我想认真探索，了解我内在的个性。

sentences.c: I just wanted to explore on my own.
sentences.cn: 我只是想独自考察一下。

name: explorer
trans: n. 探险者，勘探者

sentences.c: The default setting on Windows Explorer will not show these files.
sentences.cn: 视窗浏览器上的默认系统设定不显示这些文档。

sentences.c: Captain Cook was an explorer of the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.cn: 库克船长是太平洋的探险家。

sentences.c: Just then, a third man arrived: Japanese explorer Nobu Shirase.
sentences.cn: 正在这时，第三个人来了：日本探险家 Nobu Shirase。

name: export
trans: v. 出口；传播，输出；（在计算机中）导出，输出
n. 出口，输出；出口物，输出品；出口量，出口收入
adj. 出口的

sentences.c: Ghana's main export is cocoa.
sentences.cn: 加纳的主要出口产品是可可。

sentences.c: Our main export is rice.
sentences.cn: 我们主要出口大米。

sentences.c: Export sales were up by 32% last year.
sentences.cn: 去年出口销售额增长了32%。

name: expose
trans: v. 暴露，使显露；使面临，使遭受（危险或不快）；揭露，揭发；接触，体验；露出，显露（感情）；使（胶卷）曝光；弃（婴孩）于户外让其死去
n. 揭露，曝光

sentences.c: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
sentences.cn: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

sentences.c: My job as a journalist is to expose the truth.
sentences.cn: 我作为记者的职责就是展示事实。

sentences.c: He did not want to expose his fears and insecurity to anyone.
sentences.cn: 他不想向任何人显露他的恐惧与不安。

name: express
trans: v. 表达，表露；表现，体现；（用数学方法）表示；压榨，挤压出（空气或液体）；特快发运
n. 快车；快递；初速大的猎枪；专使；捷运公司
adj. 快递的，特快的；明确的；特意的
adv. 用快递寄送

sentences.c: Words cannot express my sorrow.
sentences.cn: 语言不能表达我的悲伤。

sentences.c: Words cannot express how pleased I am.
sentences.cn: 言语无法表达我的愉快心情。

sentences.c: I'd like to send this express, please.
sentences.cn: 劳驾，我要寄快递。

name: expression
trans: n. 表达，表示；表情，神情；（表演、歌唱或演奏时的）情感表现；词语，措词；式，表达式；挤压

sentences.c: Her expression suddenly altered.
sentences.cn: 她的表情突然变了。

sentences.c: Her expression was glacial.
sentences.cn: 她表情冷淡。

sentences.c: Her expression grew solemn.
sentences.cn: 她的表情显得严肃起来。

name: extension
trans: n. 延伸，扩展；展期，延长期；扩建部分，延伸部分；（电话）分机；扩展名；（为非全日制学生开设的）进修部；牵伸（术）；外延；广延（性）

sentences.c: They've built an extension on.
sentences.cn: 他们进行了一项扩建。

sentences.c: What's your extension number?
sentences.cn: 你的分机号码是多少？

sentences.c: She can get me on extension 308.
sentences.cn: 她可以通过分机308找到我。

name: extra
trans: adj. 额外的；另外收费的
n. 另收费的事物；临时演员；（非击球所得的）附加分；<旧>（报纸的）号外
adv. 额外；特别，格外

sentences.c: Running shoes have extra cushioning.
sentences.cn: 跑鞋有额外的减震设计。

sentences.c: She won't pay any extra.
sentences.cn: 她不会支付任何额外费用。

sentences.c: She tried extra hard.
sentences.cn: 她特别努力。

name: extraordinary
trans: adj. 异乎寻常的，令人惊奇的；非凡的，卓越的；特别的，临时的；特大（或多）的；特派的，特命的
n. （公司正常业务活动之外的）非常账目，特支款项

sentences.c: She is a designer of extraordinary versatility.
sentences.cn: 她是位特别多才多艺的设计师。

sentences.c: His behaviour was extraordinary and inexplicable.
sentences.cn: 他的行为离奇且令人费解。

sentences.c: Her writings have extraordinary depth and solidity.
sentences.cn: 她写的东西立意极深，内容特别充实。

name: extreme
trans: adj. 极大的，极度的；极端的，严重的；过分的，偏激的；尽头的，末端的；极限的，从事极限运动的
n. （观点或行为方式的）极端；（事物的）极度；端顶，端词

sentences.c: His views tend towards the extreme.
sentences.cn: 他的观点趋于偏激。

sentences.c: His politics are extreme.
sentences.cn: 他的政治观点偏激。

sentences.c: The heat in the desert was extreme.
sentences.cn: 沙漠中极其炎热。

name: extremely
trans: adv. 极度，非常

sentences.c: This species is extremely rare.
sentences.cn: 这一物种极为罕见。

sentences.c: I found her extremely irritating.
sentences.cn: 我觉得她极其令人恼火。

sentences.c: My mobile phone is extremely useful.
sentences.cn: 我的手机极为有用。

name: eye
trans: n. 眼睛；目光，所看之处；眼力，鉴赏力；眼光，视角；观点，态度；（钩）环，扣眼；（马铃薯上的）芽眼，芽；（飓风等风暴的）风眼；拍摄对象，取景器；（电）眼，（红外）眼，眼状探测装置；针眼，针鼻儿
v. 注视，仔细打量
【名】 （Eye）（英）艾，（德）艾厄（人名）

sentences.c: The film has a painterly eye.
sentences.cn: 这部电影有种绘画的眼光。

sentences.c: His left eye squints a little.
sentences.cn: 他左眼有点斜视。

sentences.c: I have something in my eye.
sentences.cn: 我的眼睛里进了什么东西。

name: eyesight
trans: n. 目力，视力

sentences.c: His eyesight is getting dim.
sentences.cn: 他的视力越来越差。

sentences.c: Her eyesight is failing.
sentences.cn: 她的视力日渐衰退。

sentences.c: He was not a particularly good shot because of his eyesight.
sentences.cn: 他由于视力缘故并不是一个特别好的射手。

name: eyewitness
trans: n. 目击者；见证人

sentences.c: Many factors influence the accuracy of eyewitness testimony.
sentences.cn: 许多因素影响目击者证词的准确性。

sentences.c: An eyewitness identified him as the shooter.
sentences.cn: 一位目击者指证他就是那个枪手。

sentences.c: He is the eyewitness of the car accident.
sentences.cn: 他是这场车祸的目击者。

name: female
trans: adj. 女性的，妇女的；女性特有的；由女性组成的；内孔的；雌性的，母的；雌蕊的
n. 雌性动物，雌性植物；女子

sentences.c: Oestrogen is a female sex hormone.
sentences.cn: 雌激素是一种雌性荷尔蒙。

sentences.c: Two of the candidates must be female.
sentences.cn: 候选人中必须有两名是女性。

sentences.c: The audience was almost entirely female.
sentences.cn: 观众几乎全是女性。

name: face
trans: n. 脸，面部；面部表情，脸色；人；初看，初听；尊严，威信；面貌；（物体的）正面，表面；斜坡，山坡；钟面，表盘；采掘面，工作面；（球拍的）拍面；（尤指足球的）球门
v. 面临，遭遇；正视，面对；与……交往，与……交谈；面向，面朝；迎战，对阵；抹盖，覆盖；接受，容忍
【名】 （Face）（法）法斯，（意）法切（人名）

sentences.c: Her face registered disapproval.
sentences.cn: 她脸上流露出不赞同的神色。

sentences.c: Her eyes flicked from face to face.
sentences.cn: 她的眼光扫过人们的脸。

sentences.c: Toby's face puckered.
sentences.cn: 托比的脸皱了起来。

name: facial
trans: adj. 面部的，面部用的
n. 面部护理，美容

sentences.c: There are exercises that tauten facial muscles.
sentences.cn: 有些练习可以让面部肌肉紧绷起来。

sentences.c: Where's the best place to get a facial in New York City?
sentences.cn: 在纽约做美容最好的地方在哪儿？

sentences.c: Cross didn't answer; his facial expression didn't change.
sentences.cn: 克罗斯没有回答；他的面部表情没有改变。

name: fact
trans: n. 事实，真相；现实

sentences.c: Her argument was grounded in fact.
sentences.cn: 她的论述以事实为根据。

sentences.c: That was a conjecture, not a fact.
sentences.cn: 那是个推测，不是事实。

sentences.c: But was it, in fact, a hideous goof?
sentences.cn: 但其实这真的是很可笑的错误吗？

name: factory
trans: n. 工厂，制造厂；（在外国的）代理店

sentences.c: A strike has shut the factory.
sentences.cn: 罢工使工厂停业。

sentences.c: The factory is in dire straits.
sentences.cn: 工厂岌岌可危。

sentences.c: That old factory is a real eyesore!
sentences.cn: 那老工厂实在碍眼！

name: fade
trans: v. 逐渐消失；（使）褪色，（使）变暗；枯萎，凋谢；变得虚弱；退步；（车辆的刹车因摩擦发热而）暂时失灵；（使）（电影或电视画面）淡入（或淡出）另一画面；变得默默无闻，变得无关紧要；（高尔夫球）偏离直线；<美，非正式>接受（掷骰子者）的打赌
n. 淡入，淡出；褪色，变暗；（高尔夫球运动员故意击出的）向右偏离球
adj. 平淡的，乏味的
【名】 （Fade）（法）法德（人名）

sentences.c: The colour in this material does not fade.
sentences.cn: 这布料不褪色。

sentences.c: Further, natural dyes tended to be muddy in hue and fade quickly.
sentences.cn: 此外，天然染料往往是浑浊的颜色而且它们很快褪色。

sentences.c: My resentment of her slowly began to fade.
sentences.cn: 我对她的怨恨慢慢地开始消退了。

name: fail
trans: v. 失败；未能做到，未能做；辜负，使失望；不及格，未能通过；出故障，失灵；衰弱，衰退；破产，倒闭；歉收；不下雨，下雨少；忘记
n. 不及格；<非正式>过失，失败
【名】 （Fail）（葡、捷）法伊尔，（法）法伊（人名）

sentences.c: He won't allow himself to fail.
sentences.cn: 他不容许自己失败。

sentences.c: What will you do if you fail?
sentences.cn: 如果你考试失败打算干什么？

sentences.c: Me? Fail? I don't think so.
sentences.cn: 我？失败？我可不这样认为。

name: failure
trans: n. 失败；失败的人（或企业、事物）；未做到；缺乏，不足；故障，衰退；公司倒闭；歉收；突然失去

sentences.c: The plan was doomed to failure.
sentences.cn: 这个计划注定要失败。

sentences.c: I felt foolish and a failure.
sentences.cn: 我自觉是个愚蠢的失败者。

sentences.c: Failure can demotivate students.
sentences.cn: 失败会挫伤学生的积极性。

name: fair
trans: adj. 公平的；合理的，公正的；相当好的；（数量、大小）相当大的；浅色的，（肤色）白皙的，（头发）金色的；晴朗的；顺风的；普通的；美丽的；界内的；<旧>（手段，方法）温和的，非暴力的；<旧>（言语，谈话，许诺）花言巧语的
adv. 公平地，公正地；非常；正面地，直接地；清楚地
n. 集市，展览会；露天游乐场；庙会；义卖会；牲畜市场；美女；职业介绍会
v. 变得晴朗；使（车辆，船舶，飞机）具有流线型
【名】 （Fair）（英、芬）费尔（人名）

sentences.c: The punishment was very fair.
sentences.cn: 这个处罚很公正。

sentences.c: Blue suited her fair colouring.
sentences.cn: 蓝色适合于她白皙的肤色。

sentences.c: 'It's not fair,' she complained.
sentences.cn: “这不公平。”她抱怨道。

name: fairly
trans: adv. 相当地，颇；公平地，公正地；<旧>（用以强调）完全，简直；令人愉快地，让人喜欢地
【名】 （Fairly）（英）费尔利（人名）

sentences.c: Our plans are fairly elastic.
sentences.cn: 我们的计划有相当大的灵活性。

sentences.c: The exam was fairly difficult.
sentences.cn: 这场考试相当难。

sentences.c: The wheels are usually fairly large.
sentences.cn: 该机轮通常相当大。

name: fairness
trans: n. 公平，公正；白皙，浅色

sentences.c: Americans have an innate sense of fairness.
sentences.cn: 美国人有一种天生的公平感。

sentences.c: He has a good overall sense of justice and fairness.
sentences.cn: 他有良好的公正和公平的整体意识。

sentences.c: Her introduction is a model of fairness, a lively summation of Irish history.
sentences.cn: 她的导论是公正的典范，是对爱尔兰历史的总结。

name: faith
trans: n. 信任，信心，信念；宗教；宗教信仰；忠诚
int. <爱尔兰>用以表示惊讶或强调千真万确
【名】 （Faith）（英）费思，费丝，（匈）福伊特，（瑞典）法伊特（人名）

sentences.c: Faith is stronger than reason.
sentences.cn: 信仰比理智更有力。

sentences.c: He retains a faith in human goodness.
sentences.cn: 他依然相信人性的善。

sentences.c: We've lost faith in the government's promises.
sentences.cn: 我们不再相信政府的承诺。

name: fall
trans: v. 降落，落下；跌倒，倒塌；（水平、数量、价格等）下跌，减少；属于；下垂，低垂；照射（到），（阴影）落在；降临，发生；倒台，失势；被打败，沦陷；阵亡，被击毙；打中，击中；（嗓音或声音）变轻，变小；进入（某状态），开始变成（某事物）
n. 落下，跌倒；（数量、水平、价格等的）下降，降低；秋天，秋季；失败，垮台 ；瀑布；（摔跤或柔道项目中的）摔倒，压倒；（雨、雪等的）降落；堕落
【名】 （Fall）（西）法勒（人名）

sentences.c: Let me fall if I must fall. The one I become will catch me.
sentences.cn: 如果必须坠落，就让我坠落。我会成为的那个人，一定会接住我。

sentences.c: Aren't you afraid (that) you'll fall?
sentences.cn: 你不怕会跌倒吗？

sentences.c: Output will fall by 6%.
sentences.cn: 产量将下降6%。

name: fall
trans: v. 降落，落下；跌倒，倒塌；（水平、数量、价格等）下跌，减少；属于；下垂，低垂；照射（到），（阴影）落在；降临，发生；倒台，失势；被打败，沦陷；阵亡，被击毙；打中，击中；（嗓音或声音）变轻，变小；进入（某状态），开始变成（某事物）
n. 落下，跌倒；（数量、水平、价格等的）下降，降低；秋天，秋季；失败，垮台 ；瀑布；（摔跤或柔道项目中的）摔倒，压倒；（雨、雪等的）降落；堕落
【名】 （Fall）（西）法勒（人名）

sentences.c: Let me fall if I must fall. The one I become will catch me.
sentences.cn: 如果必须坠落，就让我坠落。我会成为的那个人，一定会接住我。

sentences.c: Aren't you afraid (that) you'll fall?
sentences.cn: 你不怕会跌倒吗？

sentences.c: Output will fall by 6%.
sentences.cn: 产量将下降6%。

name: false
trans: False refers to something that is not true or accurate.
adj. 错误的，不真实的；伪造的；人造的；站不住脚的，全无根据的；不真诚的；不忠诚的；外表上与……相似的；非法的；妄动的
adv. 欺诈地

sentences.c: He hid behind a false identity.
sentences.cn: 他隐姓埋名。

sentences.c: The thief used a false identity.
sentences.cn: 窃贼使用的是假身份。

sentences.c: The story is almost certainly false.
sentences.cn: 这个故事几乎肯定是虚构的。

name: familiar
trans: n. （与女巫共居的）妖精；知交，密友；（在教皇或主教家服务的）仆人
【名】 （Familiar）（西）法米利亚尔（人名）
adj. 熟悉的；常见的，普通的；非正式的，随和的；过分亲密的，随便的

sentences.c: He was humming a familiar tune.
sentences.cn: 他低声哼着一支熟悉的小曲。

sentences.c: He felt a longing for the familiar.
sentences.cn: 他渴望熟悉的氛围。

sentences.c: The town was weirdly familiar.
sentences.cn: 这个城镇怪面熟的。

name: family
trans: n. 家，家庭；家属，亲属；家族；子女，孩子；（动植物的）科；语族；祖先； 一窝（动物）； 有组织的犯罪团伙；（具有明显共同特征的）一类东西；（在某些方面）像家人一样的一群人；（数）族；派别；氏族
adj. 家庭的；一家所有的；老少咸宜的；全家用的

sentences.c: They were an insular family.
sentences.cn: 他们一家人与世隔绝。

sentences.c: His family expostulated with him.
sentences.cn: 他的家人反驳他。

sentences.c: We're a very close family.
sentences.cn: 我们全家彼此亲密无间。

name: family name
trans: 姓
家族姓氏，即姓氏

sentences.c: He had disgraced the family name.
sentences.cn: 他玷污了家族的名声。

sentences.c: I don't want to bring shame on the family name.
sentences.cn: 我不想给家庭的声誉带来耻辱。

sentences.c: Shall I write your given or family name first?
sentences.cn: 我应该先写您的名字还是姓氏呢？

name: famous
trans: adj. 著名的，出名的；<非正式>极好的，了不起的

sentences.c: His books are world-famous.
sentences.cn: 他的著作举世闻名。

sentences.c: Some day he'll be famous.
sentences.cn: 总有一天他会成名的。

sentences.c: Some day I'll be famous.
sentences.cn: 总有一天我会成名的。

name: fan
trans: n. 风扇，扇子；粉丝，狂热爱好者；扇形；（使风车头迎风的）风叶；（山坡脚下的）地带
v. 扇，为……扇风；煽（火）；煽动，激起；（击球手）三击不中出局；（呼吸，微风）吹拂；驱散，扇走；<美>击球不中
【名】 （Fan）（美、法、俄）法恩（人名）

sentences.c: He is a fanatical fan of Mozart.
sentences.cn: 他是一名莫扎特音乐的狂热爱好者。

sentences.c: The fan revolved slowly.
sentences.cn: 电扇缓慢地转动着。

sentences.c: She installed a wall-mounted electric fan.
sentences.cn: 她装了一台墙壁式电扇。

name: fancy
trans: v. <英，非正式> 喜欢，想要；<英，非正式> 爱恋，爱慕；<英，非正式> 认为……会成功（赢）；<文> 认为，想象；<英，非正式>自负，自命不凡（fancy oneself）；<英> （表示惊奇或震惊）真想不到，竟然；爱恋，爱慕（常用于英式口语中）； <英，非正式>喜欢，想要（常用于英式口语中）；<英，非正式>爱恋，爱慕（常用于英式口语中）；<英，非正式>认为……会成功（赢）
n. 喜欢，想要；想象，想象力，想象的事物；<旧> （无根据的）想法，空想；花色小蛋糕；（赛马或其他体育比赛中）最被看好的人（或动物）；<旧> 喜爱的人（或事物）；（16和17世纪音乐用语）幻想曲；（无根据的）想法，空想
adj. 时髦的，奢华的；华丽的，花哨的；复杂的，高难度的；（食品）特级的，优质的；娴熟的，巧妙的；（花）杂色的；（动物）供观赏的；（画，雕塑）凭想像创作的，想像出来的
【名】 （Fancy）范茜（人名）
